Nevertheless, scant study has investigated these activities as educational experiences, especially from the viewpoints of both participants and facilitators.
Participants and Procedure: This qualitative phenomenological study examined the lived experiences of cancer carers and facilitators who engaged in an expressive arts-based craft session at a faith- based respite facility in Baguio City, Philippines. Eleven participants, comprisingseven caretakers and four facilitators, were intentionally recruited. Data were acquiredthrough semi-structured interviews, participant observation, and reflective art narratives. Colaizzi’s seven-step phenomenological technique led the analysis. Results: Seven themes emerged: (1) crafting as emotional solace, (2) the crafting process as transient therapy, (3) flowers as emblems of hope and supplication, (4) communityand collective strength, (5) instances of normalcy among caregiving strain, (6) observing resilience, and (7) service as a spiritual vocation. The workshop functioned
as an informal learning place that facilitated contemplation, emotional control, andrelational interaction. Conclusions: The research identifies expressive arts-based craft workshops as informal experiential learning environments within community care contexts, influencing outreachcurricula, service-learning programs, and informal educational efforts.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了表达性艺术手工工作坊作为癌症照顾者的非正式学习环境，通过质性现象学方法分析参与者和促进者的体验，发现工作坊提供了情感慰藉、短暂治疗、希望象征、社区支持等七个主题，证实了艺术活动在社区关怀中的教育价值。
AI.research_question: 表达性艺术手工工作坊如何作为癌症照顾者的非正式学习环境，从参与者和促进者的视角体验这些活动？
AI.motivation: 癌症照顾者经常承受长期情感压力、社会孤立和有限的反思互动机会，而表达性艺术工作坊可作为促进情感意识、象征性解释和关系学习的非正式学习环境，但现有研究很少从教育角度探讨这些活动。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非正式学习理论、体验式学习理论、现象学理论（关注生活体验）、表达性艺术治疗理论、社区关怀教育理论。
AI.method: 质性现象学研究，采用Colaizzi七步现象学方法，通过半结构化访谈、参与式观察和反思性艺术叙事收集数据，在菲律宾碧瑶市信仰型喘息设施中招募11名参与者（7名照顾者和4名促进者）。
AI.findings: 识别出七个主题：1)手工制作作为情感慰藉；2)制作过程作为短暂治疗；3)花朵作为希望和祈祷的象征；4)社区和集体力量；5)照顾压力中的正常时刻；6)观察韧性；7)服务作为精神使命。工作坊促进了反思、情感调节和关系互动。
AI.theory_contributions: 1)扩展了非正式学习理论在社区关怀环境中的应用；2)深化了对表达性艺术作为教育体验的理解；3)提供了现象学视角下照顾者和促进者双重体验的理论框架；4)丰富了体验式学习在情感调节和关系建立方面的理论内涵。
AI.practical_contributions: 1)为社区关怀机构设计艺术工作坊提供实践指导；2)影响外展课程、服务学习项目和非正式教育计划的设计；3)为癌症照顾者支持项目提供创新模式；4)促进照顾者情感健康和社区连接的具体策略。

title: Managing Walk-In-Induced No-Shows in Hybrid Outpatient Systems: The Role of Proactive Cancellation
affiliations: Bilkent University - Faculty of Business Administration

detail.title: Managing Walk-In-Induced No-Shows in Hybrid Outpatient Systems: The Role of Proactive Cancellation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None to declare.
declarations.funderStatement: None to declare.

detail.abstract: We study a hybrid outpatient system serving urgent (type-1) and regular (type-2) patients. Some patients book appointments but may also attempt walk-in service before their scheduled visit. If served via walk-in, they do not cancel the original appointment, creating walk-in-induced endogenous no-shows. We develop a dynamic game-theoretic model capturing patients' walk-in and no-show decisions and derive threshold-based optimal strategies. We characterize an equilibrium where patients' beliefs about blockage probability and direct wait match realized values. To manage endogenous no-shows, we propose a proactive cancellation policy that removes the future appointment of any patient served via walk-in. Surprisingly, simulation results reveal that proactive cancellation does not always benefit system performance. While it reduces total social cost by 28% in overloaded systems, it can increase both total social cost and indirect wait times under moderate load-challenging the conventional belief that all no-show reductions are beneficial. Moreover, its impact on timely access varies: with fewer urgent patients, it improves timely access for them but worsens regular patients' waits. When urgent demand is high, both groups benefit. These findings highlight that effective no-show management must consider both the strategic nature of no-shows and system load; universal interventions may backfire.

AI.tldr: 研究混合门诊系统中紧急和常规患者的就诊行为，发现患者可能预约后尝试直接就诊，导致"直接就诊引发的内生性爽约"。提出主动取消政策（直接就诊后取消预约），但模拟显示该政策在中等负荷下可能恶化系统性能，挑战了"减少爽约总是有益"的传统观念。
AI.research_question: 在混合门诊系统中，如何管理由患者直接就诊行为引发的内生性爽约？主动取消政策（直接就诊后取消预约）对系统性能有何影响？
AI.motivation: 传统门诊系统研究主要关注外生性爽约，但现实中患者可能预约后尝试直接就诊，如果成功就诊却不取消原预约，会产生内生性爽约。这种战略行为对系统性能的影响尚未被充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态博弈论模型，分析患者的直接就诊和爽约决策；阈值策略优化；均衡分析（患者对阻塞概率和直接等待时间的信念与实际值匹配）。
AI.method: 理论建模结合模拟分析。建立动态博弈模型推导最优策略，通过模拟验证主动取消政策在不同系统负荷下的效果。
AI.findings: 1. 主动取消政策在超负荷系统中能减少28%总社会成本，但在中等负荷下可能增加总社会成本和间接等待时间。2. 政策对及时就医的影响因患者类型而异：紧急患者少时改善紧急患者等待但恶化常规患者等待；紧急需求高时两类患者都受益。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次将直接就诊引发的内生性爽约纳入门诊系统分析。2. 挑战"减少爽约总是有益"的传统观念，证明干预效果取决于系统负荷。3. 提供博弈论框架分析患者战略行为对系统性能的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为医院管理者提供决策依据：主动取消政策并非总是有效，需根据系统负荷谨慎实施。2. 强调爽约管理需考虑患者战略行为和系统负荷的交互作用。3. 提供差异化政策建议：根据紧急患者比例调整管理策略。

title: The Economics of Space Activities: An Evolutionary Perspective

detail.title: The Economics of Space Activities: An Evolutionary Perspective
detail.abstract:
Space activities are integral to modern economies, supporting critical sectors such as transportation, energy, finance, food supply, government, public safety, law enforcement, emergency services, critical manufacturing, and national security. Today, the space economy is undergoing a radical transformation with the rise of “New Space” firms driven by innovations in reusable rockets, satellite miniaturization, additive manufacturing, and novel business models. These developments reduce costs, reshape established markets, and challenge “Old Space” incumbents while opening new frontiers in commercial space stations, in-space manufacturing, orbital services, space mining, logistics, and tourism.

Adopting an evolutionary perspective on economics, this study examines the dynamics of this shift. The goal is to explain why new market entrants appear to drive innovation more effectively than traditional, well-established companies. Key differences between New Space and Old Space include external factors, such as an influx of venture capital, innovation clusters, evolving public-private partnerships (PPPs), different types of government contracts, and regulatory influences, as well as internal factors, such as organizational structure and ambidexterity.

The thesis is structured into four chapters. Chapter I provides an overview of the concepts, history, and future value of the space economy in the U.S. and Europe. Chapter II explores theories of innovation (e.g., Schumpeterian creative destruction, clusters, and big surges) that enable new opportunities. Chapter III analyzes innovation risks using case studies (e.g., Virgin Orbit, Iridium, and SpaceX versus Arianespace) and disruptive entry. Chapter IV examines how organizational and market structures impact the innovation capacity of traditional space firms (are they “too big to innovate?”) by analyzing cases such as Boeing's financialization and outsourcing and ULA's monopoly.

The study aims to lay the groundwork for a “theory of the innovative space firm,” emphasizing outer space as the final frontier of entrepreneurship.

AI.tldr: 本文采用演化经济学视角，研究"新太空"企业如何比传统"旧太空"公司更有效地推动创新。通过分析外部因素（风险资本、创新集群、公私合作、政府合同、监管）和内部因素（组织结构、双元能力），探讨太空经济转型动态，旨在建立"创新性太空企业理论"。
AI.research_question: 为什么新进入市场的"新太空"企业比传统"旧太空"公司更能有效推动创新？太空经济转型的动态机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 太空活动对现代经济至关重要，支持交通、能源、金融、国家安全等关键部门。当前太空经济正经历"新太空"企业带来的根本性变革，这些企业通过可重复使用火箭、卫星小型化等技术创新降低成本、重塑市场、挑战传统企业，并开辟商业空间站、太空制造、太空采矿等新领域。
AI.theoretical_framework: 演化经济学视角；熊彼特创造性破坏理论；创新集群理论；大浪潮理论；组织双元能力理论；市场结构理论。
AI.method: 采用多案例研究方法，分析Virgin Orbit、Iridium、SpaceX vs Arianespace等案例；通过Boeing财务化和外包、ULA垄断等案例，分析传统太空企业的创新障碍；结合理论分析与实证案例研究。
AI.findings: 新太空企业通过技术创新和商业模式创新更有效地推动创新；外部因素（风险资本、创新集群、公私合作模式、政府合同类型、监管环境）和内部因素（组织结构灵活性、双元能力）共同影响创新效率；传统太空企业可能因规模过大、官僚结构而面临创新障碍。
AI.theory_contributions: 为"创新性太空企业理论"奠定基础；将演化经济学应用于太空经济转型分析；扩展创新理论在太空产业的应用；提出太空作为创业"最后边疆"的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供太空产业创新政策建议；帮助企业理解太空经济转型中的创新机制；为投资者识别太空经济中的创新机会；为传统太空企业提供组织变革和创新管理的实践指导。

title: A Theory of Power Convergence: The Cumulative Individual

detail.title: A Theory of Power Convergence: The Cumulative Individual

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial or personal interests that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study, as it is a theoretical analysis that does not involve human participants, data collection, or identifiable personal information.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This article develops a theory of power convergence centered on the concept of the cumulative individual. Existing theories of power remain analytically fragmented, isolating coercive, structural, symbolic, psychological, and networked dimensions without explaining how they interact. The theory advanced here argues that, under contemporary conditions of mediation, visibility, and connectivity, these domains increasingly converge within individual actors who function as systems of power rather than as occupants of discrete roles. Power is shown to accumulate through recursive feedback loops in which performance, amplification, affect, and institutional response mutually reinforce one another. To formalize this dynamic, the article introduces a developmental geometry of power organization and a systems model of convergence that specifies how heterogeneous domains become interoperable. The cumulative individual is defined as the entity in which convergent power stabilizes, reproduces itself, and remains inherently volatile. By providing a synthetic and extensible framework, the article establishes conceptual groundwork for analyzing emergent forms of authority that existing approaches cannot adequately explain.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"累积个体"的权力汇聚理论，认为在当代媒介化、可见性和连接性条件下，强制、结构、象征、心理和网络等权力维度在个体层面汇聚，个体成为权力系统而非离散角色持有者。
AI.research_question: 在当代媒介化、可见性和连接性条件下，不同的权力维度（强制、结构、象征、心理、网络）如何相互作用并汇聚于个体层面？
AI.motivation: 现有权力理论分析上碎片化，孤立地看待不同权力维度，无法解释它们如何相互作用，也无法充分解释当代新兴权威形式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 权力汇聚理论，强调权力通过表演、放大、情感和制度响应的递归反馈循环累积，形成"累积个体"作为权力汇聚的实体。
AI.method: 理论构建方法，提出权力组织的"发展几何学"和汇聚的"系统模型"，形式化权力动态。
AI.findings: 权力在当代条件下在个体层面汇聚，形成"累积个体"作为权力稳定、自我复制但内在不稳定的实体。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提供综合可扩展的框架分析现有理论无法解释的新兴权威形式；2) 形式化权力汇聚的动态过程；3) 引入"累积个体"概念作为权力汇聚的核心实体。
AI.practical_contributions: 为分析当代社会中的权力动态、权威形成和个体在权力系统中的角色提供概念工具，有助于理解媒介化社会中权力运作的新模式。

title: Integration of IoT-Enabled Technologies and Artificial Intelligence (AI) for Smart City Scenario: Recent Advancements and Future Trends
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Integration of IoT-Enabled Technologies and Artificial Intelligence (AI) for Smart City Scenario: Recent Advancements and Future Trends
detail.abstract: This article critique evaluates the journal titled Integration of IoT-Enabled Technologies and Artificial Intelligence (AI) for Smart City Scenario: Recent Advancements and Future Trends, published in Sensors (2023). The purpose of this critique is to assess the quality, relevance, and reliability of the research, particularly in relation to the subject Fundamentals of Networking. The article reviews how Internet of Things (IoT) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies are integrated to support smart city applications, with emphasis on communication networks and data processing. This critique summarizes the main ideas of the article and critically analyzes its methodology, use of evidence, logical flow, and overall contribution to the field. While the article effectively presents a broad overview of IoT-AI integration and highlights the importance of networking infrastructures, it is limited by its lack of experimental data and detailed technical analysis. Overall, the article is considered a useful academic reference for students and researchers seeking to understand the role of networking in smart city systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文评述了2023年发表在Sensors期刊上的《物联网与人工智能集成在智慧城市场景中的应用：最新进展与未来趋势》一文，评估了其在网络基础课程中的质量、相关性和可靠性。文章综述了物联网与人工智能如何集成支持智慧城市应用，重点关注通信网络和数据处理。
AI.research_question: 物联网与人工智能技术如何集成以支持智慧城市应用？通信网络和数据处理在智慧城市系统中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 评估该综述文章在网络基础课程背景下的学术质量、相关性和可靠性，为理解智慧城市系统中网络基础设施的重要性提供参考。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于物联网与人工智能技术集成的理论框架，重点关注通信网络架构、数据处理流程和智慧城市应用场景。
AI.method: 文献综述与批判性分析，包括对文章方法论、证据使用、逻辑流程和领域贡献的评估。
AI.findings: 文章有效呈现了物联网-人工智能集成的广泛概述，强调了网络基础设施的重要性，但缺乏实验数据和详细技术分析。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了物联网与人工智能在智慧城市场景中集成的系统性综述框架，突出了网络基础设施的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为学生和研究人员理解智慧城市系统中网络的角色提供了有用的学术参考，但缺乏具体的技术实施细节。

title: The Human Moral Archive Framework (HMAF) A Canonical Attribute Registry for Longitudinal AI Auditability Minimal Measurement Infrastructure for Cross-Epoch Behavioral Assessment
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Human Moral Archive Framework (HMAF) A Canonical Attribute Registry for Longitudinal AI Auditability Minimal Measurement Infrastructure for Cross-Epoch Behavioral Assessment

declarations.funderStatement: self

keywords.keywords: Human Moral Archive Framework (HMAF); AI auditability; longitudinal audit; canonical attribute registry; semantic immutability; registry epoching; audit independence; external measurement; behavioral drift; AI governance infrastructure; non-evaluative measurement; regulatory evidence preservation; regulatory compliance

detail.abstract: The Human Moral Archive Framework (HMAF) is an external archival infrastructure for the durable preservation of morally relevant characteristics of AI-mediated system behavior. It is not an ethics system, a moral authority, or a mechanism for evaluation, scoring, or control. HMAF exists to address a structural limitation in contemporary AI governance: the inability to reliably examine moral-relevant system behavior across long time horizons as systems, policies, and interpretive standards evolve. The framework establishes a fixed canonical measurement substrate composed of invariant attribute identities, applied externally to observed system behavior and interaction context. These attributes function as measurement units rather than moral claims. Their naming and structural position do not change. When the applied meaning or interpretive guidance associated with any attribute evolves, such changes are declared explicitly through registry epoching and preserved immutably as part of the historical record. This separation between measurement structure and semantic governance enables longitudinal comparison without retrospective reinterpretation. HMAF deliberately excludes embedded evaluative mathematics, normative models, and human judgment from the archival substrate. All analysis, interpretation, and regulatory or ethical assessment occur outside the framework, under explicitly declared assumptions. By separating preservation from judgment, and by externalizing moral-relevant records from adaptive AI systems, HMAF provides a stable evidentiary layer that supports auditability, oversight, and retrospective analysis without constraining system design or delegating moral authority.

AI.tldr: HMAF是一个外部档案框架，用于持久保存AI系统行为的道德相关特征，但不进行道德评估或控制。它通过固定测量结构和语义治理分离，支持长期审计和追溯分析。
AI.research_question: 如何解决AI治理中长期追踪道德相关系统行为的结构性限制？
AI.motivation: 当前AI治理无法可靠地跨长时间尺度检查道德相关系统行为，因为系统、政策和解释标准会不断演变。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于测量与语义分离的理论框架，建立固定测量基底和不变属性标识，将测量结构与语义治理解耦。
AI.method: 建立外部档案基础设施，使用不变属性标识作为测量单位，通过注册纪元机制记录语义变化，排除评估数学和规范模型。
AI.findings: HMAF通过分离保存与判断、外部化道德相关记录，提供了稳定的证据层，支持可审计性、监督和追溯分析。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了测量结构与语义治理分离的理论框架，解决了长期道德追踪中的追溯重新解释问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI治理提供了可操作的档案基础设施，支持监管审计、追溯分析，同时不限制系统设计或委托道德权威。

title: A Structural Determinism Framework for Verifying Climate Projects in an Era of Non-Linearity

detail.title: A Structural Determinism Framework for Verifying Climate Projects in an Era of Non-Linearity

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal or financial relationships with any organizations that could be perceived to have influenced the research presented in this paper. The analytical frameworks discussed are conceptual and methodological in nature, and no proprietary algorithms, commercial services, or paid advisory activities are evaluated or promoted in this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, personal data, or intervention-based research. All analyses are based on publicly available project documentation and secondary sources. Therefore, formal ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was self-funded by the author and did not receive any external financial support from public, private, or multilateral institutions.

detail.abstract: Climate change projects are often evaluated using benchmark data, historical performance proxies, or sectoral averages. Yet these methods are inherently insufficient when applied to projects designed to operate in a climate-altered future. This paper introduces a paradigm shift in climate project verification: from data-dependent evaluation toward structural determinism. We argue that in the era of irreversible tipping points, non-linearity, and systemic interdependencies, climate interventions must not be assessed by what has worked before-but by whether their internal structure makes success inevitable under defined conditions. Using the metaphor of a loaded die, we illustrate the difference between probabilistic expectations and design-based outcome assurance: rather than rolling the die and hoping for a six, we redesign the die so that six becomes the structurally dominant result. We propose a framework for verification grounded in causal integrity, execution traceability, and incentive alignment, bypassing the need for predictive benchmarks. The framework is currently being applied to emerging climate project models 1 and provides a structural basis for forthcoming large-scale benchmark analyses relevant to institutions such as the Green Climate Fund, ESG investors, and adaptation finance bodies. Structural determinism is not an abstraction-it is a verification logic for a world where the past no longer predicts the future. We must design the future we intend to survive. 1 Including the ENHANCE™ system's proprietary quantitative models: ToC:f(x)™, VERA™, VORTA™, PathFinder™, C-FAIR™, and VoC™, which were designed to assess structural integrity, incentive realism, replicability, and outcome viability in complex climate project architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出气候项目验证的范式转变：从依赖数据的评估转向结构决定论。在气候变化的非线性时代，项目评估不应基于历史表现，而应关注其内部结构是否能在特定条件下确保成功。
AI.research_question: 在气候变化不可逆转折点、非线性和系统相互依赖的时代，如何验证气候干预项目的有效性，当历史数据无法预测未来时？
AI.motivation: 传统的气候项目评估方法（基准数据、历史表现代理、行业平均值）在应用于为气候改变的未来设计的项目时存在固有不足，因为过去不再能预测未来。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构决定论：从概率期望转向基于设计的成果保证；因果完整性、执行可追溯性和激励一致性框架；"加载骰子"隐喻（重新设计骰子使特定结果成为结构主导）。
AI.method: 提出基于结构决定论的验证框架，应用于新兴气候项目模型（包括ENHANCE™系统的专有定量模型：ToC:f(x)™, VERA™, VORTA™, PathFinder™, C-FAIR™, VoC™），评估结构完整性、激励现实性、可复制性和成果可行性。
AI.findings: 结构决定论提供了一种绕过预测基准的验证逻辑，为绿色气候基金、ESG投资者和适应融资机构等机构的大规模基准分析提供结构基础。
AI.theory_contributions: 引入气候项目验证的范式转变：从数据依赖评估转向结构决定论；提出因果完整性、执行可追溯性和激励一致性的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为气候项目验证提供实用框架，应用于实际气候项目模型；为金融机构和气候融资机构提供结构化的评估工具，确保气候干预在不确定的未来中有效。

title: Learning Utility Models for Dynamic Inventory Control : A Reinforcement Learning Framework

detail.title: Learning Utility Models for Dynamic Inventory Control : A Reinforcement Learning Framework
detail.abstract: Quick-commerce operations face the dual challenge of rapidly fluctuating demand and strict fulfillment requirements in form of lead times, delivery times and storage space. We propose a utility-driven reinforcement learning (RL) framework that learns item-level utilities directly from observed demand and further uses them to dynamically control inventory. Customer Demand is defined through a two-stage process. A Poisson distribution models average number of orders received in an interval. Further,a negative binomial distribution simulates actual order arrival. Item level demand is derived using availability-aware multinomial logit (MNL) modeling. A key innovation is a censored-MNL correction that imputes preferences for items that are unavailable due to stockouts, mitigating bias in utility estimation and improving demand forecasts. We provide a convergence analysis under a trust-region (PPO-style) update and show, through simulation studies, that censored utility learning improves fill rates, reduces stockouts, and stabilizes inventory while preserving profitability compared to uncensored baselines and Poisson-only methods. The framework is modular-utilities can be parametric or neural-and extensible to assortment and SLA constraints. Collectively, our results demonstrate that learning utilities as the first-class driver of inventory decisions offers a robust, data-efficient route to optimizing fast-moving retail systems under uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于效用驱动的强化学习框架，通过修正的MNL模型学习商品级效用，动态控制库存，解决快商业务中需求波动和履约要求的双重挑战。
AI.research_question: 如何在快速波动的需求环境和严格的履约要求下，通过效用驱动的强化学习框架优化快商库存管理？
AI.motivation: 快商运营面临需求快速波动和严格的履约要求（如交货时间、配送时间和存储空间）的双重挑战，需要更智能的库存控制方法。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 两阶段需求建模：泊松分布模拟订单数量，负二项分布模拟实际订单到达
2. 可用性感知的多项Logit模型（MNL）推导商品级需求
3. 修正的MNL校正机制：估算缺货商品的偏好，减少效用估计偏差
AI.method:
1. 效用驱动的强化学习框架
2. 信任区域（PPO风格）更新策略
3. 模拟研究验证方法有效性
4. 模块化设计：效用可以是参数化或神经网络形式
AI.findings:
1. 修正的效用学习提高了填充率
2. 减少了缺货情况
3. 稳定了库存水平
4. 在保持盈利的同时优于未修正基准和仅使用泊松分布的方法
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了修正的MNL校正机制，减少缺货导致的效用估计偏差
2. 提供了信任区域更新的收敛性分析
3. 建立了将效用作为库存决策首要驱动因素的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为快商运营提供了数据高效的库存优化方案
2. 模块化框架可扩展到商品组合和服务水平协议约束
3. 在不确定性环境下为快速移动的零售系统提供了稳健的优化路径

title: Asset Pricing Robustness in Venture Capital
affiliations: Stout Risius Ross, LLC, Swiss Finance Institute - University of Geneva and Athens University of Economics and Business

detail.title: Asset Pricing Robustness in Venture Capital

publicationDetails.detailsText: Swiss Finance Institute Research Paper No. 26-26
publicationDetails.journalName: Swiss Finance Institute Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We provide robust evidence that traditional asset pricing models fail to incorporate key idiosyncratic properties of Venture Capital (VC) contracts under no proper risk-adjustment, leading to significant pricing heterogeneity relative to market participants. An option pricing analysis of 2,056 US VC-backed companies with 9,188 deals confirms that holding period and equity volatility are primary factors optimizing investor risk and return metrics, and minimizing valuation heterogeneity regardless of deal or contracting characteristics. We provide a security-return design evaluation framework leading to robust value attribution between investors, founders, and employees, and harmonized risk bifurcation across securities with asymmetric payoff properties. We link standard deviation of assets to key VC contract properties and leverage structural risk signals of VC contracts in optimizing endogenous derivation of investor risk premiums. Our results are robust and scalable to the broader VC universe.

AI.tldr: 传统资产定价模型未能考虑风险投资合同的关键特质性特征，导致定价异质性。基于2056家美国VC支持公司、9188笔交易的分析显示，持有期和股权波动率是优化投资者风险回报指标、减少估值异质性的主要因素。研究提出了安全回报设计评估框架，用于投资者、创始人和员工之间的价值分配，并优化VC合同的内生风险溢价推导。
AI.research_question: 传统资产定价模型如何未能充分考虑风险投资合同的特质性特征？持有期和股权波动率如何影响VC投资的风险调整回报和估值异质性？
AI.motivation: 传统资产定价模型在应用于风险投资合同时存在局限性，未能纳入VC合同的关键特质性特征，导致定价异质性显著，无法准确反映市场参与者的实际风险调整需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资产定价理论、期权定价理论、风险投资合同理论、风险溢价理论、异质性定价理论
AI.method: 对2056家美国VC支持公司的9188笔交易进行期权定价分析，实证检验持有期和股权波动率对投资者风险回报指标的影响，构建安全回报设计评估框架。
AI.findings: 1. 持有期和股权波动率是优化投资者风险回报指标的主要因素；2. 这些因素能最小化估值异质性，不受交易或合同特征影响；3. 资产标准差与VC合同关键特性相关；4. VC合同的结构性风险信号可用于优化内生风险溢价推导。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了传统资产定价模型在风险投资领域的应用；2. 提出了考虑VC合同特质性特征的定价框架；3. 建立了安全回报设计评估的理论基础；4. 发展了VC合同内生风险溢价推导的理论模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者、创始人和员工提供了价值分配框架；2. 帮助VC市场参与者减少估值异质性；3. 提供了优化风险调整回报的实用工具；4. 可扩展应用于更广泛的VC生态系统。

title: Artificial Intelligence and Risk-Taking in Banking
affiliations: Babeş-Bolyai University of Cluj-Napoca, Babeş-Bolyai University of Cluj-Napoca, Babes-Bolyai University - Department of Finance and University of Zurich - Department Finance

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence and Risk-Taking in Banking

publicationDetails.detailsText: Swiss Finance Institute Research Paper No. 26-25
publicationDetails.journalName: Swiss Finance Institute Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We study how banks’ adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) affects risk-taking and stability using data on major listed Chinese banks (2013–2024). We construct an AI-intensity index from agent adoption, cloud computing, and big data measures. Higher AI intensity is associated with greater risk and lower stability: a one–standard deviation increase reduces the Z‑score by 0.25 units (about 22%) next year. This operates mainly via higher earnings volatility and lower profitability, not weaker capitalization. The effect is stronger for banks with low liquidity, unstable funding, and weak loss-absorption, implying AI can amplify risk and requires tighter prudential oversight.

AI.tldr: 银行采用人工智能会增加风险并降低稳定性，主要通过提高盈利波动性和降低盈利能力实现，对流动性低、资金不稳定、损失吸收能力弱的银行影响更大
AI.research_question: 银行采用人工智能如何影响其风险承担和稳定性？
AI.motivation: 随着人工智能在银行业的广泛应用，需要了解AI对银行风险承担和金融稳定的影响，为监管政策提供依据
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于银行风险承担理论、金融稳定理论和人工智能技术应用理论
AI.method: 使用中国主要上市银行2013-2024年数据，构建AI强度指数（包括智能代理采用、云计算和大数据指标），采用回归分析检验AI强度与风险承担、稳定性的关系
AI.findings: AI强度越高，银行风险越大，稳定性越低：AI强度增加一个标准差会使Z-score下降0.25个单位（约22%）。这种影响主要通过提高盈利波动性和降低盈利能力实现，而非削弱资本充足率。对流动性低、资金不稳定、损失吸收能力弱的银行影响更显著
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统分析AI对银行风险承担的影响机制，揭示了AI通过盈利渠道而非资本渠道影响稳定性的新发现
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行AI风险管理提供指导，建议对AI应用实施更严格的审慎监管，特别是对脆弱性较高的银行

title: Household Economic Resilience
affiliations: ,  and Central Bank of Ireland

detail.title: Household Economic Resilience

publicationDetails.detailsText: Central Bank of Ireland Research Paper Series
publicationDetails.journalName: Central Bank of Ireland Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: How are households coping with high inflation in 2022? We show that, while many households remain resilient, fragilities exist. Increases in food and energy prices alongside rising rents have a much greater impact on household finances than interest rate increases on variable rate mortgages. This reflects the smaller share of mortgage interest in household expenditure relative to food and energy, among other factors. In a ‘severe’ scenario involving further price increases for essentials, our analysis shows that households in a more precarious financial position with limited savings buffers (around 15 per cent of all households) would see 44 per cent of their disposable income used for spending on just this limited set of items. Targeted, temporary supports for more exposed households will support consumption of essential goods and services until price rises abate and/or real incomes rise.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了2022年高通胀下英国家庭的应对情况，发现食品和能源价格上涨对家庭财务的影响远大于可变利率抵押贷款加息，约15%的脆弱家庭在严重情景下将把44%的可支配收入用于基本必需品支出。
AI.research_question: 在高通胀环境下，英国家庭如何应对物价上涨？不同家庭群体的财务脆弱性如何？哪些因素对家庭财务影响最大？
AI.motivation: 2022年英国面临高通胀压力，食品、能源价格和租金大幅上涨，同时利率上升影响可变利率抵押贷款持有者。需要了解不同家庭如何应对这些冲击，识别脆弱群体，为政策制定提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于家庭财务脆弱性理论，分析不同收入群体、储蓄缓冲、支出结构对通胀冲击的承受能力。考虑必需品支出占比、可支配收入分配、储蓄缓冲作用等关键因素。
AI.method: 采用情景分析法和家庭财务数据模拟，比较不同通胀冲击（食品能源价格上涨vs利率上升）对家庭支出的影响，识别脆弱家庭群体及其财务压力程度。
AI.findings: 1. 食品和能源价格上涨对家庭财务的影响远大于可变利率抵押贷款加息；2. 约15%的家庭财务状况脆弱、储蓄缓冲有限；3. 在严重情景下，这些脆弱家庭将把44%的可支配收入用于有限的基本必需品支出；4. 抵押贷款利息在家庭支出中的份额相对较小。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 量化比较了不同类型通胀冲击对家庭财务的相对影响；2. 识别了家庭财务脆弱性的关键决定因素；3. 提供了通胀冲击下家庭应对机制的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供针对性临时支持措施的依据；2. 帮助识别最需要援助的脆弱家庭群体；3. 支持基本商品和服务的消费维持，直到物价上涨缓解或实际收入增加。

title: The GOAT: According to History of Economic Thought Textbooks
affiliations: Northwood University and Middle Tennessee State University - Department of Economics and Finance

detail.title: The GOAT: According to History of Economic Thought Textbooks

declarations.ethicsApproval: No ethics statement is required.
declarations.funderStatement: No dedicated funding was received to support this research.

detail.abstract: Who is the greatest economist of all time? This paper provides one potential measure that, along with other considerations, can contribute to debates on who the greatest economist of all time is. We build a novel dataset on the percentage of history of economic thought textbooks dedicated to top economists, using 43 distinct textbooks (1st editions, when available) published between 1901 and 2023. As a percentage of total book pages, Adam Smith has the highest share at 6.69%, beating out Ricardo (5.22%), Mill (3.83%), and Marx (4.36%). Just over 32% of all textbooks allocated most of their pages to Adam Smith, followed by Marx with 18.6%, Mill with 13.95%, and Ricardo with 11.3%. While interesting as a history of economic thought project, such an exercise isn't merely amusing pedantry; it can provide insight into the types of contributions, research questions, and methodologies that have had the most enduring impact in economics. It may also inform future authors of history of economic textbooks.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析43本经济学思想史教科书（1901-2023年）的篇幅分配，量化评估历史上最伟大的经济学家。亚当·斯密以6.69%的总篇幅占比居首，超过李嘉图、穆勒和马克思。
AI.research_question: 谁是历史上最伟大的经济学家？如何通过经济学思想史教科书的篇幅分配来量化评估经济学家的历史地位和影响力？
AI.motivation: 关于"史上最伟大经济学家"的争论长期存在但缺乏量化依据。本文旨在提供一个客观的衡量标准，通过分析经济学思想史教科书的篇幅分配来评估经济学家的历史地位和持久影响力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于知识传播和学术影响力理论，假设经济学思想史教科书的篇幅分配反映了经济学家贡献的持久性和重要性。采用文本分析和量化历史方法。
AI.method: 构建了一个新颖的数据集，收集了43本经济学思想史教科书（1901-2023年出版，优先使用第一版）。计算每位经济学家在总书页中的占比，并统计每本教科书篇幅最多的经济学家分布。
AI.findings: 亚当·斯密以6.69%的总篇幅占比排名第一，其次是李嘉图（5.22%）、马克思（4.36%）和穆勒（3.83%）。32%的教科书将最多篇幅分配给亚当·斯密，其次是马克思（18.6%）、穆勒（13.95%）和李嘉图（11.3%）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了量化评估经济学家历史地位的新方法；2）为"史上最伟大经济学家"的争论提供了实证依据；3）揭示了经济学思想史中持久影响力的模式。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为未来经济学思想史教科书的编写提供参考；2）帮助理解哪些类型的贡献、研究问题和方法论在经济学中最具持久影响力；3）为学术评价和教学提供量化工具。

title: Art, Science, and Book I of the Wealth of Nations
affiliations: Northwood University and Middle Tennessee State University - Department of Economics and Finance

detail.title: Art, Science, and Book I of the Wealth of Nations
detail.abstract: Adam Smith provided the first systematic account of political economy. While no one should expect the empirical standards of modern economics from an 18 th century work, this does not diminish the scientific significance of the Wealth of Nations. Focusing on Book I, this paper argues that Smith's major claims were grounded in historical observation and institutional comparison and were intended to be confronted with experience. In doing so, the paper challenges recent interpretations that portray Smith's work as primarily ideological, while maintaining a clear distinction between Smith's economic analysis and his policy positions.

AI.tldr: 本文认为亚当·斯密的《国富论》具有科学意义，其核心主张基于历史观察和制度比较，旨在与经验事实对照，挑战了将斯密著作视为意识形态产物的解读。
AI.research_question: 亚当·斯密的《国富论》是否具有科学意义？其核心主张是基于经验观察还是意识形态立场？
AI.motivation: 回应近期将斯密著作解读为意识形态产物的观点，澄清《国富论》的科学性质，区分斯密的经济分析与政策立场。
AI.theoretical_framework: 亚当·斯密的政治经济学理论，特别是《国富论》第一卷中的核心概念，如分工、市场机制、自然价格等。
AI.method: 文本分析，聚焦《国富论》第一卷，考察斯密主张的历史观察基础、制度比较方法，以及其理论如何与经验事实对照。
AI.findings: 斯密的主要主张基于历史观察和制度比较，旨在与经验事实对照，具有科学意义；需要区分其经济分析与政策立场。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了《国富论》的科学性质，挑战了将其视为意识形态产物的解读，为理解斯密政治经济学的经验基础提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助学者更准确地理解斯密著作的性质，为经济思想史研究提供方法论指导，促进对古典政治经济学科学性的重新评估。

title: How Long Do they Walk and Work to Grow Food? Insights into Women Farmers in the Marshlands of the Democratic Republic of Congo
affiliations: University of Lubumbashi

detail.title: How Long Do they Walk and Work to Grow Food? Insights into Women Farmers in the Marshlands of the Democratic Republic of Congo

declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval and consent to participate I obtained written research authorization No. 016/2022 from the University of Lubumbashi to conduct a survey of farmers from February to June 2022. Women farmers participating in this study provided oral consent confirming their willingness to participate in the survey. The study does not involve human or animal parts

detail.abstract: In rural areas, women are key agents of development, balancing their time between household care responsibilities and economic activities, particularly farming. In this study, I use a mixed-methods approach, combining quantitative and qualitative data from 232 women farmers in the Democratic Republic of Congo, to examine time use and labor involved in food production in marshlands. I also explore how long walking distances and physically demanding tasks impact women's labor productivity and well-being. Findings show notable differences in time spent walking to fields and hours worked daily. In Kabare, South Kivu, 74% of women farm marshlands within a 30-minute walk from home, whereas in Mulungwishi, Haut-Katanga, 37% walk over an hour to reach their fields. Across both regions, women work between 6 and 7.5 hours per day and often rely on their children for labor support. While children's participation in farm work helps alleviate women's (usually their mothers') workload during peak cropping periods, it can negatively affect their education, leading to missed classes or school dropout. 2 Women farmers in focus groups reported intense fatigue after returning from the fields, deterioration in their well-being, and concerns about their young children being left unsupervised for long hours. These findings highlight that improving family farm productivity and the well-being of rural women requires more than just access to land, seeds, and fertilizers. Enhancing rural infrastructure-such as roads, transportation, and irrigation systems-can help alleviate the physical strain on women both in the fields and during transportation.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用混合方法调查刚果民主共和国农村妇女在沼泽地农业生产中的时间使用和劳动负担，发现长距离步行和重体力劳动严重影响妇女的生产力和福祉，儿童参与农活虽缓解母亲负担但影响教育，改善农村基础设施是关键解决方案。
AI.research_question: 农村妇女在沼泽地农业生产中的时间使用和劳动负担如何影响其劳动生产力和福祉？长距离步行和重体力任务对妇女的农业生产力有何影响？
AI.motivation: 农村妇女是发展的关键推动者，但她们需要在家庭照护责任和经济活动（特别是农业）之间平衡时间。在沼泽地农业生产中，妇女面临长距离步行和重体力劳动的挑战，这些因素可能严重影响她们的生产力和福祉，需要深入研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 时间使用理论、农业劳动力性别分工理论、农村妇女福祉理论、儿童劳动与教育权衡理论
AI.method: 混合方法研究，结合定量和定性数据，调查刚果民主共和国两个地区（南基伍省卡巴雷和上加丹加省穆伦圭希）的232名妇女农民
AI.findings: 1. 地区间存在显著差异：卡巴雷74%的妇女步行30分钟内可达沼泽地，而穆伦圭希37%的妇女需要步行1小时以上；2. 妇女每天工作6-7.5小时；3. 儿童参与农活帮助缓解母亲负担，但导致缺课或辍学；4. 妇女报告极度疲劳、福祉下降，以及儿童长时间无人照管的担忧
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 深化了对农村妇女时间分配和劳动负担的理解；2. 揭示了儿童参与农业劳动对教育的负面影响；3. 提出了基础设施改善对缓解妇女体力负担的理论框架；4. 扩展了农业生产力与妇女福祉关系的理论视角
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 强调改善农村基础设施（道路、交通、灌溉系统）的重要性；2. 指出仅提供土地、种子和肥料不足以提高家庭农场生产力；3. 为政策制定者提供减轻妇女体力负担的具体方向；4. 关注儿童教育保护与农业劳动力需求的平衡

title: Systematic Risk Embedded in Negative ESG Incidents
affiliations: College of Business, Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST), College of Business, Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST) and

detail.title: Systematic Risk Embedded in Negative ESG Incidents
detail.abstract: We examine whether negative environmental, social and governance (ESG) incidents contribute to systematic downside risk in the equity value of firms. Leveraging data from RepRisk that captures negative ESG incidents at the firm-day level, we show that firms facing such incidents exhibit a significant rise in downside beta. This effect is especially pronounced when incidents are severe and novel. The relationship strengthens after the Paris Agreement and the staggered release of Sustainability Accounting Standards Board (SASB)'s sector-specific disclosure guidance, consistent with growing investor awareness towards ESG. Overall, our findings indicate that ESG contributes to elevated systematic risk and underscore the importance of considering ESG into portfolio construction, valuation frameworks, and disclosure standards particularly when the incidents are more salient.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现负面ESG事件会增加企业的系统性下行风险，这种效应在事件严重和新颖时尤为明显，且在巴黎协定和SASB标准发布后更加显著。
AI.research_question: 负面环境、社会和治理（ESG）事件是否会增加企业股权价值的系统性下行风险？
AI.motivation: 随着ESG投资日益重要，需要了解负面ESG事件如何影响企业的系统性风险，这对投资组合构建、估值框架和披露标准具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于系统性风险理论，探讨ESG事件如何通过投资者意识和市场反应影响企业的下行beta。
AI.method: 使用RepRisk提供的企业日度负面ESG事件数据，分析这些事件与企业下行beta之间的关系，并考察事件严重性、新颖性以及巴黎协定和SASB标准发布的时间效应。
AI.findings: 负面ESG事件显著增加企业的下行beta，这种效应在事件严重和新颖时更强；巴黎协定和SASB标准发布后，这种关系更加明显，表明投资者对ESG问题的意识增强。
AI.theory_contributions: 将ESG因素纳入系统性风险理论框架，揭示了负面ESG事件如何通过投资者意识和市场机制影响企业的系统性下行风险。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资组合管理提供ESG风险考量依据，建议在估值框架和披露标准中充分考虑ESG因素，特别是当负面事件较为突出时。

title: Ethics and Economics

detail.title: Ethics and Economics

contentType.other: Lecture notes for the course "Ethics and Economics" at Charles University.

detail.abstract:
This text is based on the 2025-version of lecture notes for the course “Ethics and Economics”
taught at Charles University in Prague – Faculty of Social Sciences. It links basic topics of moral  and political philosophy with economics in  twelve chapters: Ethics as Practical Philosophy; Justice and Coordination; Utilitarianism and Justice; Economics as Social Science; Neoclassical Synthesis, Post-Keynesian Economics and Justice; Immanuel Kant, Psyche and Conscience; Self-realization; Social Stability, Order and Liberty; Constitutional Economics; Justice and Democracy; Democratic Justice; Ethics, People and Society. In appendices to chapters, different ethically interesting problems are discussed: legalization of drugs, abortion, helping to the poor, migration, the ethics of war and peace, terrorism and torture, same sex marriage and surrogate motherhood, freedom of speech, animals’ ethics, environment, ICT and AI development and codes of ethics.

AI.tldr: 这是一份课程讲义，而非研究论文。内容将道德与政治哲学的基本主题与经济学联系起来，涵盖12个章节，涉及伦理学、正义、经济学理论、康德哲学、自我实现、社会秩序、宪政经济学、民主正义等主题，并在附录中讨论各种伦理问题。
AI.research_question: 这不是一篇研究论文，而是课程讲义，因此没有明确的研究问题。讲义旨在探讨伦理学与经济学之间的交叉领域，分析道德哲学概念如何应用于经济问题。
AI.motivation: 为查尔斯大学社会科学学院"伦理学与经济学"课程提供教学材料，帮助学生理解道德哲学与经济学之间的内在联系，培养学生在经济决策中考虑伦理因素的能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 讲义融合了多种理论框架：1）道德哲学（伦理学作为实践哲学）；2）正义理论（分配正义、民主正义）；3）经济学理论（新古典综合、后凯恩斯经济学）；4）康德哲学（道德心理学与良知）；5）宪政经济学；6）社会政治理论（社会稳定性、秩序与自由）。
AI.method: 作为课程讲义，采用的教学方法包括：章节式主题讲解、理论概念介绍、跨学科连接、案例研究（通过附录中的实际问题讨论），以及理论与实践的结合。
AI.findings: 作为教学材料，没有实证研究结果。讲义的结构安排表明作者认为：1）伦理学与经济学存在深刻联系；2）经济决策需要考虑伦理维度；3）各种伦理理论可以为经济分析提供框架；4）当代社会面临的实际伦理问题需要跨学科分析。
AI.theory_contributions: 作为教学材料，其主要理论贡献在于：1）系统性地将伦理学与经济学领域连接起来；2）提供了跨学科的教学框架；3）展示了不同伦理理论如何应用于经济分析；4）整合了古典与现代的经济学与哲学思想。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为"伦理学与经济学"课程提供了完整的教学材料；2）帮助学生理解经济决策的伦理维度；3）通过附录中的实际问题（毒品合法化、堕胎、贫困、移民、战争伦理、恐怖主义、同性婚姻、代孕、言论自由、动物伦理、环境、ICT与AI发展、职业道德准则）展示了理论的实际应用；4）培养了学生在复杂社会问题中进行伦理经济分析的能力。

title: The Convexity of Liquidity: A High-Frequency Investigation into Market Fragility, Saturation Points, and Regimes of Volatility
affiliations: University of Benin

detail.title: The Convexity of Liquidity: A High-Frequency Investigation into Market Fragility, Saturation Points, and Regimes of Volatility

AI.tldr: 高频交易在平静时期降低交易成本、提高局部效率，但超过临界参与度后会导致系统性脆弱性，表现为流动性真空和尾部风险放大，最终以机械效率牺牲有机韧性。
AI.research_question: 高频交易在现代金融市场中的矛盾作用是什么？特别是，高频交易参与度如何影响市场系统性脆弱性？是否存在一个"饱和点"，超过该点后算法流动性提供的边际效益会转为负凸性？
AI.motivation: 金融市场已从人类中介的"平庸世界"转变为算法主导的"极端世界"。虽然高频交易在平静时期降低交易成本、提高效率，但其对市场系统性稳定性的影响尚不明确，特别是在极端市场条件下的表现需要深入研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 极端世界理论（Extremistan vs Mediocristan）；2) 负凸性边际效益理论；3) 流动性真空理论；4) Taleb启发式（免费退出、无"利益共担"）；5) 机械效率与有机韧性权衡理论
AI.method: 使用细粒度Level 3（L3）ITCH数据，通过已实现波动率的严格分解，建立高频交易参与与系统性脆弱性之间的因果关系，识别临界参与阈值和饱和点。
AI.findings: 1) 存在明确的"饱和点"，超过该点后算法流动性提供的边际效益呈现负凸性（均值有益但尾部灾难性）；2) 高频交易"稳定直到不稳定"，主要在宏观冲击时撤回流动性（流动性真空）；3) 超过临界参与阈值会放大跳跃风险；4) 高频交易具有"免费退出"特性且缺乏"利益共担"，以机械效率为代价牺牲市场有机韧性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 建立了高频交易参与度与市场脆弱性之间的理论框架；2) 提出了算法流动性提供的负凸性边际效益理论；3) 扩展了Taleb启发式在金融市场中的应用；4) 发展了机械效率与有机韧性的权衡理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为投资者提供风险识别工具；2) 为监管者提供市场稳定性监测指标；3) 为市场设计者提出从脆弱玻璃系统向抗脆弱金融架构转型的战略建议；4) 应用于加密货币24/7算法强度和预测市场信息金融（InfoFi）的多部门分析。

title: How to ask for Belief Statistics without Distortion?
affiliations: National University of Singapore (NUS) - Department of Economics, National University of Singapore (NUS) and

detail.title: How to ask for Belief Statistics without Distortion?
detail.abstract: Belief elicitation is ubiquitous in experiments but can distort behavior in the main tasks. We study when, and how, an experimenter can ask for a series of action-dependent belief statistics after a subject chooses an action, while incentivize truthful reports without distorting the subject's optimal action in the main experimental tasks. We first propose a novel mechanism called the Counterfactual Scoring Rule (CSR), which achieves such nondistortionary elicitation of any single belief statistic by decomposing it into supplemental action-independent statistics. In contrast, when eliciting a fixed set of belief statistics without such decomposition, we show that robust nondistortionary elicitation is achievable if and only if the questions satisfy a joint alignment condition with the task payoff. The necessity of joint alignment is established through a graph theoretical approach, while its sufficiency follows from invoking an adaptation of the Becker-DeGroot-Marschak mechanism. Our characterization applies to experiments with general task-payoff structures and belief elicitation questions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何在实验中进行信念诱导而不扭曲主体在主要任务中的行为。作者提出了反事实评分规则（CSR）机制，通过将行动依赖的信念统计量分解为补充的行动独立统计量来实现非扭曲性诱导。研究发现，在没有这种分解的情况下，只有当信念统计量问题与任务收益满足联合对齐条件时，才能实现稳健的非扭曲性诱导。
AI.research_question: 实验者何时以及如何能够在被试选择行动后，询问一系列行动依赖的信念统计量，同时激励真实报告而不扭曲被试在主要实验任务中的最优行动？
AI.motivation: 信念诱导在实验中无处不在，但可能会扭曲主体在主要任务中的行为。现有研究缺乏对如何在诱导信念的同时不干扰主体在主要任务中决策的系统分析。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 反事实评分规则（CSR）机制
2. 联合对齐条件
3. 图论方法
4. Becker-DeGroot-Marschak机制的适应性应用
AI.method: 理论分析框架，结合机制设计理论和图论方法。首先提出CSR机制，然后分析在没有分解的情况下信念统计量诱导的条件，使用图论方法证明联合对齐条件的必要性，并通过Becker-DeGroot-Marschak机制的适应性应用证明其充分性。
AI.findings:
1. CSR机制能够通过将行动依赖的信念统计量分解为补充的行动独立统计量，实现任何单一信念统计量的非扭曲性诱导。
2. 在没有这种分解的情况下，只有当信念统计量问题与任务收益满足联合对齐条件时，才能实现稳健的非扭曲性诱导。
3. 联合对齐条件的必要性通过图论方法建立，充分性通过Becker-DeGroot-Marschak机制的适应性应用证明。
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了反事实评分规则（CSR）这一新的信念诱导机制。
2. 建立了信念诱导问题与任务收益的联合对齐条件理论框架。
3. 将图论方法应用于机制设计分析，提供了新的分析工具。
4. 扩展了Becker-DeGroot-Marschak机制在信念诱导中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为实验经济学家提供了在不扭曲主体行为的情况下进行信念诱导的具体方法。
2. 帮助实验设计者判断何时可以安全地加入信念诱导问题。
3. 提供了CSR机制的实际操作指南，可用于各种实验设置。
4. 为实验设计中的信念诱导提供了理论指导，避免因不当的信念诱导而污染实验结果。

title: Is Causality Necessary for Efficient Portfolios? A Computational Perspective on Predictive Validity and Model Misspecification
affiliations: University of Reading

detail.title: Is Causality Necessary for Efficient Portfolios? A Computational Perspective on Predictive Validity and Model Misspecification
detail.abstract: Portfolio optimization is increasingly argued to require causally identified return predictors to avoid signal inversion and optimization failure. This paper reexamines this claim by studying when predictive signals yield viable efficient frontiers, even under structural misspecification. We show that causal identification is not necessary for portfolio efficiency within static mean-variance and closely related quadratic portfolio optimization frameworks. Instead, efficiency is governed by geometric sufficiency conditions on predictive signals: directional alignment, ranking preservation, and calibration. We formally decompose portfolio efficiency into these three components and show that miscalibration alone attenuates Sharpe ratios even when alignment and ranking are preserved. Robustness is characterized as smooth degradation rather than collapse, with explicit attenuation behavior and continuity of performance under increasing misspecification. The theoretical results are supported by simulations and empirical analysis. Empirical validation combines equity-based illustrations with a large global bond universe spanning multiple currencies, countries, sectors, maturities along the term structure, seniority classes, and credit ratings, together with high-dimensional stress tests, nonlinear data-generating processes, rolling-window analyses, covariance regularization, realistic portfolio constraints, and bootstrap-based statistical validation. Across these settings, optimization geometry remains well behaved whenever directional alignment is preserved. The results clarify the boundary between causality and portfolio optimization: causality may inform signal representation, but portfolio efficiency at the optimization stage is a geometric property conditional on a given representation.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了投资组合优化是否需要因果识别预测因子的主张。研究表明，在静态均值-方差框架下，因果识别并非投资组合效率的必要条件，而是由预测信号的几何充分条件（方向对齐、排序保持和校准）决定。投资组合效率可分解为这三个组成部分，其中校准误差会降低夏普比率。研究通过模拟和实证分析验证了理论结果。
AI.research_question: 投资组合优化是否必须依赖因果识别的预测信号才能避免信号反转和优化失败？在什么条件下，即使存在结构误设，预测信号仍能产生可行的有效前沿？
AI.motivation: 当前投资组合优化领域普遍认为需要因果识别的预测因子来避免信号反转和优化失败。本文旨在重新审视这一主张，研究在结构误设情况下预测信号仍能产生有效投资组合的条件。
AI.theoretical_framework: 静态均值-方差投资组合优化框架及相关二次优化框架；投资组合效率的几何充分条件理论（方向对齐、排序保持和校准）；信号分解理论；稳健性分析理论。
AI.method: 理论推导与证明；模拟分析；实证分析（包括股票和全球债券市场的多维度数据，涵盖多种货币、国家、行业、期限结构、优先级类别和信用评级）；高维压力测试；非线性数据生成过程；滚动窗口分析；协方差正则化；现实投资组合约束；基于bootstrap的统计验证。
AI.findings: 1. 因果识别并非投资组合效率的必要条件；2. 投资组合效率由预测信号的三个几何充分条件决定：方向对齐、排序保持和校准；3. 投资组合效率可分解为这三个组成部分；4. 仅校准误差就会降低夏普比率，即使方向和排序保持良好；5. 稳健性表现为平滑退化而非崩溃，具有明确的衰减行为和连续性；6. 只要方向对齐保持，优化几何就表现良好。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 明确了因果识别与投资组合优化之间的边界：因果关系可能影响信号表示，但优化阶段的投资组合效率是给定表示下的几何属性；2. 提出了投资组合效率的几何充分条件理论；3. 发展了投资组合效率的三分量分解理论；4. 建立了结构误设下投资组合性能的稳健性理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资组合经理提供了更实用的优化框架，无需完全依赖因果识别；2. 提供了评估预测信号质量的几何标准；3. 展示了在现实约束下投资组合优化的稳健性；4. 为全球债券投资组合优化提供了实证验证；5. 提供了处理高维数据和结构误设的实用方法。

title: Collaborative Governance and Ethno-Tourism Development in a Multicultural City: The Case of Makassar, Indonesia
affiliations: Universitas Negeri Makassar, Universitas Negeri Makassar, UNM and

detail.title: Collaborative Governance and Ethno-Tourism Development in a Multicultural City: The Case of Makassar, Indonesia
detail.abstract: Background The development of ethnotourism in Makassar City has considerable potential; however, its management practices remain largely partial and have not yet been optimally integrated. This condition is indicated by weak synergy among actors, insufficient promotion grounded in local identity, and limited supporting infrastructure within cultural areas. Therefore, a collaborative governance approach is needed to integrate the interests of government, cultural communities, business actors, and academics into a unified policy direction and collective action. Objectives This study aims to: (1) describe the implementation of collaborative governance in ethnotourism development in Makassar City; and (2) identify the supporting and inhibiting factors affecting such collaboration. Methods The research employs a descriptive qualitative approach. Data were collected through in-depth interviews, participant observation, and documentation review. Data analysis followed the interactive model of Miles, Huberman, and Saldaña, comprising data collection, data reduction, data display, and cyclical conclusion drawing/verification. Results The findings show that collaboration occurs through both formal and informal mechanisms, such as MoUs/cooperation agreements, FGDs, cultural forums, community deliberations, and interethnic dialogues; this pattern strengthens cross-stakeholder coordination. Key supporting factors include cultural richness and diversity, interethnic social tolerance, strong community cohesion, supportive government policies, and growing tourist interest in cultural tourism and authentic experiences. Inhibiting factors include limited budgets, uneven human resource capacity, differing understandings of the ethnotourism concept, dependence on external support, and community concerns regarding the negative impacts of tourism. Conclusion Collaborative-based ethnotourism development generates multidimensional positive impacts, particularly in strengthening cultural identity and appreciation, improving the local/creative economy, and maintaining social tolerance and harmony in Makassar City. Overall, collaborative governance is considered appropriate and relevant; however, its effectiveness should be reinforced through institutional strengthening, capacity building among actors, and sustained commitment across stakeholders.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了望加锡市民族旅游发展中协作治理的实施情况，发现通过正式和非正式机制的合作能加强跨利益相关者协调，但面临预算有限、人力资源不均等挑战。
AI.research_question: (1) 望加锡市民族旅游发展中协作治理的实施情况如何？(2) 影响这种协作的支持和抑制因素有哪些？
AI.motivation: 望加锡市民族旅游发展潜力巨大，但管理实践零散且未充分整合，表现为利益相关者协同薄弱、基于地方身份的推广不足、文化区域支持基础设施有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 协作治理理论，强调政府、文化社区、商业参与者和学术界等多方利益相关者的整合与协同。
AI.method: 描述性定性研究方法，通过深度访谈、参与观察和文献回顾收集数据，采用Miles、Huberman和Saldaña的互动模型进行数据分析（数据收集、数据简化、数据展示、循环结论推导/验证）。
AI.findings: 协作通过正式和非正式机制（如谅解备忘录/合作协议、焦点小组讨论、文化论坛、社区审议、跨民族对话）实现，加强了跨利益相关者协调。支持因素包括文化丰富性和多样性、跨民族社会包容性、强大的社区凝聚力、支持性政府政策、游客对文化旅游和真实体验的兴趣增长。抑制因素包括预算有限、人力资源能力不均、对民族旅游概念理解不同、对外部支持的依赖、社区对旅游负面影响的担忧。
AI.theory_contributions: 为协作治理理论在民族旅游发展领域的应用提供了实证支持，展示了正式与非正式协作机制在文化旅游管理中的互补作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为望加锡市民族旅游发展提供了具体的政策建议：加强制度建设、提升参与者能力建设、维持利益相关者持续承诺，以实现文化认同强化、地方/创意经济发展、社会包容与和谐等多维积极影响。

title: Can Randomized Controlled Trials be a Discovery Process?

detail.title: Can Randomized Controlled Trials be a Discovery Process?
detail.abstract: Trends in development economics have led randomized controlled trials to be a popular method for investigating a variety of questions in developing economies. This chapter weighs significant arguments that RCTs are one of the best tools for program evaluation against criticisms of their internal and external validity. To resolve these debates, it then turns to discuss the implicit political economy of the process described by the 2019 Nobel Prize winners. Finally, to satisfy these and other institutional prerequisites for experimentation in a developing society to be productive, it argues that embedding RCTs and other forms of experimentation in a civil society is more likely to produce improvements in human wellbeing than embedding RCTs in a developmental state.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了随机对照试验在发展经济学中的应用，权衡了其作为项目评估最佳工具的优势与内外效度批评，并基于2019年诺贝尔奖得主描述的过程，提出将RCT嵌入公民社会比嵌入发展型国家更能促进人类福祉改善。
AI.research_question: 随机对照试验在发展经济学项目评估中的有效性如何？将RCT嵌入公民社会还是发展型国家更能促进人类福祉改善？
AI.motivation: 随机对照试验在发展经济学中日益流行，但对其内部和外部效度存在争议，需要探讨如何使实验方法在发展中社会更有效地促进人类福祉。
AI.theoretical_framework: 发展经济学理论、项目评估理论、随机对照试验方法论、政治经济学理论、公民社会理论、发展型国家理论
AI.method: 文献综述与理论分析，基于2019年诺贝尔经济学奖得主的工作，对RCT的优缺点进行系统性评估，并提出制度嵌入框架
AI.findings: RCT虽然是有效的项目评估工具，但其成功应用需要满足特定的制度前提；将RCT嵌入公民社会比嵌入发展型国家更可能产生积极的人类福祉改善效果
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 系统梳理了RCT在发展经济学中的优势与局限性辩论；2) 提出了RCT应用的政治经济学分析框架；3) 建立了实验方法制度嵌入的理论模型，区分公民社会与发展型国家两种路径
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为发展实践者提供了RCT应用的指导原则；2) 建议将实验方法融入公民社会结构而非单纯依赖国家主导；3) 为国际发展机构设计评估方案提供了制度考量框架

title: The Retirement Spending Smile Revisited: Cross-Sectional Patterns versus Within-Household Dynamics
affiliations: University of Southern Maine

detail.title: The Retirement Spending Smile Revisited: Cross-Sectional Patterns versus Within-Household Dynamics
detail.abstract: The "retirement spending smile" (Blanchett, 2014), a U-shaped pattern in the rate of retiree spending change, has shaped how advisors and retirees think about spending in retirement. We replicate Blanchett's analysis using RAND HRS/CAMS data (2001-2009) and extend it with panel econometric methods through 2021. Our central finding: the smile pattern appears when comparing different households at different ages, but is not statistically detectable when tracking the same households over time. This divergence may reflect cohort composition, period effects, survivorship, or other factors rather than individual-level dynamics, though the data do not permit a clean causal decomposition. In our replication, coefficient signs match Blanchett's specification, but 95% bootstrap confidence intervals for Age² and Age include zero – meaning the evidence for the smile's curvature is not statistically distinguishable from a simple linear decline. We also document that the ln(Spending) coefficient sign depends on whether spending is measured at interval start or end, an implementation choice not specified in the original. The central finding (smile attenuation in within-household analysis) is robust to survey weighting. For individual client projections, a constant real decline (~1%, with sensitivity around 0-2% annually) is a more defensible baseline than assuming a smile pattern.

AI.tldr: 该研究复制并扩展了Blanchett(2014)的"退休消费微笑曲线"分析，发现微笑模式在跨家庭比较时存在，但在追踪同一家庭随时间变化时统计上不显著，建议使用恒定实际下降率而非微笑模式作为退休规划基准。
AI.research_question: "退休消费微笑曲线"模式是否在追踪同一家庭随时间变化时仍然存在？跨家庭比较与家庭内追踪分析的结果是否一致？
AI.motivation: Blanchett(2014)提出的"退休消费微笑曲线"（U型退休消费变化模式）深刻影响了理财顾问和退休者对退休消费的认知，但该发现主要基于跨家庭比较，需要验证其在追踪同一家庭随时间变化时是否仍然成立。
AI.theoretical_framework: 退休消费理论、生命周期假说、面板数据分析方法、跨家庭比较与家庭内追踪分析的差异理论。
AI.method: 使用RAND HRS/CAMS数据(2001-2021)，复制Blanchett的分析方法，并扩展使用面板计量经济学方法进行家庭内追踪分析，采用自助法计算置信区间，检验统计显著性。
AI.findings: 1. 微笑模式在跨家庭比较时出现，但在追踪同一家庭随时间变化时统计上不显著；2. 年龄平方项和年龄项的95%自助置信区间包含零，微笑曲线的曲率统计上与简单线性下降无显著差异；3. ln(消费)系数符号取决于测量时点选择；4. 主要发现在考虑调查权重后依然稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了"退休消费微笑曲线"可能更多反映队列组成、时期效应、生存偏差等因素，而非个体层面的动态变化；2. 区分了跨家庭比较与家庭内追踪分析的不同结果；3. 对退休消费模式的理论理解提供了更精细的实证基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为理财顾问提供更稳健的退休规划基准：建议使用恒定实际下降率（约1%，敏感性范围0-2%）而非微笑模式；2. 指出了原始研究中未明确的实施选择对结果的影响；3. 提供了更可靠的退休消费预测方法。

title: Toggling the Defiers to Relax Monotonicity: The Difference-in-Instrumental-Variables Estimand
affiliations: Hiroshima University

detail.title: Toggling the Defiers to Relax Monotonicity: The Difference-in-Instrumental-Variables Estimand
detail.abstract: Standard instrumental variables (IV) methods identify a Local Average Treatment Effect under monotonicity, which rules out defiers. In many empirical environments, however, distinct instruments may induce heterogeneous and even opposing behavioral responses. This paper introduces the Difference-in-Instrumental-Variables (DIIV) estimand, which exploits two instruments with opposing compliance patterns to recover a point-identified and behaviorally interpretable causal effect without imposing monotonicity. The estimand yields a convex combination of the marginal treatment effects on compliers and defiers, with weights reflecting differential shifts in treatment take-up across instruments. When monotonicity holds, DIIV coincides with the standard IV estimand. The approach can be implemented using simple linear transformations and standard two-stage least squares procedures. Applications using replication data illustrate its applicability in practice.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了差异工具变量(DIIV)估计量，利用两个具有相反服从模式的工具变量，在不施加单调性假设的情况下恢复点识别且行为可解释的因果效应。
AI.research_question: 如何在存在违抗者(defiers)的情况下，利用多个工具变量识别因果效应，而不依赖单调性假设？
AI.motivation: 传统工具变量方法依赖单调性假设(排除违抗者)，但在许多实证环境中，不同的工具变量可能引发异质甚至相反的行为反应，需要新的识别方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 工具变量理论、局部平均处理效应(LATE)、单调性假设、边际处理效应(MTE)、异质性处理效应。
AI.method: 提出差异工具变量(DIIV)估计量，利用两个具有相反服从模式的工具变量，通过简单的线性变换和标准两阶段最小二乘法实现。
AI.findings: DIIV估计量可以识别违抗者和服从者的边际处理效应的凸组合，权重反映不同工具变量对治疗采纳的差异影响；当单调性成立时，DIIV与标准IV估计量一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 放宽单调性假设，允许违抗者存在；2) 提供点识别且行为可解释的因果效应；3) 建立多工具变量下的统一识别框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供简单易行的实证实施方法；2) 适用于多种实证环境；3) 通过复制数据展示了实际应用可行性。

title: Artificial Intelligence and College Major Choice
affiliations: and The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence and College Major Choice
detail.abstract: This paper studies how the diffusion of artificial intelligence technology reshapes human capital investment. Using online job postings data from Lightcast along with American Community Survey data, we construct a measure of local AI labor demand shocks based on shift-share instruments. Higher AI demand reallocates the field-ofdegree composition of young college graduates toward AI intensive majors, such as computer science and engineering, and away from education and humanities, while there is no significant effect on overall college enrollment or college premium. Moreover, AI demand raises local income, with gains concentrated in higher-income areas, suggesting that AI can widen geographic disparities.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨人工智能技术扩散如何重塑人力资本投资。使用在线招聘数据和美国社区调查数据，基于转移份额工具构建地方AI劳动力需求冲击指标。研究发现，更高的AI需求使年轻大学毕业生的专业选择从教育和人文学科转向AI密集型专业（如计算机科学和工程），但对总体大学入学率或大学溢价无显著影响。此外，AI需求提高地方收入，但收益集中在高收入地区，表明AI可能加剧地理不平等。
AI.research_question: 人工智能技术扩散如何影响人力资本投资（特别是大学专业选择）？AI需求冲击对地方收入分配和地理不平等有何影响？
AI.motivation: 随着人工智能技术的快速扩散，理解其对人力资本投资的影响至关重要。AI可能改变劳动力市场需求结构，影响个人的教育选择和专业决策，进而影响收入分配和地区发展差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人力资本投资理论，结合技术扩散对劳动力市场影响的经济学框架。使用转移份额工具（shift-share instruments）方法识别AI需求冲击的因果效应。
AI.method: 使用Lightcast在线招聘数据和美国社区调查数据，构建地方AI劳动力需求冲击指标。采用转移份额工具变量方法进行因果推断，分析AI需求对大学专业选择、入学率和收入的影响。
AI.findings:
1. 更高的AI需求使年轻大学毕业生的专业选择从教育和人文学科转向AI密集型专业（计算机科学、工程）
2. 对总体大学入学率或大学溢价无显著影响
3. AI需求提高地方收入，但收益集中在高收入地区，可能加剧地理不平等
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 为AI技术扩散如何影响人力资本投资提供了实证证据
2. 揭示了AI对专业选择的重塑作用
3. 拓展了技术变革与收入分配不平等的理论研究
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为教育政策制定者提供参考，帮助调整专业设置
2. 为个人职业规划提供指导
3. 为区域发展政策提供依据，应对AI可能加剧的地理不平等

title: A Structural VAR (SVAR) based Approach to Calculating the Marginal Propensity to Consume (MPC) across Income Groups
affiliations: , The Central Bank of Bangladesh

detail.title: A Structural VAR (SVAR) based Approach to Calculating the Marginal Propensity to Consume (MPC) across Income Groups
detail.abstract: Here we have devised a new structural VAR (SVAR) based approach to measuring marginal propensity to consume (MPC) of households from different income groups. To be precise, we build structural VAR model with group-wise income and expenditure data of US households and perform impulse response analysis on the model to estimate the MPC of different income groups. Our analysis suggests that MPC values of US households belonging to bottom [0-20]%, [20-40]%, [40-60]%, [60-80]% and [80-100]% income group are 0.95, 0..81, 0.74, 0.71 and 0.35 respectively, which nicely converges with the existing theory of MPC that says, low income households have higher MPCs. Alongside conventional approaches of measuring MPCs, which involve OLS regression, instrumental variable, randomized control trial, natural experiment, variance decomposition etc., here we have developed a new methodology of measuring MPCs, which relies on standardized secondary data and provides reliable estimates of MPCs that nicely resembles to the existing theory.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种基于结构VAR的新方法来测量不同收入阶层的边际消费倾向，发现低收入家庭的MPC更高，与现有理论一致。
AI.research_question: 如何准确测量不同收入阶层美国家庭的边际消费倾向？
AI.motivation: 现有MPC测量方法（OLS回归、工具变量、随机对照试验、自然实验、方差分解等）存在局限性，需要开发基于标准化二手数据的新方法来提供可靠估计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 边际消费倾向理论（低收入家庭MPC更高）、结构VAR模型理论、脉冲响应分析理论
AI.method: 构建包含分组收入和支出数据的结构VAR模型，进行脉冲响应分析来估计不同收入阶层的MPC
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 开发了基于结构VAR的MPC测量新方法；2. 验证了边际消费倾向理论的正确性；3. 为收入-消费关系研究提供了新的计量框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供不同收入阶层消费行为的可靠估计；2. 使用标准化二手数据降低了研究成本；3. 方法可推广到其他国家或地区的研究

title: A New SMP Transformed Standard Weibull Distribution for Health Data Modelling
affiliations: The University of Manchester, University of Louisiana at Lafayette and Nova Southeastern University

detail.title: A New SMP Transformed Standard Weibull Distribution for Health Data Modelling
detail.abstract: New methods of extending base distributions are always invoke to increase their adaptability in modeling real life data. Recently, SMP method was introduced but Weibull distribution is yet to be explored through this method. First, we provide updated review on SMP transformed distributions. We then proposed and developed another extended Weibull distribution through this technique named SMPtW. Importantly, twelve of its statistical properties - reliability measures, quantile function, moment, stress-strength, mean waiting time, moment generating function, characteristics function, renyi entropy, order statistics, mean residual life and mode, were derived and studied extensively. The hazard function has a decreasing, increasing and constant shapes. We found a relation between the quantile of SMPtW and that of SMP Pareto distribution despite their difference in density functions. We adopt the inverse transform approach in random number generation and through simulation we evaluate maximum likelihood estimates (MLE) performance of its parameters. The result showed that MLE is consistent all through. The performance of the distribution was then examined using health dataset compared with five similar distributions. The results showed that three parameters SMPtW performed best among the competing models.

AI.tldr: 本文通过SMP方法扩展了Weibull分布，提出了SMPtW分布，推导了其12个统计特性，并通过模拟和实际健康数据验证了该分布的优越性能。
AI.research_question: 如何通过SMP方法扩展Weibull分布？SMPtW分布具有哪些统计特性？在实际应用中其性能如何？
AI.motivation: 现有SMP方法尚未应用于Weibull分布，而Weibull分布在可靠性工程和生存分析中广泛应用，需要新的扩展方法来提高其对现实数据的建模适应性。
AI.theoretical_framework: SMP（Symmetric Multiplicative Pareto）变换方法；Weibull分布理论；可靠性理论；统计分布理论
AI.method: 1. 理论推导SMPtW分布的12个统计特性；2. 采用逆变换方法进行随机数生成；3. 通过模拟评估参数的最大似然估计性能；4. 使用健康数据集与5个类似分布进行性能比较

title: The Equity-Backed Dollar: A Rule-Based Monetary System Anchored to Corporate Equity
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Equity-Backed Dollar: A Rule-Based Monetary System Anchored to Corporate Equity

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No one
declarations.ethicsApproval: This is a design paper with no studies
declarations.funderStatement: Personal funding

detail.abstract: This paper proposes a monetary system in which the US dollar is defined as a fractional claim on the aggregate equity of the 500 largest publicly traded US companies by market capitalization, with the fraction decreasing at a legislatively fixed annual rate. Building on Demyanov (2021), which introduced index-linked central bank rates and chain indexation of the economy, the system takes this logic to its conclusion by defining the currency itself as a fraction of the index, eliminating discretionary money creation entirely. The money supply grows through two channels distinguished by their inflationary properties: compositional turnover in the index, which is compensatory and non-inflationary, and the legislatively mandated decrease in the dollar’s equity fraction, which is the system’s sole source of inflation. Government revenue derives from three parallel wealth taxes—mandatory equity dilution on all business entities, the fractional decrease (the inflation tax), and a federal property tax on real property. The three taxes are set at a uniform rate, a design constraint that prevents wealth migration between asset classes and that is absent from prior wealth tax proposals. The equity dilution mechanism avoids the valuation, liquidity, and unrealized-gains problems that have historically blocked wealth tax implementation: public companies simply issue new shares, the market provides continuous pricing, and no entity is forced to sell assets or generate cash. The definitional identity between the monetary base and the index’s total market capitalization produces structural properties absent from both fiat and prior asset-backed monetary systems: the aggregate index cannot decline in its own unit, the government’s primary revenue streams are recession-proof by mathematical identity rather than empirical approximation, and the sovereign debt crisis mechanism is largely eliminated. We analyze the system’s behavior under normal economic conditions, overheating, recession, and financial crisis.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种新的货币体系，将美元定义为按立法固定年率递减的500家最大美国上市公司总股权的分数权益。该系统消除了自由裁量的货币创造，货币供应通过指数成分股变动（非通胀性）和美元股权分数递减（唯一通胀来源）两种渠道增长。政府收入来自三种平行的财富税，税率统一以防止财富在资产类别间迁移。股权稀释机制避免了传统财富税的实施障碍。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种基于股票指数的货币体系，既能消除自由裁量的货币创造，又能通过统一的财富税机制为政府提供稳定收入，同时避免传统财富税的实施障碍？
AI.motivation: 现有货币体系存在自由裁量货币创造、通胀控制不精确、财富税实施困难（估值、流动性、未实现收益问题）以及政府收入在经济衰退时不稳定等问题。需要一种更稳定、自动化的货币和财政体系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Demyanov (2021)的指数挂钩央行利率和链式指数化经济理论，将货币定义为股票指数的分数权益。结合现代货币理论、财富税理论和资产支持货币理论，构建统一的货币-财政框架。
AI.method: 理论建模和情景分析。通过构建基于S&P 500指数的货币体系模型，分析其在正常经济条件、经济过热、衰退和金融危机四种情景下的行为特征和稳定性。
AI.findings: 1) 货币供应增长分为指数成分股变动（非通胀性）和股权分数递减（唯一通胀来源）两种渠道；2) 三种统一税率的财富税避免了财富迁移；3) 股权稀释机制解决了传统财富税的估值、流动性和未实现收益问题；4) 货币基础与指数总市值之间的定义性关系产生了结构性稳定特征。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了基于股票指数的货币定义新范式；2) 发展了统一的货币-财政理论框架；3) 解决了财富税实施的理论障碍；4) 建立了结构性抗衰退的政府收入机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供了消除自由裁量货币创造的可行方案；2) 设计了避免财富迁移的统一财富税体系；3) 提供了解决传统财富税实施难题的技术方案；4) 建立了在经济周期中更稳定的货币财政体系。

title: IP and Music: Harnessing Nigeria's Music Industry for Economic Growth

detail.title: IP and Music: Harnessing Nigeria's Music Industry for Economic Growth
detail.abstract:
The economic power of music is more than art—it is big business.
Nowhere is this statement truer than in Nigeria, where music has become one of the country’s most valuable exports. A 2025 Spotify report reveals that Nigeria’s music exports grew by 49 percent over the past three years due to the Afrobeats boom. Additionally, recent report indicates that royalties generated by Nigerian artists on Spotify alone exceeded 58 billion naira in 2024. Likewise, a 2024 report by Statista indicates that music recording as well as motion picture accounted for roughly 154 billion naira of Nigeria's GDP in 2023. In the same vein, Nigerian artists like Rema, who broke Spotify streaming records with the remix of his song “Calm Down,” and Tems, who have won two Grammy awards, are breaking barriers and redefining the importance of Afrobeat on the global stage. 

However, behind the glitz and glamour lies a cancerous tumor that has spread across the Nigerian music industry: intellectual property infringement. The labours of music creators are being exploited, thereby depriving artists of their rights and consequently undermining fundamental financial growth and development in the industry. Against this backdrop, this essay examines how IP can help in transforming Nigeria’s music industry into a reliable driver of sustainable economic growth.

title: Statistical Analysis of Climate Change Impact on Macroeconomic Variables in Ghana
affiliations: University of Ghana - University of Ghana, University of Ghana, University of Ghana and University of Ghana

detail.title: Statistical Analysis of Climate Change Impact on Macroeconomic Variables in Ghana
detail.abstract: Climate change presents a cosmopolitan challenge with far-reaching macroeconomic implications, demanding immediate action. Thus, this study sought to offer a statistical analysis exploring the macroeconomic effects of climate change in Ghana using monthly observations from 2000 to 2023. By utilizing Canonical Correlation Analysis (CCA), the study examined the statistical relationship between climate variables (represented by Global CO2 levels, temperature, rainfall, and humidity obtained from GMet’s 22 monitored synopsis stations) and key macroeconomic indicators (including economic growth rates, inflation rates, real effective exchange rates, and interest rates). The short-run and long-term impacts of climate change on these economic variables were assessed by applying Vector Autoregression (VAR). The observed pattern among the examined economic and climate metrics suggests a symbiotic influence, where fluctuations in these variables have interconnected impacts. Notably, the VAR analysis results disclosed that a 1% increase in relative humidity in Ada and a unit rise in temperature across Abetifi, Bole, Kumasi, and Tema weather stations are associated with adverse effects on certain macroeconomic indicators, particularly immediate and long-term interest rates and inflation rates, albeit with some degree of uncertainty. The study advises that strengthening Ghana’s economic resilience to climate change requires targeted investments in climate-smart agriculture and infrastructure, particularly in vulnerable communities. Prioritizing smallholder farmers through adaptation financing and insurance is critical. Integrating climate risk into monetary and fiscal policy, alongside improved data systems and research, will support responsive and inclusive planning.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用典型相关分析和向量自回归模型，分析了2000-2023年加纳气候变量与宏观经济指标之间的统计关系，发现湿度和温度变化对利率和通胀有负面影响，建议加强气候智能农业投资和气候风险管理。
AI.research_question: 气候变化对加纳宏观经济指标（经济增长率、通胀率、实际有效汇率、利率）有何短期和长期影响？

AI.theoretical_framework: 基于气候变化经济学理论，探讨气候变量（CO2水平、温度、降雨、湿度）与宏观经济指标之间的统计关系，采用典型相关分析（CCA）和向量自回归（VAR）模型框架。
AI.method: 使用2000-2023年月度数据，采用典型相关分析（CCA）检验气候变量与宏观经济指标之间的统计关系，应用向量自回归（VAR）模型评估短期和长期影响。气候数据来自加纳气象局22个监测站，经济指标包括经济增长率、通胀率、实际有效汇率和利率。
AI.findings: 1. 气候变量与经济指标之间存在相互影响的共生关系；2. Ada地区相对湿度增加1%对宏观经济指标有负面影响；3. Abetifi、Bole、Kumasi和Tema气象站的温度上升对利率和通胀率产生不利影响，但存在一定不确定性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为发展中国家气候变化宏观经济影响研究提供了实证证据；2. 验证了气候变量与宏观经济指标之间的统计关联；3. 扩展了典型相关分析和VAR模型在气候经济学中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 建议加强气候智能农业和基础设施投资；2. 优先为小农户提供适应融资和保险；3. 将气候风险纳入货币和财政政策；4. 改进数据系统和研究支持包容性规划。

declarations.funderStatement: This essay has been written by an independent candidate without external funding.

detail.abstract: This essay argues that peatland restoration in Ireland should be guided by post-development practices to prevent the further exploitation of people, nature, and culture. While peatlands account for only 3% of the Earth’s surface, they store approximately one-quarter of global soil carbon, making them vital ecosystems for climate regulation. By applying Arturo Escobar’s post-development theory, originally rooted in Latin American discourse, this paper critiques the Western linear model of modernisation and its "productivist" understanding of progress. The analysis examines Ireland’s ambiguous position as both a highly advanced Western state and the first colony of the British Empire, with indigenous Celtic roots.

title: Food Fortification in The EU And Some of Its Member States
affiliations: European Institute for Food Law, University of Pavia, ,  and

detail.title: Food Fortification in The EU And Some of Its Member States

declarations.funderStatement: Gates Foundation

detail.abstract: This paper provides an overview of the law on the addition of vitamins and minerals to foods (‘fortification’) in the EU and three of its Member States: Denmark, Finland and the Netherlands.EU food law starts from the assumption that a normal varied diet provides all the micronutrients that a consumer needs. The addition of vitamins or minerals to the diet would rarely be needed. Mandatory fortification is absent in EU law and rare in the law of the Member States. Regulation (EC) 1925/2006 on the addition of vitamins and minerals and of certain other substances to foods, therefore, is mostly relevant voor voluntary fortification. Topics are addressed such as purposes of fortification, the nature and quantity of micronutrients added, and foods excluded for use as vehicles for fortification. Other topics of interest addressed in this paper are nutrition declaration and claims. Regulatory oversight is based on pre-approval in Denmark, notification in Finland and exemptions from a prohibition to fortify in the Netherlands.

AI.tldr: 本文概述了欧盟及其三个成员国（丹麦、芬兰、荷兰）关于食品中添加维生素和矿物质（强化）的法律规定。欧盟食品法基于正常多样化饮食可提供消费者所需所有微量营养素的假设，认为很少需要额外添加。强制性强化在欧盟法律中不存在，在成员国法律中也罕见。因此，欧盟法规1925/2006主要针对自愿性强化，涉及强化目的、添加的微量营养素性质和数量、不能作为强化载体的食品等主题。监管方式包括丹麦的事前批准、芬兰的通知制度以及荷兰的禁止强化豁免。
AI.research_question: 欧盟及其成员国（丹麦、芬兰、荷兰）关于食品维生素和矿物质强化的法律框架是什么？这些法律如何规范强化的目的、方法、监管和声明要求？

AI.method: 法律文件分析、比较法研究、案例研究（丹麦、芬兰、荷兰三个成员国）、文献综述

title: When Stability Becomes Fragility: How Modern Banking Design Converts Safety Mechanisms into Systemic Risk Author

detail.title: When Stability Becomes Fragility: How Modern Banking Design Converts Safety Mechanisms into Systemic Risk Author

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declare no personal, financial, or professional conflicts of interest that could be perceived to have influenced the analysis or conclusions of this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based on conceptual, analytical, and publicly available resources. It does not involve human participants, personal data, confidential information, or experimental interventions. As such, formal ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract:
Modern banking systems are constructed around an explicit objective of stability. Capital buffers, liquidity requirements, governance frameworks, supervisory oversight, and increasingly sophisticated technological controls are intended to reduce risk and prevent systemic failure. Yet despite repeated reform cycles, banking crises and near-crises continue to recur with notable regularity. This persistence raises a fundamental question: how do stability-oriented designs themselves become sources of fragility?

This paper examines banking stability not as a static condition, but as a dynamic outcome shaped by institutional design choices and system interactions over time. Using a conceptual and system-level analytical approach, it explores how governance architectures, incentive structures, and digital infrastructures interact to transform protective mechanisms into amplifiers of systemic risk. Rather than focusing on individual institutions or discrete regulatory failures, the analysis emphasises structural feedback loops that emerge across complex financial systems.

title: Friction and Fragility: A Physicalist Theory of Value Continuity A Proposed ETS-RFS Synthesis for Economic Engineering

declarations.declarationOfInterest: none
declarations.ethicsApproval: none
declarations.funderStatement: none

detail.abstract: For over two centuries, economic thought has been centered on the concept of "Utility." We have built global empires on the understanding of human psychology, assuming that value is a subjective feeling pursued in a world of scarcity. This paper explores the possibility that we might benefit from a different map-one grounded in physical reality. Value may not only be a psychological whim; it can be viewed as a physical struggle. Every economic system in history-from the grain ledgers of Babylon to the high-frequency trading of Wall Street-can be seen as a purposebuilt engine designed to navigate the laws of physics. Specifically, we address Friction. Prosperity, in this view, is not just about having "more." It is about Value Continuity: the ability to preserve the surplus we create and move it across the three irreducible walls of reality: Exchange, Time, and Space (ETS). By seeking to minimize these frictions, we may unlock the true potential of the human species.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个革命性观点：价值不仅是主观心理感受，更是一种物理斗争。经济系统可视为应对物理定律（特别是摩擦）的引擎，繁荣的关键在于实现"价值连续性"——跨越交换、时间和空间三大现实壁垒。
AI.research_question: 价值是否可以从纯粹的心理学概念转变为基于物理现实的概念？经济系统如何作为应对物理摩擦（交换、时间、空间）的引擎运作？
AI.motivation: 传统经济学基于"效用"这一主观心理学概念已主导两个世纪，但可能忽略了物理现实的基础。作者认为需要基于物理现实的新"地图"来理解经济系统。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 价值连续性理论：价值跨越交换、时间、空间三大现实壁垒的能力；2. 物理摩擦理论：经济系统作为应对物理摩擦的引擎；3. 价值物理观：价值不仅是心理感受，更是物理斗争。
AI.method: 概念性分析框架，通过历史案例（从巴比伦谷物账簿到华尔街高频交易）展示经济系统如何作为应对物理摩擦的引擎。
AI.findings: 所有历史经济系统都可视为专门设计的引擎，旨在应对物理定律，特别是摩擦。繁荣不是简单的"更多"，而是实现价值连续性——跨越交换、时间和空间三大壁垒。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出价值物理观，挑战传统效用理论；2. 建立价值连续性理论框架；3. 将经济系统重新概念化为应对物理摩擦的引擎。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为经济系统设计提供新视角：专注于最小化交换、时间、空间摩擦；2. 为政策制定者提供实现价值连续性的框架；3. 为企业创造更高效的价值保存和转移机制。

title: Friction and Fragility: A Constrained Theory of Economic Value
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Friction and Fragility: A Constrained Theory of Economic Value

declarations.declarationOfInterest: none
declarations.ethicsApproval: none
declarations.funderStatement: none

detail.abstract: The prevailing pursuit of economic success is often simplified to maximizing Gross Domestic Product (GDP) growth. This unidimensional focus, while powerful in measuring aggregate activity, has proven fundamentally inadequate. [5] It systematically fails to capture the essential components of true human well-being and resilient prosperity, specifically neglecting the importance of structural stability (R), institutional fairness (F), or technological capability (S). [2] The global financial crisis of 2008, the subsequent rise of systemic inequality, and the persistent vulnerabilities exposed by global health crises have demonstrated unequivocally that traditional economic models lack the diagnostic depth required for resilient prosperity. [3] Prosperity without resilience is merely volatility waiting to happen. [1] This book posits that a fundamental re-conceptualization of economic activity is required, one that shifts the focus from purely psychological motives (utility maximization) to the physical and informational frictions that govern the transfer and preservation of value. We introduce the ETS-RFS Synthesis, a master conceptual framework that redefines economic theory on transdisciplinary grounds. At its foundation, the Exchange, Time, Space (ETS) Constraints Theory asserts that all economic institutions and technologies are purpose-built systems designed to manage three irreducible constraints: Exchange (E), Time (T), and Space (S). [3, 2] The longterm, ethical goal of economic policy is then framed by the Real Free Sophisticated (RFS) Framework, which provides a tripartite, measurable diagnostic for achieving a balanced state of resilient well-being. [2] Crucially, this synthesis explores the dangerous shadow of relentless optimization: the Self-Consuming Efficiency Paradox. [4] This paradox reveals why the very success of minimizing the ETS constraints in the digital age leading to hyper-efficiency paradoxically degrades the human lives it seeks to serve, resulting in societal friction, stress, and burnout. [4] This manuscript, structured across four distinct parts, provides a universal blueprint for policymakers, technologists, and citizens. It aims to offer not just a new theoretical lens for understanding economic history and modern crises, but also a practical, balanced approach to building sustainable, humane economies.

AI.tldr: 本文批判传统GDP增长导向的经济模式，提出ETS-RFS综合框架，将经济重新定义为管理交换、时间、空间三大约束的系统，并揭示自我消耗效率悖论，为构建可持续、人性化经济提供新蓝图。
AI.research_question: 如何超越传统GDP增长导向的经济模式，构建一个能够真正促进人类福祉和韧性繁荣的新经济理论框架？
AI.motivation: 传统GDP增长模式在衡量人类福祉和韧性繁荣方面存在根本缺陷，无法捕捉结构性稳定、制度公平和技术能力等关键要素。2008年金融危机、系统性不平等加剧以及全球健康危机暴露了传统经济模型的诊断深度不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: ETS-RFS综合框架：1) ETS约束理论（交换、时间、空间三大不可约约束）；2) RFS框架（真实、自由、复杂的三元可测量诊断）；3) 自我消耗效率悖论（数字化时代超效率反而降低人类福祉的悖论）。
AI.method: 跨学科的概念框架构建方法，通过理论综合和概念分析，建立新的经济理论范式，为政策制定者、技术专家和公民提供通用蓝图。
AI.findings: 1) 传统经济模型缺乏韧性繁荣所需的诊断深度；2) ETS约束是经济制度和技术的根本设计原则；3) 数字化时代的超效率导致自我消耗效率悖论，反而损害人类福祉；4) 需要平衡的经济政策实现RFS目标。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出跨学科的ETS-RFS综合理论框架；2) 重新定义经济理论的基础为物理和信息摩擦；3) 揭示自我消耗效率悖论这一重要理论发现；4) 提供衡量韧性福祉的三元诊断框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供构建可持续、人性化经济的实用蓝图；2) 帮助技术专家理解技术发展的社会影响；3) 为公民提供理解现代经济危机的新视角；4) 提供平衡经济发展与人类福祉的具体方法。
