detail.title: Enforcing Fair Lending: Evidence from Mortgage Market Litigation

publicationDetails.detailsText: Finance and Economics Discussion Series, issue 2026-012, 2026[10.17016/FEDS.2026.012]

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: Does fair lending litigation impact mortgage lender decisions? Using a novel dataset of all fair lending legal actions from 1991 to 2023, we find that it does. In the wake of legal settlements for discrimination against Black borrowers, lenders significantly reduced denial rates for Black applicants. The reductions offset pre-litigation racial disparities in denial rates by litigated banks, relative to those banks' competitors. Origination rates for Black applicants also increased post-litigation. We further observe evidence of a spillover effect on the approval decisions of non-litigated banks operating in the same city as a litigated bank. Altogether, the evidence suggests that the enforcement of fair lending laws is an effective tool to reduce racial discrimination in credit markets.

AI.tldr: 研究发现公平借贷诉讼对抵押贷款机构决策有显著影响：被起诉银行在解决歧视诉讼后，对黑人申请人的拒绝率显著降低，黑人贷款发放率提高，且存在对同城非被诉银行的溢出效应。
AI.research_question: 公平借贷诉讼是否影响抵押贷款机构的决策？
AI.motivation: 研究公平借贷法律执行的有效性，了解诉讼是否真正能减少信贷市场中的种族歧视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公平借贷法律执行理论、歧视经济学、监管威慑理论
AI.method: 使用1991-2023年所有公平借贷法律诉讼的新数据集，采用实证分析方法，比较被起诉银行与竞争对手在诉讼前后的拒绝率和发放率变化。
AI.findings: 1. 被起诉银行在解决歧视诉讼后，对黑人申请人的拒绝率显著降低；2. 这些降低抵消了诉讼前的种族差异；3. 黑人申请人的贷款发放率提高；4. 存在溢出效应：同城非被诉银行的批准决策也受到影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 为公平借贷法律执行的有效性提供实证证据，支持监管威慑理论，证明诉讼能改变金融机构行为。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供证据支持公平借贷法律的执行，为监管机构提供执法有效性的量化依据，为金融机构提供合规参考。

AI.tldr: 银行如何形成对未来信贷供给的预期仍知之甚少，现有研究主要关注过去经验如何影响银行对宏观经济和信贷表现的预期，进而影响其信贷供给决策。
AI.research_question: 银行如何形成对未来信贷供给的预期？过去经验在塑造银行对宏观经济和信贷表现的预期中扮演什么角色？

AI.method: 文献综述和理论分析，参考Ma et al. (2022)和Falato & Xiao (2024)的研究方法。
AI.findings: 银行对未来信贷供给的预期受到过去经验的影响，这些经验塑造了银行对宏观经济和信贷表现的判断，进而影响其信贷供给决策。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了银行预期形成理论，强调了经验学习在银行决策中的重要性，为理解银行信贷周期提供了新的理论视角。

title: AlphaGen: An Experimental Visualization Cockpit for Regime-Adaptive Market Cognition

detail.title: AlphaGen: An Experimental Visualization Cockpit for Regime-Adaptive Market Cognition

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial, commercial, or personal relationships that could be construed as a potential conflict of interest with respect to this research. The experimental cockpit described in this paper is presented solely as a research and architectural reference implementation. It does not provide investment advice, trading recommendations, or executable trading functionality.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research did not involve human participants, animal subjects, personal data, or any form of intervention requiring ethical approval. As such, no institutional ethics review or approval was required for this study.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The work was conducted independently by the author as part of an exploratory research program at the AlphaGen Institute for Cognitive & Quantitative Research.

detail.abstract:
This paper presents an experimental visualization cockpit designed to externalize the internal cognitive layers of a regime-adaptive market architecture. The cockpit is derived from the AlphaGen framework for autonomous regime-aware strategy evolution and is released as a frozen reference implementation (Experimental Cockpit v1). Rather than generating executable trades, investment advice, or performance claims, the cockpit exposes intermediate abstractions—market aggregation, trait inference, finite-state regime modelling, adaptive risk posture, and decision alignment—within a unified interface.

The system enables inspection of how market information propagates through a layered cognitive architecture, supporting interpretability, auditability, and architectural validation. The cockpit is demonstrated using Indian equity symbols solely as an illustrative case study. No broker connectivity, execution logic, or optimization objectives are included. The contribution of this work lies in demonstrating how regime-aware market cognition architectures can be made transparent and analysable through structured visualization artifacts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个实验性可视化驾驶舱，用于外部化自适应市场架构的内部认知层。该驾驶舱基于AlphaGen框架，展示市场聚合、特征推断、有限状态机制建模、自适应风险姿态和决策对齐等中间抽象，支持可解释性、可审计性和架构验证。
AI.research_question: 如何通过结构化可视化工具使机制感知的市场认知架构变得透明和可分析？
AI.motivation: 现有的市场认知架构通常是黑箱系统，缺乏透明度和可解释性。需要一种方法来外部化这些架构的内部认知层，以支持可解释性、可审计性和架构验证。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机制自适应市场架构理论、分层认知架构理论、AlphaGen自主机制感知策略演化框架、有限状态机制建模理论

AI.findings: 可视化驾驶舱能够有效展示市场信息如何在分层认知架构中传播，支持对市场聚合、特征推断、机制建模、风险姿态和决策对齐等中间抽象的可视化检查

title: Success, Status, and the Endogenous Origins of Decline

detail.title: Success, Status, and the Endogenous Origins of Decline
detail.abstract: Societies characterized by sustained prosperity and security exhibit a recurring cluster of outcomes across diverse social contexts-declining fertility, care-centered moralization, intensified moral enforcement, distributive polarization, and the weakening of containment and corrective mechanisms. These phenomena are typically analyzed in isolation or attributed to cultural change, ideological diffusion, or institutional drift. This paper proposes a unified, micro-founded theoretical framework that explains their joint emergence as unintended consequences of altered incentive and selection environments generated by sustained success. The model assigns causal priority to individual incentives, status competition, and sexual selection operating under relaxed material and reproductive constraints. Sustained prosperity and security reconfigure aggregate mating preferences, generating a directional selection bias favoring care-consistent traits that is amplified and stabilized through status competition. From this shared upstream transformation, two analytically distinct downstream trajectories emerge. The first is a normative-symbolic sequence in which care-centered signaling produces inversion of traditional status markers, crystallizes into moral values, and culminates in intensified enforcement practices. The second is a distributive-structural sequence in which mating-market concentration generates de facto polygyny and durable male polarization. These trajectories originate from the same upstream conditions but follow different logics and interact through asymmetric feedback rather than mutual determination. The paper further shows how the moralization of care generates incentive misalignment and feedback blindness, progressively decoupling moral alignment from outcome-based evaluation. Decline is conceptualized not as moral failure or institutional collapse, but as a loss of adaptive discrimination and corrective capacity under locally rational and stable equilibria. By specifying a unified causal architecture linking prosperity, selection, status competition, moralization, and decline, the framework explains why diverse downstream phenomena recurrently co-occur across societies characterized by sustained prosperity and security and why they tend to persist once established. This paper develops the theoretical core of a broader research program. Companion papers apply the framework to specific domains and institutional contexts. Note on previous versions Earlier versions of this work circulated in preliminary form on SSRN in December 2025. The present paper represents a substantial expansion and full specification of the theoretical framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一的理论框架，解释为何持续繁荣与安全的社会会同时出现生育率下降、关怀道德化、道德执行强化、分配极化以及纠错机制弱化等现象。这些现象不是孤立的文化变迁，而是成功环境改变激励与选择机制导致的意外后果。
AI.research_question: 为什么在持续繁荣与安全的社会中，会反复出现生育率下降、关怀道德化、道德执行强化、分配极化以及纠错机制弱化这一系列相关现象？这些现象之间是否存在统一的因果机制？
AI.motivation: 现有研究通常将这些现象孤立分析或归因于文化变迁、意识形态传播或制度漂移，缺乏统一的解释框架。本文旨在填补这一理论空白，为这些反复出现的现象提供一个统一的微观基础解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于激励与选择环境的微观基础理论框架，强调个体激励、地位竞争和性选择在物质与生殖约束放松条件下的作用。框架包含两个分析上不同的下游轨迹：规范-符号序列（关怀中心信号化、传统地位标记倒置、道德价值固化、执行强化）和分配-结构序列（婚配市场集中、事实多偶制、男性极化）。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建统一的因果架构，将繁荣、选择、地位竞争、道德化和衰退联系起来。通过逻辑推导展示这些现象如何作为持续成功的意外后果共同出现。
AI.findings: 持续繁荣与安全通过重新配置总体择偶偏好，产生有利于关怀一致性特征的定向选择偏差，这种偏差通过地位竞争被放大和稳定。关怀道德化导致激励错位和反馈盲点，使道德对齐与结果评估逐渐脱钩。衰退被概念化为适应性辨别和纠错能力的丧失，而非道德失败或制度崩溃。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出统一的理论框架解释多个社会现象的共现；2）将衰退概念化为适应性辨别能力丧失而非道德失败；3）阐明繁荣、选择、地位竞争、道德化和衰退之间的因果联系；4）区分规范-符号序列和分配-结构序列两个下游轨迹。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为政策制定者理解繁荣社会的系统性风险提供框架；2）帮助识别激励错位和反馈盲点；3）为设计更有效的纠错机制提供理论基础；4）解释为何这些现象一旦建立就倾向于持续存在。

title: Disruptions to Foreign Trade and U.S. Banks’ Returns
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Disruptions to Foreign Trade and U.S. Banks’ Returns

publicationDetails.detailsText: Finance and Economics Discussion Series, issue 2026-013, 2026[10.17016/FEDS.2026.013]

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: We develop a market-based measure of firms' and industries' exposure to foreign trade disruptions. Combining this approach with detailed supervisory data, we quantify large U.S. banks' exposure to such disruptions and propose a novel bank-level vulnerability index. We show that banks with greater exposure experienced significantly larger stock price declines following the April 2025 tariff announcements. Our vulnerability index explains 18% of the cross-sectional variation in bank returns during this episode.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一种基于市场的企业及行业对外贸中断风险的暴露度测量方法，结合监管数据量化美国大型银行对此类中断的暴露，并提出新的银行脆弱性指数。研究发现，暴露度较高的银行在2025年4月关税公告后股价跌幅显著更大，该脆弱性指数能解释银行回报横截面变异的18%。
AI.research_question: 如何测量银行对外贸中断的暴露度？这种暴露度如何影响银行在贸易政策冲击下的股价表现？
AI.motivation: 随着全球贸易紧张局势加剧，了解银行对贸易中断的脆弱性变得日益重要。现有研究缺乏系统测量银行对外贸中断暴露度的方法，以及这种暴露度如何影响银行在贸易政策冲击下的表现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于市场定价理论，通过股票市场反应来衡量企业对外贸中断的暴露度；结合银行风险传导理论，分析银行对贸易冲击的脆弱性。
AI.method: 开发基于市场的企业及行业外贸中断暴露度测量方法；结合详细的监管数据量化银行暴露度；构建银行脆弱性指数；使用事件研究法分析2025年4月关税公告对银行股价的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 暴露度较高的银行在关税公告后股价跌幅显著更大；2. 提出的脆弱性指数能解释银行回报横截面变异的18%；3. 银行对外贸中断的暴露度是影响其股价表现的重要因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出新的基于市场的银行外贸中断暴露度测量框架；2. 开发银行脆弱性指数，丰富了银行风险测量理论；3. 为理解贸易政策冲击如何通过银行体系传导提供理论依据。

detail.abstract: Prediction markets offer a new market-based approach to measuring macroeconomic expectations in real-time. We evaluate the accuracy of prediction market-implied forecasts from Kalshi, the largest federally regulated prediction market overseen by the CFTC. We compare Kalshi with more traditional survey and market-implied forecasts, examine how expectations respond to macroeconomic and financial news, and how policy signals are interpreted by market participants. Our results suggest that Kalshi markets provide a high-frequency, continuously updated, distributionally rich benchmark that is valuable to both researchers and policymakers.

title: Pricing the Social Cost of Flaring: Composition, Location, and Policy Implications
affiliations: Department of Agricultural and Resource Economics, UC Davis, Environmental Defense Fund, School of Economic Sciences, Washington State University, Pullman, United States, Colorado School of Mines - Division of Economics and Business and

detail.title: Pricing the Social Cost of Flaring: Composition, Location, and Policy Implications

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: Agerton's work is supported is supported by the Research Capacity Fund (HATCH), project award no. 7007711, from the U.S. Department of Agriculture's National Institute of Food and Agriculture.

publicationDetails.detailsText: Environmental Defense Fund Economics Discussion Paper Series, 26-01, February 2026

detail.abstract:
Taxing pollutants at their marginal social costs is theoretically optimal but practically challenging when damages vary across space and technologies. Gas flaring presents exactly this problem. We quantify the climate and local health costs of flaring in the three largest U.S. flaring basins (Permian, Bakken, and Eagle Ford), showing that total social costs depend on four factors: gas composition, flare efficiency, the relative social costs of  CO2 versus methane, and population exposure to local air pollutants.

The climate damages from flaring are an order of magnitude larger than the market value of the gas. Using EPA's estimate of the social cost of greenhouse gases and detailed composition data, we estimate climate costs of flaring are $15-25/mcf  (USD2024), compared to an average real natural gas price of $2.73/mcf that year. At typical flare efficiencies, CO2 from combustion---not methane---causes the majority of climate damages from flaring. Local health expenditures vary with population density: our lower-bound estimate ranges from $1.70/mcf in the sparsely populated Bakken to $31/mcf in the more densely populated Eagle Ford---an 18-fold difference. Aggregating across the three basins, 2023 flaring imposed approximately $4 billion in climate damages and $1.6 billion in health expenditures.

These findings have direct policy implications. Methane-only regulations like the Waste Emissions Charge underprice flaring because they ignore CO2, which comprises roughly 85-95\% of total climate damages from flaring. A fully efficient policy must account for well-level variation in emissions of multiple greenhouse gases and health costs that vary across space.

AI.tldr: 该研究量化了美国三大页岩气盆地（二叠纪、巴肯、鹰福特）天然气燃烧的气候和健康成本，发现燃烧的气候损害比天然气市场价值高一个数量级，其中CO2（而非甲烷）造成大部分气候损害，健康成本随人口密度变化显著。研究指出仅针对甲烷的监管政策定价不足，有效政策需考虑多种温室气体排放和空间变化的健康成本。
AI.research_question: 如何量化天然气燃烧的社会成本（包括气候和健康损害），以及这些成本如何随气体成分、燃烧效率、温室气体相对社会成本和人口暴露而变化？
AI.motivation: 理论上按边际社会成本征税是最优的，但当损害在空间和技术间变化时，实践上具有挑战性。天然气燃烧正是这样的问题，需要量化其真实社会成本以制定有效政策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境经济学中的外部性理论、边际社会成本定价理论、空间异质性污染损害理论，以及温室气体社会成本评估框架。
AI.method: 使用EPA的温室气体社会成本估计和详细的气体成分数据，量化美国三大燃烧盆地（二叠纪、巴肯、鹰福特）的燃烧成本。分析基于四个因素：气体成分、燃烧效率、CO2与甲烷的相对社会成本、人口对当地空气污染物的暴露程度。
AI.findings: 1. 燃烧的气候损害比天然气市场价值高一个数量级（$15-25/mcf vs $2.73/mcf）；2. 在典型燃烧效率下，CO2（而非甲烷）造成大部分气候损害（85-95%）；3. 健康成本随人口密度变化显著，从巴肯的$1.70/mcf到鹰福特的$31/mcf（18倍差异）；4. 2023年三大盆地燃烧造成约40亿美元气候损害和16亿美元健康支出。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了量化空间异质性污染损害（特别是天然气燃烧）的实证框架；2. 揭示了CO2在燃烧气候损害中的主导作用，挑战了仅关注甲烷的政策思路；3. 强调了同时考虑多种温室气体和空间变化健康成本的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 指出当前甲烷专项监管（如废物排放收费）定价不足，因忽略CO2损害；2. 为制定完全有效的政策提供依据，需考虑井场水平的多种温室气体排放和空间变化的健康成本；3. 提供了具体成本估算，支持基于社会成本的污染定价政策。

detail.abstract: We present a unified theoretical framework in which all known fundamental interactions-including gravity, gauge forces, and matter-arise from a single higher-dimensional quantum structure defined by M-theory. Compactification on warped internal manifolds yields F-theory, Type IIA, and Type IIB string theories as dual descriptions in appropriate limits. Gauge symmetries, chiral matter, and fermion generations emerge from geometric singularities and flux configurations, while mass hierarchies are generated through warped localization. Building on this, we propose a Vines-Inspired Warp Drive Physics (VIWDP) mechanism, in which controlled extra-dimensional fluxes create an effective 4D warp bubble, enabling superluminal travel without violating 4D energy conditions. The combination of M/F-theory with VIWDP allows both a quantifiable unification framework and a testable approach to FTL travel, with falsifiable predictions spanning particle physics, cosmology, and gravitational phenomena.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个统一理论框架，将已知基本相互作用（包括引力、规范力和物质）统一源于M理论定义的高维量子结构。通过卷曲内部流形的紧致化，在适当极限下得到F理论、IIA型和IIB型弦理论作为对偶描述。规范对称性、手性物质和费米子代从几何奇点和通量构型中涌现，质量层次通过卷曲局域化产生。基于此，作者提出了Vines启发的曲速驱动物理机制，通过控制额外维通量创建有效的4D曲速泡，实现超光速旅行而不违反4D能量条件。
AI.research_question: 如何从M理论的高维量子结构统一描述所有已知基本相互作用（引力、规范力、物质），并在此基础上开发可实现超光速旅行的物理机制？
AI.motivation: 当前物理学面临基本相互作用统一、物质起源、质量层次问题以及超光速旅行理论可行性等挑战。需要构建一个既能统一描述所有已知物理现象，又能为实际应用（如超光速旅行）提供理论基础的综合框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: M理论作为基础框架，通过紧致化产生F理论、Type IIA和Type IIB弦理论。规范对称性、手性物质和费米子代从几何奇点和通量构型中涌现，质量层次通过卷曲局域化机制解释。Vines启发的曲速驱动物理机制作为应用扩展。
AI.method: 理论构建方法：从M理论的高维量子结构出发，通过卷曲内部流形的紧致化推导出各种弦理论对偶描述。使用几何奇点和通量构型解释规范对称性和物质起源。通过卷曲局域化机制解释质量层次。最后提出VIWDP机制，利用额外维通量创建4D曲速泡。
AI.findings: 1. M理论可以统一描述所有基本相互作用；2. 紧致化产生各种弦理论对偶描述；3. 规范对称性、手性物质和费米子代从几何结构中涌现；4. 质量层次可通过卷曲局域化解释；5. VIWDP机制理论上可实现超光速旅行而不违反4D能量条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了从M理论统一所有基本相互作用的综合框架；2. 解释了规范对称性、物质和费米子代的几何起源；3. 提出了质量层次的卷曲局域化机制；4. 创新性地将弦理论与超光速旅行理论结合，提出了VIWDP机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为超光速旅行提供了理论可行性；2. 提出了可检验的预测，涵盖粒子物理、宇宙学和引力现象；3. 为实验验证提供了具体方向；4. 可能推动航天技术和基础物理研究的发展。

title: Banks' Risk-Taking and Deposits Around Going Concern Opinions
affiliations: NHH Norwegian School of Economics - Department of Accounting, Auditing and Law and Universität Paderborn

detail.title: Banks' Risk-Taking and Deposits Around Going Concern Opinions

publicationDetails.detailsText: TRR 266 Accounting for Transparency Working Paper Series No. 226
publicationDetails.journalName: TRR 266 Accounting for Transparency Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We investigate banks' risk-taking and deposit flows around first-time going concern opinions (GCOs). While GCOs may strengthen market monitoring, they are also often suspected of destabilizing banks by triggering depositor runs. Our evidence is difficult to reconcile with that concern. Uninsured deposits begin to decline several quarters before the GCO, while insured deposits increase over the same period, leaving total deposits broadly stable around the opinion. This pattern suggests that more sophisticated depositors respond to timelier information than the annual audit report and shift from uninsured to insured funding before the GCO becomes public, whereas insured retail depositors do not exhibit large-scale withdrawals around the GCO. We also document that bank risk measures rise in the quarters leading up to the GCO and then stabilize and subsequently decline after the opinion. In addition, severe enforcement actions become more likely in the post-GCO period. Taken together, these patterns are consistent with an indirect supervisory channel that may help interpret the post-GCO change in risk-taking. Overall, our findings suggest that concerns about GCOs precipitating depositor runs may be overstated in the banking setting and that systematic auditor forbearance is not clearly justified on financial stability grounds.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨银行首次收到持续经营审计意见（GCO）前后的风险承担和存款流动变化。研究发现，GCO不会引发大规模存款挤兑，未保险存款在GCO公布前几个季度就开始下降，而保险存款同期增加，总存款保持稳定。银行风险指标在GCO前上升，之后稳定并下降，监管行动在GCO后更可能发生。这表明GCO的金融稳定担忧可能被夸大。
AI.research_question: 银行首次收到持续经营审计意见（GCO）如何影响其风险承担行为和存款流动？GCO是否会引发存款挤兑并破坏银行稳定？
AI.motivation: 虽然持续经营审计意见可能加强市场监督，但也常被怀疑会通过触发存款挤兑而破坏银行稳定。监管机构和审计师面临是否对银行采取更宽容态度的困境，担心GCO可能引发系统性风险。需要实证证据来评估这些担忧的合理性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于市场监督理论、信息不对称理论和金融稳定理论。研究探讨审计意见作为信息信号的作用，以及不同存款人（保险vs未保险）对信息的反应差异。同时涉及监管渠道理论，考察GCO如何通过间接监管机制影响银行行为。
AI.method: 实证研究方法，使用银行层面的面板数据，分析首次GCO前后的存款流动模式和风险指标变化。采用事件研究法，比较GCO前后多个季度的存款构成（保险vs未保险）、总存款变化以及银行风险指标（如资本充足率、不良贷款率等）。同时分析监管行动概率的变化。
AI.findings: 1. 未保险存款在GCO公布前几个季度就开始下降，而保险存款同期增加，总存款保持稳定；2. 更成熟的存款人基于更及时的信息在GCO公布前就从未保险存款转向保险存款；3. 保险零售存款人在GCO前后没有大规模提款；4. 银行风险指标在GCO前上升，之后稳定并下降；5. GCO后监管行动概率增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战了GCO会引发存款挤兑的传统观点；2. 揭示了不同存款人对审计信息反应的异质性；3. 提出了GCO通过间接监管渠道影响银行风险承担的机制；4. 为审计意见的信息含量理论提供了银行部门的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 减轻监管机构和审计师对GCO可能破坏金融稳定的担忧；2. 支持审计师在必要时出具GCO，无需过度担心系统性风险；3. 为银行管理层理解存款人行为提供参考；4. 为监管政策制定提供实证依据，表明系统性审计宽容可能缺乏充分理由。

detail.abstract: The Paris Agreement is designed to increase climate ambition gradually through a process of ratcheting up. What is the plausible endpoint of this process? We develop a tractable integrated assessment model in which countries interact through a decentralized general equilibrium and negotiate unanimously over a global carbon budget, with all mitigation implemented via a global carbon price. We prove existence and uniqueness of a unanimous international agreement on global emissions, in which carbon pricing revenues are redistributed across countries in proportion to marginal climate damages. In a quantitative application for 154 countries, the resulting equilibrium limits global mean surface temperature change to 1.51C, at a carbon price of 320 USD/tCO2. The associated international transfers of carbon pricing revenue are progressive toward lower-income countries and amount to about 0.8% of global GDP annually - an order of magnitude larger than the Paris Agreement’s climate finance target.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一个可处理的综合评估模型，证明存在唯一的全球碳排放预算国际协议，其中碳定价收入按边际气候损害比例重新分配。量化应用显示该均衡能将全球平均地表温度变化限制在1.51°C，碳价格为320美元/吨CO₂，国际转移支付占全球GDP的0.8%。
AI.research_question: 《巴黎协定》通过逐步提高气候雄心的过程，其合理终点是什么？
AI.motivation: 《巴黎协定》设计了一个逐步提高气候雄心的机制，但这一过程的最终合理结果尚不明确。需要理解在分散化一般均衡和一致同意谈判框架下，全球碳预算协议的可能形态。
AI.theoretical_framework: 综合评估模型、分散化一般均衡理论、国际谈判理论、碳定价机制、收入再分配理论
AI.method: 开发了一个可处理的综合评估模型，其中各国通过分散化一般均衡相互作用，并就全球碳预算进行一致同意谈判。所有减缓措施通过全球碳价格实施，碳定价收入按边际气候损害比例重新分配。
AI.findings: 证明了存在唯一的全球排放国际协议。在154个国家的量化应用中，均衡结果将全球平均地表温度变化限制在1.51°C，碳价格为320美元/吨CO₂。国际碳定价收入转移支付向低收入国家倾斜，约占全球GDP的0.8%，比《巴黎协定》气候融资目标大一个数量级。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 证明了在分散化一般均衡和一致同意谈判框架下，存在唯一的全球碳排放预算国际协议；2) 建立了碳定价收入按边际气候损害比例重新分配的分配机制理论框架；3) 为《巴黎协定》的合理终点提供了理论预测。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供了具体的量化预测：1.51°C温升目标、320美元/吨碳价格；2) 揭示了国际转移支付的规模和分配模式（占全球GDP 0.8%，向低收入国家倾斜）；3) 为国际气候谈判和政策设计提供了实证依据，特别是关于气候融资规模的参考。

title: The comparative study on various taxes imposed in US state of Alaska
affiliations: PES University

detail.title: The comparative study on various taxes imposed in US state of Alaska
detail.abstract: This research examines Alaska's unique tax structure through a comprehensive quantitative analysis of petroleum and non-petroleum revenue sources from 2015-2024. Using official Alaska Department of Revenue data, this study reveals extreme revenue volatility driven by petroleum dependency, with annual tax collections fluctuating from $1.27 billion to $3.84 billion. Statistical analysis demonstrates that petroleum revenue exhibits a coefficient of variation of 46.9% compared to just 3.2% for non-petroleum sources, representing a fifteenfold difference in volatility. Inflation-adjusted analysis confirms that Alaska's fiscal challenges extend beyond nominal effects, with real revenue volatility creating governance challenges unprecedented among American states. The research quantifies Alaska's fiscal vulnerability, with petroleum taxes averaging 84% of total revenue and year-over-year growth ranging from-39% to +144%. These findings highlight critical challenges for Alaska's fiscal sustainability and provide empirical evidence supporting the urgent need for comprehensive revenue diversification strategies.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过定量分析阿拉斯加2015-2024年石油与非石油税收收入，揭示了石油依赖导致的极端收入波动性，石油税收占平均总收入的84%，年度波动幅度达-39%至+144%，凸显了该州财政可持续性的严峻挑战。
AI.research_question: 阿拉斯加独特的税收结构如何影响其财政收入稳定性？石油依赖对阿拉斯加财政波动性的具体影响程度如何？

AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为阿拉斯加政策制定者提供了财政脆弱性的量化证据；2. 支持全面收入多元化战略的紧迫性；3. 为其他资源依赖型经济体提供了警示案例；4. 为财政规划和预算制定提供了数据基础。

detail.title: Permanent Exemption from Payroll Taxes: The Role of Hiring Frictions

publicationDetails.journalName: National Bank of Belgium Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Belgium’s 2016 payroll tax exemption for first-time employers triggered a sharp increase in firms hiring their first worker but little growth among larger firms. To account for this pattern, we develop and estimate a directed search model—with discrete hiring, firm heterogeneity, and endogenous entry— using Belgian microdata. The exemption reduces the high marginal cost of the first hire, enabling many previously non-hiring entrepreneurs to become employers, but most lack the productivity needed to expand beyond one worker. The model matches the post-reform size distribution and identifies the conditions under which size-dependent hiring subsidies can foster sustained firm growth.

AI.tldr: 比利时2016年首次雇主工资税减免政策显著增加了企业首次雇佣行为，但对较大规模企业增长影响有限。研究通过建立和估计定向搜索模型发现，该政策降低了首次雇佣的高边际成本，使许多原本不雇佣的企业家成为雇主，但大多数企业缺乏生产力以扩张到超过一名员工。

AI.method: 使用比利时微观数据建立和估计定向搜索模型，分析工资税减免政策对企业雇佣行为的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 工资税减免显著增加了企业首次雇佣行为；2. 但对较大规模企业增长影响有限；3. 政策降低了首次雇佣的高边际成本，使许多原本不雇佣的企业家成为雇主；4. 大多数新雇主缺乏生产力以扩张到超过一名员工；5. 模型能够匹配改革后的企业规模分布。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 发展了包含离散雇佣、企业异质性和内生进入的定向搜索模型；2. 识别了规模依赖型雇佣补贴政策促进企业持续增长的条件；3. 解释了为何某些政策只能促进首次雇佣而难以推动规模扩张。

detail.title: Assessing Bankruptcy Risk In Sustainable Enterprises Using The Altman Z-Score Model
detail.abstract: The Altman Z-Score model is a widely used tool for evaluating the financial health of an organization and assessing its risk of bankruptcy. The primary objective of this study is to apply the Altman Z-Score model to seven sustainable enterprises by calculating their Z-scores for the period from 2020 to 2024. Further, regression analysis is employed to forecast the Z-scores for the year 2025. The study identifies comparatively safer companies for investment by analyzing and highlighting the financial risk levels of all seven enterprises. In addition, the findings provide valuable insights for investors and stakeholders by supporting informed investment decision-making.

title: The Dialectics of Fate: Stochastic Finalism and the Function of the Observer
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Dialectics of Fate: Stochastic Finalism and the Function of the Observer
detail.abstract:
The Dialectics of Fate: Stochastic Finalism and the Function of the Observer presents a systematic continuation of the theoretical framework developed in the preceding works—Anatomy of Chaos, The Dynamics of Expansion, and The Architecture of Decay. Together, these texts form a unified model of historical dynamics grounded in the thermodynamics of socio-political systems. The present work addresses the unresolved ontological problem within that framework: the role and function of the conscious subject under conditions of systemic constraint, entropy, and irreversible phase transition.

Rejecting the traditional opposition between free will and determinism, the work introduces the model of Stochastic Finalism. Within this model, historical macro-trajectories are understood as teleonomic—directed toward complexity and equilibration—without implying teleology, intention, or moral purpose. History is conceptualized as a system with a fixed terminal condition (equilibrium), while its concrete development proceeds probabilistically through stochastic events that generate critical junctions.

Within this context, the human agent is redefined as the Observer: not a moral authority or autonomous origin of action, but a functional locus through which probabilistic potential collapses into irreversible historical actuality. This role is further grounded in a four-coordinate ontology (Matter, Space, Time, Consciousness), where Consciousness functions as the axis of actualization. The transition from biological existence to historical agency—described as the Neolithic rupture—is analyzed as the activation of this coordinate, producing a permanent structural tension between biological inertia and conscious direction.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了"随机目的论"模型，将历史视为具有固定终态（均衡）但通过随机事件概率性发展的系统，并将人类主体重新定义为"观察者"——使概率潜力坍缩为历史现实的功能性场所。

AI.theoretical_framework: 随机目的论模型、四坐标本体论（物质、空间、时间、意识）、历史热力学、新石器断裂理论、系统相变理论。
AI.method: 理论建模与概念分析，基于先前建立的统一历史动力学模型进行系统性理论扩展。
AI.findings: 历史宏观轨迹是目的性的（趋向复杂性和均衡），但非目的论的；人类主体作为"观察者"使概率潜力坍缩为历史现实；意识作为实现轴心在四坐标本体论中发挥关键作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了超越自由意志与决定论对立的随机目的论模型；建立了四坐标本体论框架；重新定义了人类作为历史观察者的角色；分析了新石器断裂作为意识坐标激活的关键转变。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解历史发展中的随机性与必然性关系提供了新框架；为分析社会政治系统的热力学行为提供了理论基础；为理解人类在历史进程中的功能性角色提供了新视角。

detail.title: Information About Data

declarations.funderStatement: Partially funded by NSF EAGER Program.

detail.abstract:
Deterrence-based approaches to privacy enforcement rely on an overlooked and often false premise—that firms know what their own data practices are. There is good reason for skepticism because operational information tends to become siloed within firm subunits. Information about data management is no different. Firms may neglect to memorialize relevant information in reports for internal distribution. And even if such reports are generated, they may not be presented in a manner that is intelligible across firm constituencies.

This paper looks outside of privacy law for a solution. Recent scholarship on securities disclosures has highlighted the variety of goals that disclosures serve. While the traditional purpose of financial disclosures is to inform outside investors, the process of preparing disclosures has beneficial internal effects too. It forces firms to study their own financial health and ensures that relevant corporate units are apprised of the results. 

Mandatory disclosures about corporate data practices could have similarly beneficial effects. While some states already require firms to publish generic information about data practices to consumers, these disclosures lack basic attributes that make financial disclosures effective—they lack detail, no human signs them, and they are not filed with any state authority. Securities style disclosures hold more promise. By carefully tailoring the content, format, and required signatories of data practice disclosures, authorities could force firms to generate, translate, and  internally propagate important information about data. Firms that actually know what they are doing with data are more susceptible to efforts aimed to deter data misuse.

AI.tldr: 该论文认为隐私执法中的威慑方法存在缺陷，因为企业往往不了解自身的数据实践。论文借鉴证券披露制度的经验，提出通过强制性的数据实践披露来迫使企业了解自身数据管理情况，从而提高隐私执法的有效性。
AI.research_question: 如何解决隐私执法中威慑方法的根本缺陷——即企业不了解自身数据实践的问题？
AI.motivation: 当前基于威慑的隐私执法方法依赖于一个被忽视且往往错误的假设：企业了解自己的数据实践。实际上，企业运营信息往往在各部门间形成信息孤岛，数据管理信息也不例外，导致企业无法有效监管自身的数据实践。
AI.theoretical_framework: 借鉴证券披露理论，特别是信息披露的多重目标理论。传统财务披露旨在告知外部投资者，但披露准备过程本身具有有益的内部效应——迫使企业研究自身财务状况并确保相关部门了解结果。
AI.method: 理论分析和比较法研究。通过分析现有隐私披露的不足（缺乏细节、无人签字、未向当局备案），并与证券披露的有效特征进行对比，提出改进数据实践披露的具体方案。
AI.findings: 当前某些州要求企业向消费者发布通用数据实践信息的做法效果有限，因为这些披露缺乏使财务披露有效的基本属性。证券式披露在内容、格式和签字要求方面的精心设计，可以迫使企业生成、翻译和内部传播重要的数据信息。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 识别了隐私执法中威慑方法的根本缺陷；2. 将证券披露理论应用于隐私法领域；3. 提出了通过信息披露改善企业内部数据治理的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为监管机构设计有效的数据实践披露制度提供具体建议；2. 帮助企业建立更好的内部数据治理机制；3. 提高隐私执法的实际效果，使真正了解自身数据实践的企业更容易受到威慑。

title: Integration of Direct Battery Recycling and Solutions to Reduce the Carbon Footprint in the Transport Industry
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Integration of Direct Battery Recycling and Solutions to Reduce the Carbon Footprint in the Transport Industry
detail.abstract:
Transport is one of the most energy-intensive and polluting sectors of the global economy: a significant proportion of modern trucks and cars still run on internal combustion engines, which produce high levels of greenhouse gas emissions and air pollutants. The very fact that there are millions of vehicles with internal combustion engines creates a system where it is increasingly difficult to achieve climate goals through full electrification alone. Another important challenge is the environmental and economic cost of extracting new resources for electric vehicle batteries, which also has a significant impact on the overall carbon balance. [5]


In the context of transport decarbonization, special attention should be paid to the difference between emissions directly during vehicle operation (tailpipe emissions) and emissions throughout the entire life cycle of technologies (life-cycle emissions). Focusing exclusively on reducing exhaust emissions creates the illusion of climate efficiency, while a significant part of the carbon footprint is actually transferred to the stages of raw material extraction, battery production, and their subsequent disposal. In the case of electric transport, this means that without well-established battery reuse and recycling systems, full electrification does not guarantee a reduction in the total carbon footprint. That is why modern approaches to decarbonization increasingly view transport not as an isolated sector, but as part of a broader material and energy system, where efficiency is determined by the balance of all stages of the life cycle.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨交通脱碳的挑战，指出仅靠全面电气化难以实现气候目标，需要关注全生命周期排放而非仅尾气排放，并强调电池再利用和回收系统的重要性。
AI.research_question: 在交通脱碳背景下，如何通过全生命周期视角评估和优化交通系统的碳足迹，而不仅仅是关注尾气排放？
AI.motivation: 交通是全球能源消耗最大、污染最严重的部门之一，内燃机车辆产生大量温室气体和空气污染物。仅靠全面电气化难以实现气候目标，且电动汽车电池的资源开采、生产和处置过程会产生显著的碳足迹。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全生命周期评估理论、系统思维方法、循环经济理论、交通脱碳框架
AI.method: 文献综述、系统分析、全生命周期评估方法、案例研究
AI.findings: 仅关注尾气排放会创造气候效率的假象，实际碳足迹被转移到原材料开采、电池生产和处置阶段。没有完善的电池再利用和回收系统，全面电气化无法保证总碳足迹的减少。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将交通视为更广泛物质和能源系统一部分的系统视角，强调全生命周期评估在交通脱碳中的重要性，挑战了仅关注尾气排放的传统脱碳方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了更全面的交通脱碳策略框架，强调需要建立完善的电池再利用和回收系统，促进循环经济在交通领域的应用。

detail.abstract:
Foreign direct investment (FDI) is widely promoted as a catalyst for agricultural transformation in developing countries, yet empirical evidence on its efficiency effects remains limited and mixed. This study examines the association between foreign direct investment and coffee production efficiency in Uganda, with particular attention to regional heterogeneity and policy context. Using a panel of five coffee-producing regions over the period 1995–2024, we estimate technical efficiency scores through stochastic frontier analysis and subsequently analyze their relationship with FDI exposure using fixed-effects panel regressions.
The results indicate that foreign direct investment is positively and significantly associated with coffee production efficiency, reflecting improvements in the use of existing inputs rather than expansion of cultivated area. On average, a one percent increase in FDI inflows is associated with an approximately 0.07–0.09 percent increase in production efficiency. However, these efficiency gains are unevenly distributed across regions, with stronger effects observed in relatively mature coffee-producing areas. Complementary factors including technology adoption, infrastructure, capital formation, and governance quality are also positively associated with efficiency, conditioning the magnitude of investment-related gains. In addition, the relationship between FDI and efficiency strengthens following the implementation of Uganda’s National Coffee Policy, highlighting the role of institutional reforms.
The findings suggest that while foreign investment can support efficiency-enhancing growth in smallholder-based agricultural systems, its benefits are neither automatic nor uniformly distributed. Effective investment strategies therefore require complementary public investments and institutional frameworks to promote inclusive and regionally balanced agricultural development.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了外国直接投资（FDI）与乌干达咖啡生产效率的关系，发现FDI对生产效率有显著正向影响，但效果存在区域差异，且受政策环境、基础设施等因素调节。
AI.research_question: 外国直接投资如何影响乌干达咖啡生产效率？这种影响是否存在区域异质性？政策环境如何调节FDI与生产效率的关系？
AI.motivation: 虽然FDI被广泛认为是发展中国家农业转型的催化剂，但关于其效率影响的实证证据有限且结果不一，特别是在具体农业部门如咖啡生产中的影响机制尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于农业转型理论、技术扩散理论和制度经济学，研究探讨FDI通过技术转移、资本形成和效率改进促进农业发展的机制，同时考虑区域异质性和制度环境的调节作用。
AI.method: 使用1995-2024年乌干达5个咖啡产区的面板数据，首先通过随机前沿分析（SFA）估算技术效率得分，然后采用固定效应面板回归分析FDI暴露与生产效率的关系。
AI.findings: 1. FDI与咖啡生产效率显著正相关，FDI流入每增加1%，生产效率提高约0.07-0.09%；2. 效率提升主要来自现有投入的更好利用而非种植面积扩张；3. 效率增益存在区域差异，成熟产区效果更强；4. 技术采用、基础设施、资本形成和治理质量等互补因素正向调节FDI效果；5. 乌干达国家咖啡政策实施后，FDI与效率的关系增强。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为FDI在农业部门的技术效率影响提供了实证证据；2. 揭示了FDI影响农业效率的区域异质性机制；3. 强调了制度环境在调节FDI效果中的关键作用；4. 丰富了农业转型理论中关于外部投资与内生发展关系的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者设计更有效的农业投资策略提供依据；2. 强调需要配套的公共投资和制度框架来确保FDI效益的包容性和区域平衡；3. 为咖啡产区制定差异化的投资促进政策提供参考；4. 突显了制度改革在放大FDI积极影响中的重要性。

title: Asset Returns, Portfolio Choice, and Proportional Wealth Taxation

detail.title: Asset Returns, Portfolio Choice, and Proportional Wealth Taxation
detail.abstract: We analyse the effect of a proportional wealth tax on asset returns, portfolio choice, and asset pricing in a partial equilibrium setting. The tax is levied annually on the market value of all holdings at a uniform rate. We show that such a tax is economically equivalent to the government acquiring a proportional stake in the investor's portfolio each period — a form of risk sharing in which expected wealth and risk are reduced by the same factor, while the return per share is unaffected. This multiplicative separability between the tax factor and the return realisation drives four main results. First, the coefficient of variation of wealth is invariant to the tax rate, since the tax reduces expected wealth and risk by the same proportion. Second, the optimal portfolio weights — and in particular the tangency portfolio — are independent of the tax rate. Third, the wealth tax is orthogonal to portfolio choice: in discrete time it induces a homothetic contraction of the opportunity set in the mean–standard deviation plane that preserves the Sharpe ratio of every portfolio. Fourth, both taxed and untaxed investors are willing to pay the same price per share for any asset. The results are derived first under geometric Brownian motion and then generalised to any return distribution in the location-scale family. A complementary Modigliani-Miller analysis, treating the tax claim as a separate security, confirms pricing neutrality and identifies an inconsistency in the existing literature regarding the discount rate used for after-tax cash flows. Imposing the Capital Asset Pricing Model as a special case confirms that after-tax betas equal pre-tax betas and the security market line contracts uniformly by (1 − τ_w); under CRRA preferences, general-equilibrium returns and prices are unchanged. This resolves an error in Fama (2021), who overstates the price effect by adding the wealth tax to the cost of capital without adjusting the discount rate. The neutrality results depend on three conditions that are commonly violated in practice: universal taxation at market value, frictionless markets, and dividend consumption. We formalise three channels through which relaxing these conditions breaks neutrality — book-value taxation, liquidity frictions, and dividend extraction — and show that they have opposing effects on asset prices.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了比例财富税对资产回报、投资组合选择和资产定价的影响。研究发现，在特定条件下，财富税对投资组合选择和资产定价具有中性效应，即税收不会改变最优投资组合权重和资产价格。
AI.research_question: 比例财富税如何影响资产回报、投资组合选择和资产定价？
AI.motivation: 财富税是重要的政策工具，但其对金融市场的影响存在争议。现有文献对财富税效应的分析存在不一致，特别是Fama（2021）高估了财富税对资产价格的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 部分均衡分析框架；2. 几何布朗运动模型；3. 位置-尺度分布族；4. 莫迪利亚尼-米勒定理；5. 资本资产定价模型（CAPM）；6. 常相对风险厌恶（CRRA）偏好。
AI.method: 1. 理论建模：在部分均衡设定下分析比例财富税效应；2. 数学推导：首先在几何布朗运动假设下推导结果，然后推广到位置-尺度分布族；3. 补充分析：使用莫迪利亚尼-米勒框架将税收要求权视为独立证券；4. 特殊情况分析：在CAPM和CRRA偏好下检验一般均衡结果。
AI.findings: 1. 财富变异系数与税率无关；2. 最优投资组合权重（特别是切线组合）独立于税率；3. 财富税与投资组合选择正交，保持所有投资组合的夏普比率不变；4. 征税和未征税投资者对任何资产愿意支付相同的每股价格；5. 税后贝塔等于税前贝塔，证券市场线均匀收缩(1-τ_w)；6. 在CRRA偏好下，一般均衡回报和价格保持不变。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了财富税效应的统一分析框架；2. 证明了财富税在特定条件下的中性性质；3. 纠正了Fama（2021）关于财富税对资本成本影响的错误；4. 识别了现有文献中关于税后现金流折现率的不一致性；5. 形式化了打破中性条件的三个渠道。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了财富税设计的理论依据；2. 帮助投资者理解财富税对其投资决策的实际影响；3. 为财富税改革提供了分析框架；4. 指出了实践中可能破坏中性条件的因素及其对资产价格的影响。

title: A Chicken-and-Egg Problem: Profits and Inflation after COVID-19

detail.title: A Chicken-and-Egg Problem: Profits and Inflation after COVID-19
detail.abstract: In 2022, the contribution of unit profits to domestic price pressures in the Euro area more than doubled relative to its historical average. This increase was uneven across industries and particularly pronounced in upstream sectors. While profits have attracted growing attention as a potential driver of inflation, the existing literature has not examined their role within a fully structural macroeconomic framework alongside a broad set of competing price pressures. In this paper, I propose a unified Bayesian VAR framework to disentangle how profits have affected inflation in the Euro area, focusing on the period after the pandemic. The results show that while demand and energy prices initially drove inflation, profits in upstream companies further amplified price pressures, thereby delaying the return of inflation to the 2% target. In the labor-capital distribution debate, profits contribute about one-third more to price pressures than wages. Moreover, firms more than offset by a factor of four the losses they incurred during the pandemic. Overall, the findings suggest that increasing concentration in key sectors poses a material risk to price stability and warrants close monitoring.

AI.tldr: 本文使用贝叶斯VAR框架分析欧元区通胀，发现疫情后单位利润对价格压力的贡献翻倍，上游行业尤为显著。利润在通胀中起到放大作用，延迟通胀回归2%目标，其贡献比工资高约三分之一，企业补偿了疫情期间损失的4倍。
AI.research_question: 利润在欧元区通胀中扮演什么角色？特别是在疫情后时期，利润如何与其他价格压力因素（如需求、能源价格）相互作用影响通胀？
AI.motivation: 2022年欧元区单位利润对国内价格压力的贡献比历史平均水平翻倍，且在不同行业间分布不均，上游行业尤为显著。现有文献未能在完全结构化的宏观经济框架中考察利润作为通胀驱动因素的作用，也未将其与多种竞争性价格压力因素一同分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝叶斯向量自回归（VAR）框架，用于在宏观经济结构模型中分解不同因素对通胀的影响。该框架整合了利润、需求、能源价格等多种价格压力因素。
AI.method: 统一的贝叶斯VAR框架，分析欧元区疫情后的通胀动态。该方法能够同时考虑利润、需求、能源价格等多种因素对通胀的影响，并进行结构性分解。
AI.findings: 1. 需求因素和能源价格最初驱动通胀，但上游企业的利润进一步放大了价格压力，延迟了通胀回归2%目标的时间。2. 在劳动-资本分配争论中，利润对价格压力的贡献比工资高约三分之一。3. 企业补偿了疫情期间损失的4倍以上。4. 关键行业集中度增加对价格稳定构成实质性风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在完全结构化的宏观经济框架中分析利润作为通胀驱动因素的作用，将利润与多种竞争性价格压力因素一同考虑，为通胀分析提供了更全面的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了监测利润对通胀影响的分析工具。2. 揭示了关键行业集中度增加对价格稳定的风险。3. 为理解疫情后通胀动态提供了实证依据。4. 在劳动-资本分配争论中提供了利润相对重要性的量化证据。

title: Expenditure Smoothing under Balanced Budget Rules
affiliations: University of Houston - Department of Economics, , Indiana University Bloomington, University of Houston, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Expenditure Smoothing under Balanced Budget Rules
detail.abstract: An increasing number of countries use balanced budget rules (BBRs) to control government debt, with the potential cost that BBRs constrain the governments’ ability to smooth public expenditures. We find that U.S. state governments, despite having BBRs, smooth expenditures using savings. This is accomplished via substantial cash balances held by agencies outside of the General Fund with only a minor contribution from dedicated “rainy day” funds. We estimate a state government discount rate using a buffer stock model, fitted to fiscal data consolidated over all agencies, and find that expenditures are smoothed as if guided by a planner with a discount rate similar to that typically found for consumers.

AI.tldr: 美国州政府通过机构现金储备而非一般基金来平滑支出，尽管有平衡预算规则约束，其行为类似于消费者缓冲储蓄模型
AI.research_question: 在平衡预算规则约束下，美国州政府如何平滑公共支出？他们使用什么机制来规避规则限制？
AI.motivation: 越来越多的国家采用平衡预算规则控制政府债务，但这可能限制政府平滑公共支出的能力。需要研究政府如何在规则约束下实现支出平滑。
AI.theoretical_framework: 缓冲储蓄模型（缓冲库存模型），政府支出平滑理论，平衡预算规则的经济效应
AI.method: 使用美国州政府的财政数据，将所有机构的数据进行整合，估计州政府的贴现率，应用缓冲库存模型分析支出平滑行为
AI.findings: 1. 州政府通过机构持有的巨额现金余额平滑支出，而非主要依赖专门的"雨天基金"；2. 支出平滑行为类似于消费者缓冲储蓄模型；3. 估计的州政府贴现率与消费者贴现率相似
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了平衡预算规则下政府行为理论；2. 将消费者缓冲储蓄模型应用于政府财政行为分析；3. 揭示了政府通过机构现金储备规避规则约束的机制
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者设计更有效的财政规则提供参考；2. 帮助理解政府实际财政管理行为；3. 为评估平衡预算规则的实际效果提供实证依据

title: Five Objections to Commodification
affiliations: Harvard Law School

detail.title: Five Objections to Commodification
detail.abstract: In free markets, countless goods may be bought and sold. What was once not traded on markets-for example, access to public parks or sexual and reproductive capacitiesmight be turned into a commodity. Time and again, allowing things to be bought and sold increases both autonomy and welfare. Still, there are pervasive objections to commodification. The first set of objections points to illicit preferences and values and the importance of delegitimating, or not legitimating, those preferences and values (for example, employers cannot "buy" the right to engage in sexual harassment). A second set of objections involves collective action problems: commodification might create such problems (consider the right to vote). A third set of objections invokes equality (as, for example, when people reject the idea that access to public parks should be allocated on the basis of willingness to pay). A fourth set of objections points to information failures and behavioral biases, potentially producing blocked exchanges. A fifth set of objections emphasizes what may be the corrosive effects of commodification on the goods in questions (consider prostitution). These objections sometimes depend on doubtful empirical assumptions, and are frequently overstated. They have different levels of force in different contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了商品化（将原本非市场交易的事物变为商品）的利弊。虽然商品化能提升自主性和福利，但存在五大反对理由：1) 涉及非法偏好和价值观；2) 引发集体行动问题；3) 不平等问题；4) 信息失灵和行为偏差；5) 对商品本身的腐蚀效应。这些反对意见在不同情境下力度不同，有时基于可疑的经验假设。
AI.research_question: 商品化（将原本非市场交易的事物变为商品）在什么情况下是合理的？反对商品化的主要理由有哪些，它们的有效性如何？
AI.motivation: 在自由市场中，越来越多的东西被商品化（如公共公园使用权、性和生育能力等），虽然这通常能增加自主性和福利，但存在广泛而持久的反对声音。需要系统分析这些反对意见的合理性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于商品化理论、市场伦理、自主性理论、福利经济学、集体行动理论、平等理论、行为经济学等框架，分析商品化的多维影响。
AI.method: 概念分析和理论论证，系统梳理和评估反对商品化的五大类理由，分析其理论基础和经验假设。
AI.findings: 1) 反对商品化的五大理由各有不同理论基础；2) 这些反对意见有时基于可疑的经验假设；3) 在不同情境下，这些反对意见的力度不同；4) 反对意见经常被夸大；5) 需要具体情况具体分析商品化的合理性。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统化地提出了反对商品化的五大理论框架，为商品化伦理研究提供了结构化分析工具，澄清了不同反对理由的理论基础和经验前提。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、市场设计者和社会管理者提供了评估商品化决策的框架，帮助识别哪些领域的商品化可能存在问题，以及如何平衡自主性、福利与其他社会价值。

reference: Ernest Lim and Philip Morgan, The Cambridge Handbook of Private Law and Artificial Intelligence (Cambridge University Press 2024) pp409-430
title: Corporate Law, Corporate Governance And Ai: Are We Ready For Robots In The Boardroom?

detail.title: Corporate Law, Corporate Governance And Ai: Are We Ready For Robots In The Boardroom?

publicationDetails.detailsText: Ernest Lim and Philip Morgan, The Cambridge Handbook of Private Law and Artificial Intelligence (Cambridge University Press 2024) pp409-430

detail.abstract: While affirming the robustness of core corporate law principles, this chapter explores how AI has, and could, impact the content, application and processes of corporate law and corporate governance, and the interactions of corporate law actors including boards, shareholders and regulators. As AI gains agency, the legal and cultural challenges in recognising robo-directors are probed. A contextual exploration of directors' duties confronts the significant contemporary challenge concerning the need for directors to engage with AI's potential to transform companies' business models, culture and systems. When considering how and when to deploy AI applications, adoption and reliance upon AI by companies is considered against the backdrop of likely judicial application of key best interests duty and duty of care precepts to directors. The chapter also engages with corporate governance potential and controversies surrounding use of AI and robo-directors including stakeholder interests, board effectiveness, groupthink and internal biases.

AI.tldr: 本章探讨AI如何影响公司法与公司治理的内容、应用和流程，分析AI获得代理权后带来的法律文化挑战，特别是机器人董事的认可问题，并讨论董事在AI应用中的职责与义务。
AI.research_question: AI如何影响公司法的内容、应用和流程？AI获得代理权后，公司法如何应对机器人董事的法律认可挑战？董事在AI应用中的职责和义务应如何界定？
AI.motivation: 随着AI技术在公司治理中的应用日益广泛，需要探讨AI对公司法基本原则的冲击，特别是当AI获得代理权时，公司法需要如何适应这种技术变革，以及董事在AI时代面临的新职责挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于公司法核心原则，结合AI代理理论、董事职责理论、公司治理理论，探讨AI技术对公司法律框架的理论影响。
AI.method: 采用理论分析和法律文本分析的方法，通过探讨AI对公司法具体条款和原则的影响，分析AI应用的法律后果和挑战。
AI.findings: AI正在改变公司法的内容和应用方式；AI获得代理权带来了机器人董事的法律认可挑战；董事在AI应用中需要重新审视其最佳利益义务和注意义务；AI在公司治理中既带来效率提升也引发利益相关者冲突、群体思维等新问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了公司法理论在AI时代的适用性，提出了AI代理权对公司法主体理论的新挑战，丰富了董事职责理论在技术变革背景下的内涵。
AI.practical_contributions: 为立法者和监管机构提供AI时代公司法改革的参考框架，为董事和公司提供AI应用中的法律风险指引，为企业AI治理实践提供理论支持。

detail.abstract: It is critical to ensure the safe and quality supply of blood among various stakeholders; however, this remains a significant challenge in today's world, especially in developing countries. These countries face severe problems, including blood shortages, fragmented regulatory frameworks, and inconsistent quality control measures. To tackle these challenges, countries like India are trying to implement the use of artificial intelligence (AI) and its derivative platforms to transform blood collection, testing, storage, and distribution by enabling interoperability, real-time compliance monitoring, automated donor screening, optimized inventory management, and advanced component separation. The article argues that developing countries must adopt both regulatory reform and technological innovation to improve the current blood supply chain. Having a collaborative system wherein there is an interoperable relationship among various stakeholders, combined with an AI-driven blood management technology, would help ensure a reduction in blood wastage, improve patient safety, and the timely supply of high-quality blood products on a global scale.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨发展中国家如何通过监管改革和技术创新（特别是人工智能）来改善血液供应链，解决血液短缺、监管碎片化和质量控制不一致等问题。
AI.research_question: 发展中国家如何通过监管改革和人工智能技术来改善血液供应链的安全性和质量？
AI.motivation: 发展中国家面临严重的血液供应链问题，包括血液短缺、分散的监管框架和不一致的质量控制措施，这对患者安全和公共卫生构成重大挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于供应链管理理论、技术创新采纳理论和监管改革理论，探讨技术-监管协同对血液供应链改善的影响。
AI.method: 该论文采用案例研究方法，以印度为例，分析人工智能技术在血液收集、检测、储存和分配中的应用，并结合政策分析探讨监管改革需求。
AI.findings: 人工智能技术能够实现互操作性、实时合规监控、自动化供血者筛查、优化库存管理和先进成分分离，但需要与监管改革相结合才能有效改善血液供应链。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"技术-监管协同框架"，强调在发展中国家背景下，技术创新必须与监管改革相结合才能有效改善关键医疗供应链。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家提供了具体的实施路径：建立利益相关者协作系统、采用人工智能驱动的血液管理技术、推动监管框架整合，以减少血液浪费、提高患者安全并确保高质量血液产品的及时供应。

detail.abstract: Post-pandemic inflation highlighted tensions between price stability and growth objectives. We evaluate this risk using probabilistic responses from professional forecasters' surveys. Our dynamic factor model with time-varying uncertainty and asymmetry captures the joint dynamics of inflation and growth and decomposes them into demand and supply components. We find that tail risk is prominent in US data in the 1980s and during the Great Recession for inflation, and during the 1980s and in the period following COVID-19 for GDP growth. The post-pandemic inflation is driven by temporary adverse supply and persistent positive demand. The model-implied correlation between inflation and growth is time-varying, negatively related to nominal term premiums and on average positive, suggesting that professional forecasters do not have stagflationary beliefs. In 2022, stagflation risks increased after three decades of near-zero probabilities.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用专业预测者的概率调查数据，通过动态因子模型分析通胀与增长的尾部风险，发现后疫情通胀由暂时性负面供给和持续性正面需求驱动，预测者并不持有滞胀信念。
AI.research_question: 后疫情时期通胀与增长之间的尾部风险如何？专业预测者对通胀与增长关系的信念是什么？
AI.motivation: 后疫情通胀凸显了价格稳定与增长目标之间的紧张关系，需要评估这种风险并理解通胀与增长的动态关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态因子模型，包含时变不确定性和不对称性，能够捕捉通胀与增长的联合动态并将其分解为需求和供给成分。
AI.method: 使用专业预测者调查中的概率响应数据，构建包含时变不确定性和不对称性的动态因子模型，分析美国数据。
AI.findings: 1. 尾部风险在1980年代和大衰退期间对通胀显著，在1980年代和COVID-19后对GDP增长显著；2. 后疫情通胀由暂时性负面供给和持续性正面需求驱动；3. 通胀与增长的相关性随时间变化，与名义期限溢价负相关，平均为正，表明预测者没有滞胀信念；4. 2022年滞胀风险在近30年接近零概率后有所增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个能够捕捉通胀与增长联合动态并分解为需求供给成分的动态因子模型框架，为理解宏观经济风险提供了新方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了评估通胀与增长尾部风险的工具，帮助理解后疫情通胀的驱动因素，并对专业预测者的信念提供了实证证据。

title: The Bureaucratic Demise: A Kafkaesque Analysis of Modern Death
affiliations: Victoria University of Wellington - Te Herenga Waka

detail.title: The Bureaucratic Demise: A Kafkaesque Analysis of Modern Death

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Nil.
declarations.funderStatement: Nil.

detail.abstract: The determination of death is a foundational clinical practice, yet the transition from biological presence to administrative record is fraught with friction. This Viewpoint argues that the modern clinical and legal setting is a site of conflict between divergent global definitions of death: medical, legal, economic, statistical, religious, and coronial. Governed by national statutes and international registries, these systems have created a Kafkaesque labyrinth where the administrative record often supersedes biological reality. Drawing on Giorgio Agamben's concept of "Bare Life" and the literary frameworks of Franz Kafka, we analyse the "Bureaucratic Demise" (the moment when the file takes precedence over the person). We examine global cases of jurisdictional death, the absurdity of registry errors, and the administrative paralysis of the coronial system to highlight the dissonance between the messy reality of the dying body and the rigid requirements of the global bureaucracy. Finally, we propose narrative medicine as a humble, human-centric alternative to multidisciplinary reductionism.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了死亡认定过程中生物学现实与行政记录之间的冲突，分析了全球不同死亡定义（医学、法律、经济、统计、宗教、法医）造成的官僚迷宫，提出叙事医学作为更人性化的替代方案。
AI.research_question: 在当代临床和法律环境中，不同全球死亡定义（医学、法律、经济、统计、宗教、法医）如何导致生物学现实与行政记录之间的冲突？如何通过叙事医学解决这种官僚化死亡认定的问题？
AI.motivation: 死亡认定是基础临床实践，但从生物学存在到行政记录的转变充满摩擦。现代临床和法律环境成为不同死亡定义冲突的场所，行政记录常常超越生物学现实，形成卡夫卡式的官僚迷宫。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 乔治·阿甘本的"赤裸生命"概念
2. 弗朗茨·卡夫卡的文学框架
3. "官僚消亡"概念（文件优先于个人的时刻）
AI.method:
1. 概念分析：运用阿甘本和卡夫卡的理论框架
2. 案例研究：分析全球管辖权死亡案例
3. 制度分析：审查登记错误和法医系统的行政瘫痪
4. 比较分析：对比死亡身体的混乱现实与全球官僚体系的刚性要求
AI.findings:
1. 现代死亡认定系统形成了卡夫卡式的官僚迷宫
2. 行政记录常常超越生物学现实
3. 登记错误和法医系统的行政瘫痪凸显了现实与官僚要求之间的不协调
4. 不同死亡定义（医学、法律、经济、统计、宗教、法医）之间存在根本冲突
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了"官僚消亡"的概念框架
2. 将阿甘本的"赤裸生命"概念应用于死亡认定分析
3. 发展了卡夫卡式官僚主义在医疗行政中的应用理论
4. 为理解死亡认定的多学科冲突提供了理论视角
AI.practical_contributions:

2. 为改革死亡认定系统提供实践建议

reference: Northwestern Public Law Research Paper ; Harvard Public Law Working Paper
title: Divesting University Endowments
affiliations: Northwestern University - Pritzker School of Law and

detail.title: Divesting University Endowments

publicationDetails.journalName: Northwestern University Pritzker School of Law, Public Law & Legal Theory Research Paper Series
Harvard Law School, Public Law & Legal Theory Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
The brutal conflict between Hamas and Israel convulsed higher education. Student protestors have demanded that university endowments "divest" from Israel. University leaders have largely resisted those demands on grounds of fiduciary obligation, institutional neutrality, or both. In response, protestors have pointed to prior instances of purported divestment. Confusion abounds over the applicable fiduciary principles and the scope of prior divestments. This paper synthesizes the law and finance of endowment divestment and applies that analysis to past divestments and present divestment demands. 

We show that under prevailing law endowment divestment for nonfinancial reasons is permissible only if: (1) the divestment is consistent with the university's charitable purpose of research and education, and (2) the divestment's effect on the portfolio is reasonable in light of that purpose. Applied to the current state of university endowment management, this is a highly restrictive standard. The charitable purpose of most secular universities is research and education, full stop. Moreover, contemporary endowment practice relies on external managers, making a divestment today more costly to implement than in the past. Under current endowment practice, therefore, even a de minimis divestment, whether from Israel or otherwise, would likely be a fiduciary breach, potentially exposing university trustees to out-of-pocket damages for any resulting loss to the endowment. 

We also examine current divestment policies and purported prior divestments, including South Africa under apartheid, tobacco, the Darfur war, and fossil fuels. Consistent with our legal analysis, but contrary to conventional wisdom, we find that universities have generally not engaged in broad divestments, not even from South Africa under apartheid. Instead, most large university endowments adhere to a narrow divestment policy for "moral abhorrence" that has rarely been invoked. We show that a divestment for moral abhorrence could pass fiduciary muster as consistent with the public benefit principle of charity law if supported by a clear public policy established by confirmatory governmental actions.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨大学捐赠基金撤资的法律与财务问题，分析当前以色列撤资要求及历史撤资案例，指出非财务原因的撤资只有在符合大学慈善目的且对投资组合影响合理时才被允许，但现代捐赠基金管理实践使这种撤资难以实现。
AI.research_question: 大学捐赠基金基于非财务原因（如道德、政治）进行撤资的法律允许性条件是什么？当前以色列撤资要求及历史撤资案例是否符合这些条件？
AI.motivation: 哈马斯与以色列冲突引发学生要求大学从以色列撤资，大学管理者以受托责任和机构中立为由拒绝，但抗议者引用历史撤资案例，导致对适用法律原则和历史撤资范围的混淆。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于慈善法中的公共福利原则和受托责任理论，结合现代捐赠基金管理实践（依赖外部经理人、投资组合多元化等）。
AI.method: 法律与财务分析的综合研究方法：1）分析适用法律原则；2）应用分析框架评估历史撤资案例（南非种族隔离、烟草、达尔富尔战争、化石燃料）；3）评估当前撤资要求。
AI.findings: 1）非财务原因撤资只有在符合大学慈善目的且对投资组合影响合理时才被允许；2）现代捐赠管理实践使撤资成本高昂；3）历史案例显示大学并未广泛撤资，即使南非种族隔离时期也是如此；4）大多数大学采用狭窄的"道德厌恶"撤资政策且很少使用。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了大学捐赠基金撤资的法律标准，建立了"慈善目的一致性"和"投资组合影响合理性"的双重检验框架，修正了对历史撤资案例的误解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为大学管理者提供明确的撤资决策法律指导，指出当前撤资要求可能违反受托责任，为捐赠基金管理者提供风险管理建议，帮助学生活动家理解撤资的法律限制。

affiliations: George Mason University and George Mason University - Department of Economics

detail.title: State Capacity, State Capture, and Political Capitalism: The Case of the Military-Industrial Complex

publicationDetails.journalName: George Mason University Department of Economics Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: State capacity, the ability to achieve policy goals and provide public goods, is a central concept in contemporary political economy. National defense is the textbook case of a public good requiring state provision. Analysis of defense provision, however, assumes that the state possesses the means and the incentives to serve public interest. We reconsider the meaning of state capacity by examining the institutional context surrounding the provision of national defense and the militaryindustrial complex. Because defense is supplied outside the market, decisions about scope and quality are inherently political and shaped by information and incentive constraints that differ from market settings. We show how the instruments of defense provision create channels for special interests, so that a capable state risks becoming a captured one. We argue that this dynamic is not simply unidirectional capture but a reciprocal process of political capitalism, in which political and economic elites jointly produce privilege.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视国家能力概念，通过分析国防供给的制度背景和军工复合体，揭示国防供给如何为特殊利益集团创造渠道，使有能力的国家面临被俘获的风险，形成政治资本主义的互惠过程。
AI.research_question: 国家能力在国防供给这一典型公共品提供中如何被重新定义？国防供给的制度背景如何影响国家能力，并可能导致国家被特殊利益集团俘获？
AI.motivation: 传统分析假设国家有能力和动机服务公共利益，但国防供给作为典型的公共品，其决策过程具有政治性，受信息和激励约束影响，需要重新审视国家能力在这一特定领域的含义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国家能力理论、公共品理论、政治经济学、俘获理论、政治资本主义理论
AI.method: 理论分析框架构建，通过制度分析考察国防供给的政治经济学机制
AI.findings: 国防供给在非市场环境下进行，其范围和质量决策具有政治性；国防供给工具为特殊利益集团创造了渠道；有能力的国家可能成为被俘获的国家；这一过程不是单向俘获，而是政治经济精英共同生产特权的互惠过程。
AI.theory_contributions: 重新概念化国家能力，强调其在特定制度背景下的复杂性；提出国防供给中的俘获风险理论；发展政治资本主义的互惠过程理论，超越单向俘获模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供关于国防供给制度设计的警示；帮助识别和防范国家能力被特殊利益集团俘获的风险；为公共品供给的治理改革提供理论依据。

title: Is Universal Disclosure Equivalent to No Disclosure? Data Asset Disclosure, Investors' Limited Attention and Capital Market Pricing Efficiency
affiliations: School of Management and Economics, Beijing Institute of Technology and

detail.title: Is Universal Disclosure Equivalent to No Disclosure? Data Asset Disclosure, Investors' Limited Attention and Capital Market Pricing Efficiency

declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: This paper utilizes data from Chinese A-share listed companies and, based on the limited attention theory, reexamines the impact of data asset disclosure on capital market pricing efficiency. The study finds that the economic consequences of data asset disclosure are not static but exhibit a significant marginal decreasing feature as the overall market disclosure level rises. Specifically, when the overall market disclosure level is low, corporate disclosure of data asset information can significantly reduce stock price synchronization and enhance capital market pricing efficiency by increasing the supply of idiosyncratic information, enhancing information diffusion, and accelerating information integration. However, with the recent widespread disclosure behavior, there is no evidence that the above mechanisms remain effective. Further analysis indicates that disclosure behavior can maintain its positive effect only when the overall market disclosure level of data assets is low, and the firm's disclosed idiosyncratic information is relatively limited, the information dissemination environment is favorable, or institutional investor attention is not excessively diffused. This paper expands the boundaries of the limited attention theory, extending the research perspective to the dimension of the dispersion of investor attention by homogenized information, and reveals the value dilution problem faced by data asset information disclosure in the context of universalization.

AI.tldr: 本文基于有限注意力理论，重新审视数据资产披露对资本市场定价效率的影响，发现其经济后果并非静态，而是随着市场整体披露水平上升呈现显著边际递减特征。
AI.research_question: 数据资产披露如何影响资本市场定价效率？这种影响是否会随着市场整体披露水平的变化而改变？
AI.motivation: 随着数据资产在企业价值中重要性日益凸显，其信息披露行为逐渐普遍化，但现有研究对数据资产披露的经济后果缺乏动态视角，特别是在市场整体披露水平变化背景下的影响机制尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 有限注意力理论，特别关注同质化信息导致的投资者注意力分散维度
AI.method: 使用中国A股上市公司数据，基于有限注意力理论，采用实证分析方法研究数据资产披露对股票价格同步性和资本市场定价效率的影响
AI.findings: 1. 数据资产披露的经济后果具有边际递减特征；2. 当市场整体披露水平低时，数据资产披露能显著降低股价同步性，提高定价效率；3. 当披露行为普遍化后，上述机制不再有效；4. 只有在市场整体披露水平低、公司特有信息有限、信息传播环境良好或机构投资者注意力不过度分散时，披露行为才能保持积极效应
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 拓展了有限注意力理论的边界，将研究视角延伸到同质化信息导致的投资者注意力分散维度；2. 揭示了数据资产信息披露在普遍化背景下面临的价值稀释问题
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为监管机构制定数据资产披露政策提供参考；2. 为企业优化信息披露策略提供指导；3. 帮助投资者理解数据资产披露的价值变化规律

title: Structured Financial Reconciliation and Anomaly Detection in U.S. Public-Sector Reporting Environments: A Methodology for Cross-Period Variance Identification and Accountability Infrastructure
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Structured Financial Reconciliation and Anomaly Detection in U.S. Public-Sector Reporting Environments: A Methodology for Cross-Period Variance Identification and Accountability Infrastructure

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest. This research was conducted independently without financial compensation.

keywords: government auditing JEL Classifications: H72 (State and Local Budget and Expenditures)

detail.abstract: Fragmented and inconsistent financial reporting across the 89,000+ units of local government in the United States creates systemic barriers to cross-period comparability, anomaly detection, and institutional financial accountability. This paper presents a structured financial reconciliation methodology that adapts institutional credit-risk modeling discipline-developed in regulated banking environments-to municipal and public-sector financial data analysis. The methodology incorporates four core components: (1) transactional data normalization and period-sequencing; (2) structured variance identification and cross-period balance reconciliation; (3) reproducible evidentiary documentation enabling independent third-party review under professional auditing standards; and (4) scalable analytical protocols transferable across jurisdictions and reporting formats. A case application is presented in which the methodology was applied to municipal utility billing data, producing findings subsequently confirmed through independent CPA attestation under AICPA and Government Auditing Standards and culminating in formal municipal corrective action. The paper discusses scalability considerations, integration with AI-assisted data mapping tools, and implications for national public-sector financial oversight capacity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结构化财务对账方法，将银行监管环境中的信用风险建模原则应用于地方政府财务数据分析，以解决美国地方政府财务报告碎片化和不一致的问题。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一种系统性的财务对账方法，以解决美国地方政府财务报告的碎片化和不一致问题，从而提高跨期可比性、异常检测和财务问责能力？
AI.motivation: 美国超过89,000个地方政府单位的财务报告存在碎片化和不一致性，这严重阻碍了跨期可比性、异常检测和机构财务问责，需要系统性的解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将受监管银行环境中发展的机构信用风险建模原则应用于市政和公共部门财务数据分析，建立结构化的财务对账框架。
AI.method: 提出包含四个核心组件的结构化财务对账方法：1)交易数据标准化和期间排序；2)结构化差异识别和跨期余额对账；3)可复制的证据文件编制；4)可扩展的分析协议。通过市政公用事业账单数据的案例应用验证方法有效性。
AI.findings: 该方法成功应用于市政公用事业账单数据，产生的发现通过了独立注册会计师根据AICPA和政府审计标准的认证，并最终促成了正式的市政纠正行动。
AI.theory_contributions: 将银行监管环境中的信用风险建模原则扩展到公共部门财务分析，建立了跨部门理论迁移的框架，为公共部门财务监督提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可跨司法管辖区和报告格式扩展的实用工具，支持独立第三方审计，增强了全国公共部门财务监督能力，可与AI辅助数据映射工具集成。

title: Protecting Social Security: The Case Against Extending the Full Retirement Age

detail.title: Protecting Social Security: The Case Against Extending the Full Retirement Age

publicationDetails.detailsText: Retirement Management Journal, No. Vol. 14, No. 1, pp. 38-44, 2025
publicationDetails.journalName: Retirement Management Journal

detail.abstract:
The Social Security “full retirement age” (FRA) is the age at which retirement-income benefits are available without reduction for early commencement. Presently, that age is 67 for those born in 1960 or later. This paper is about the unfair and unnecessary threat to reduce Social Security retirement-income benefits by extending the FRA, a change that will affect upwards of 80 percent of future retirees, most of whom can ill-afford the reduction.

Learn more about the Retirement Management Journal.

AI.tldr: 该论文反对提高社会保障"完全退休年龄"的政策，认为这会不公平且不必要地削减未来退休人员的收入，影响超过80%的退休者，而他们大多难以承受这种收入减少。
AI.research_question: 提高社会保障完全退休年龄对退休人员福利的影响是什么？这种政策是否公平且必要？
AI.motivation: 当前政策提议将完全退休年龄从67岁进一步提高，这将影响1960年及以后出生的80%以上未来退休者。这些退休者大多经济状况不佳，难以承受福利削减。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会保障政策分析、退休收入保障理论、代际公平理论、福利经济学
AI.method: 政策分析、数据统计（影响80%以上未来退休者）、经济影响评估
AI.findings: 提高完全退休年龄是不公平且不必要的政策，会严重损害大多数未来退休者的经济利益，而这些退休者经济状况本就脆弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了通过提高退休年龄来解决社会保障资金问题的传统思路，提出了代际公平和福利保障的新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了反对提高退休年龄的论据，保护了大多数未来退休者的利益，提出了更公平的社会保障改革方案。

title: 9DA™ Conformity Engine: A Deterministic Structural Framework for EU AI Act Conformity Assessment
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: 9DA™ Conformity Engine: A Deterministic Structural Framework for EU AI Act Conformity Assessment

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the sole creator of the 9DA™ framework and the described software. The author has a commercial interest in the 9DA™ Conformity Engine. No external funding or third-party influence was received.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper presents a mathematical framework and software tool. No human participants, patient data, or personal data were used. Ethics approval is not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: Self-funded independent research. No external funding received.

detail.abstract: We present the 9DA™ Conformity Engine, a deterministic mathematical framework for assessing structural conformity of high-risk artificial intelligence systems under Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (EU AI Act). The framework maps nine governance fields-Alignment, Safety, Autonomy, Transparency, Fairness, Robustness, Privacy, Accountability, and Emergence-to specific legal obligations (Articles 6, 9-15, 17, 20, 43, 47, 72 and Annex IV) and computes structural conformity as a measurable scalar. The core innovation is the q_legal distribution: a use-case-specific legal target distribution constructed from article weights and Annex III risk profiles, against which the system's documentation state is measured via KL divergence. Governance loss is computed as Euler distance from the attractor state (-1, 0) in a complex governance plane, embedding Euler's identity e^(iπ) + 1 = 0 as a structural completion law. The correction simulator applies a governor formula-identical in structure to the 9DA AGI Field's fractal governor-to project documentation remediation paths toward CE declaration eligibility. The engine is deterministic (seeded), produces reproducible SHA-256-fingerprinted reports, and integrates a structural contradiction detector with seven rule types. Formal verification confirms: (1) 100% boundedness, (2) convergence of all 35 scenario × coupling combinations, (3) Lyapunov stability P(ΔV < 0) = 75.2%, and (4) attractor basin p* = 1.0. Calibrated results across six Annex III use cases are presented. The system is available at github.com/9DAtm/9DA-Core under Apache-2.0.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了9DA™一致性引擎，这是一个确定性数学框架，用于评估高风险人工智能系统在欧盟AI法案下的结构一致性。该框架将九个治理领域映射到具体法律义务，通过KL散度衡量系统文档状态与法律目标分布的差距，并计算治理损失。系统具有确定性、可重复性，并包含结构矛盾检测器。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个确定性数学框架来评估高风险人工智能系统在欧盟AI法案下的结构一致性？
AI.motivation: 欧盟AI法案（Regulation (EU) 2024/1689）对高风险AI系统提出了严格的法律要求，需要系统化的方法来评估和确保AI系统的结构一致性，以符合法规要求。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 9DA治理框架（对齐、安全、自主性、透明度、公平性、鲁棒性、隐私、问责制、涌现性）
2. q_legal分布：基于条款权重和附件III风险概况构建的用例特定法律目标分布
3. KL散度用于衡量系统文档状态与法律目标的差距
4. 复杂治理平面中的欧拉距离计算治理损失
5. 欧拉恒等式e^(iπ) + 1 = 0作为结构完整性定律
AI.method:
1. 将九个治理领域映射到具体法律条款（第6、9-15、17、20、43、47、72条和附件IV）
2. 使用KL散度计算系统文档状态与q_legal分布的差异
3. 在复杂治理平面中计算欧拉距离作为治理损失
4. 应用校正模拟器生成文档修复路径
5. 使用确定性算法生成可重复的SHA-256指纹报告
6. 集成七种规则类型的结构矛盾检测器
AI.findings:
1. 正式验证确认：100%有界性
2. 所有35种场景×耦合组合的收敛性
3. 李雅普诺夫稳定性P(ΔV < 0) = 75.2%
4. 吸引子盆地p* = 1.0
5. 在六个附件III用例上进行了校准
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了一个将AI治理领域映射到具体法律义务的确定性数学框架
2. 引入了q_legal分布概念，将法律要求量化为可测量的目标分布
3. 将欧拉恒等式嵌入治理框架作为结构完整性定律
4. 开发了基于分形治理器的校正模拟器
5. 建立了结构矛盾检测的理论基础
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 提供了评估AI系统是否符合欧盟AI法案的具体工具
2. 生成了可重复、可验证的一致性评估报告
3. 帮助组织识别和修复文档缺陷以达到CE声明资格
4. 开源实现（Apache-2.0许可）可供实际应用
5. 为高风险AI系统的合规性评估提供了标准化方法

title: Banking on Disagreement: Heterogeneous Credit Risk Assessments in Syndicated Lending
affiliations: , Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Northwestern University - Department of Accounting Information & Management and London Business School

detail.title: Banking on Disagreement: Heterogeneous Credit Risk Assessments in Syndicated Lending
detail.abstract: Using confidential supervisory data, we measure disagreement among bank syndicate lenders about borrowers’ credit risk by exploiting dispersion in probability-of-default (PD) estimates that banks report to the Federal Reserve for the same borrower-loan pair. Consistent with theory, disagreement is greater for larger loans and syndicates. At origination, loans with higher disagreement carry significantly higher spreads, even after controlling for borrower and loan risk characteristics. Although disagreement does not affect the number of covenants, it lowers the likelihood that contracts include performance-pricing provisions, consistent with lenders seeking to avoid future coordination frictions. After origination, banks with more pessimistic PD assessments are more likely to exit the syndicate, and greater disagreement lowers the probability of loan amendments following both positive and negative shocks to borrower fundamentals. However, successful renegotiations narrow subsequent disagreement. Overall, our evidence shows that within-syndicate coordination frictions shape loan pricing, contract design, syndicate composition, and renegotiation outcomes.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用银行监管数据，通过分析银行对同一借款人贷款组合的概率违约估计差异来衡量银行辛迪加内部的分歧。研究发现分歧影响贷款利率、合同设计、辛迪加构成和重新谈判结果。
AI.research_question: 银行辛迪加内部对借款人信用风险的分歧如何影响贷款定价、合同设计、辛迪加构成和重新谈判结果？
AI.motivation: 银行辛迪加贷款中，不同银行对同一借款人的信用风险评估可能存在分歧，这种分歧可能导致协调摩擦，影响贷款合同的设计和执行，但现有研究对此缺乏实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于协调摩擦理论，银行辛迪加内部的分歧会影响贷款定价、合同条款设计、银行退出决策和重新谈判过程。
AI.method: 使用美联储的机密监管数据，分析银行对同一借款人贷款组合报告的概率违约估计的离散度来衡量分歧，并检验分歧与贷款利率、合同条款、银行退出和重新谈判的关系。
AI.findings: 1. 分歧与贷款规模和辛迪加规模正相关；2. 分歧较高的贷款初始利差更高；3. 分歧降低合同中包含绩效定价条款的可能性；4. 更悲观的银行更可能退出辛迪加；5. 分歧降低借款人在基本面正负冲击后贷款修改的概率；6. 成功的重新谈判会缩小后续分歧。
AI.theory_contributions: 为协调摩擦理论提供了实证支持，揭示了银行辛迪加内部分歧对贷款合同全周期的影响机制，丰富了银行间协调和信息不对称的理论研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行辛迪加贷款定价、合同设计和管理提供了实践指导，帮助银行识别和管理协调风险，提高贷款组合管理效率。

title: Green Consumerism and Climate Change: A Bibliometric Review of Global Research (2000-2025)
affiliations: , affiliation not provided to SSRN, and

detail.title: Green Consumerism and Climate Change: A Bibliometric Review of Global Research (2000-2025)
detail.abstract: Green consumerism has gained huge momentum in sustainability research and policy discussions as environmental risks and climate change intensify. Over past twenty years researchers have conducted study into how climate perceptions, ecological awareness and sustainability norms affect consumer behavior. Despite the fast growth of this field a thorough overview of its ideas and research trends and aspects is still lacking. This study provides a bibliometric analysis of global research on green consumerism in relation to climate change from 2000 to 2025. Using Scopus as the main database we identified over 1,000 relevant publications through a structured Boolean search. These were screened using specific inclusion criteria and analyzed with VOS viewer and the Bibliometric (Biblioshiny) R package. The analysis shows a significant increase in publications after 2015 indicating rising urgency around climate issues and the impact of sustainable consumption movements. Science mapping techniques like keyword co-occurrence, co-citation and bibliographic coupling reveal four main clusters that are green purchase intention models, climate beliefs and environmental attitudes, sustainable lifestyles and low carbon consumption and circular economy and green marketing strategies. Thematic evolution analysis indicates a shift from traditional behavioral theories (TPB, VBN) in earlier years to modern themes like carbon neutrality, climate anxiety, eco innovation and circular consumption in the 2020s. This study establishes a future agenda for increasing research on climate-focused consumer behavior, improves understanding of global knowledge development and identifies emerging research areas. Researchers, decision-makers and companies can use these insights to adapt to shifting sustainability demands.

AI.tldr: 本文对2000-2025年绿色消费主义与气候变化相关研究进行了文献计量分析，发现2015年后相关研究显著增加，识别出四个主要研究集群，并揭示了从传统行为理论向碳中和、气候焦虑等现代主题的演变趋势。
AI.research_question: 全球绿色消费主义与气候变化研究领域的主要研究趋势、知识结构和演变模式是什么？
AI.motivation: 随着环境风险和气候变化加剧，绿色消费主义在可持续性研究和政策讨论中获得巨大关注。尽管该领域快速发展，但缺乏对其思想、研究趋势和方面的全面概述。
AI.theoretical_framework: 计划行为理论(TPB)、价值-信念-规范理论(VBN)等传统行为理论，以及碳中性、气候焦虑、生态创新和循环消费等现代主题。
AI.method: 文献计量分析，使用Scopus数据库识别1000多篇相关出版物，通过结构化布尔搜索筛选，使用VOSviewer和Bibliometric (Biblioshiny) R包进行分析，包括关键词共现、共被引和文献耦合等科学图谱技术。
AI.findings: 1. 2015年后出版物显著增加，表明气候问题紧迫性和可持续消费运动影响增强；2. 识别出四个主要研究集群：绿色购买意愿模型、气候信念与环境态度、可持续生活方式与低碳消费、循环经济与绿色营销策略；3. 主题演变分析显示从早期传统行为理论向2020年代现代主题的转变。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了绿色消费主义与气候变化研究的系统知识图谱；2. 揭示了该领域从传统行为理论向现代主题的演变路径；3. 识别了四个核心研究集群及其相互关系；4. 为未来研究提供了理论发展框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为研究人员提供了该领域的全面概览和研究方向；2. 帮助决策者了解全球知识发展趋势；3. 为企业适应可持续性需求变化提供洞察；4. 识别了新兴研究领域，指导未来研究议程。

title: Biotique and the Rise of Green Branding: A Case Study on Sustainability and Storytelling in India's Beauty Sector

detail.title: Biotique and the Rise of Green Branding: A Case Study on Sustainability and Storytelling in India's Beauty Sector
detail.abstract: Green branding is beyond changing and vital strategy innovated by businesses to react to consumers' needs to environment friendly and eco conscious products. Social media marketing campaigns regarding eco conscious products, environmentally friendly products and marketing is encouraging more customers towards consumption of the products/services. This paper discusses the case of the Indian ayuvedic beauty and wellness firm Biotique to see the green branding and how it has repositioned its market. The firm is widely recognized for mixing up stories of Ayurveda, organic way of life and purity within the products and thus established its identity that connects domestic as well as international customers. The firm uses combination of 5000-year-old science of Ayurveda and modern biotechnology to capture customers at international levels and to deliver serious skin care and hair care products. The study employs a qualitative case study method to bring into focus the green branding strategy employed, the storytelling approach estimated and the market positioning of Biotique. It is also targeted to understand brand positioning and market capture by such initiative in beauty sector. Findings indicate that the success of Biotique is due to its capacity to harmonize authenticity prompted by heritage and contemporary trends for sustainability, albeit with challenges in guaranteeing transparency and differentiation in a competitive marketplace. The company has well structured marketing campaign and influencer branding to attract more customers and repeat purchases for the products.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过印度阿育吠陀美容品牌Biotique的案例，探讨绿色品牌战略如何结合传统智慧与现代可持续趋势，成功实现市场重新定位。
AI.research_question: 绿色品牌战略如何通过结合传统阿育吠陀智慧与现代可持续趋势，帮助Biotique在美容行业实现市场重新定位和品牌差异化？
AI.motivation: 随着消费者对环保和生态友好产品的需求增长，企业需要创新的绿色品牌战略来应对市场变化。本研究旨在探讨绿色品牌在美容行业的实际应用和效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 绿色品牌理论、市场定位理论、品牌叙事理论、可持续消费理论
AI.method: 定性案例研究方法，深入分析Biotique公司的绿色品牌战略、叙事方法和市场定位策略
AI.findings: Biotique的成功源于将5000年阿育吠陀传统与现代生物技术结合，通过品牌叙事建立真实性，同时运用社交媒体营销和影响者品牌策略吸引客户。挑战在于保持透明度和在竞争市场中实现差异化。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了绿色品牌理论在传统智慧与现代可持续性结合方面的应用，提供了品牌叙事在绿色营销中的实证案例，扩展了美容行业可持续品牌定位的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为美容企业提供结合传统遗产与现代可持续趋势的绿色品牌战略模板，展示了社交媒体营销和影响者品牌在绿色产品推广中的有效应用，为企业如何在竞争市场中通过真实性实现差异化提供实践指导
