title: Finite Ventures
affiliations: University of Colorado Law School

detail.title: Finite Ventures

publicationDetails.detailsText: U of Colorado Law Legal Studies Research Paper
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Colorado Law School Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
The law endows corporations and other business organizations with the awesome power of perpetual life—unless the charter expressly provides for a certain duration, such as ten years. But does anyone ever actually choose limited life? Why would they?

This article reveals that limited-life business entities—finite ventures—play a significant and underappreciated role in modern commerce. Private equity and venture capital funds, SPACs, and insurance syndicates are all organized with a limited lifespan.Their motivation? This article claims that limited life is a valuable, but often overlooked, tool for ameliorating agency costs: the managers of a finite venture know they must produce results by the end of the term—their future career prospects depend on it—so they have an incentive to be diligent and loyal.

Even so, limited life has drawbacks—and perpetual life has benefits of its own—so the trick is to know when to use it. To guide decision-makers, this article identifies key factors that weigh in favor of or against finite structure. It closes by proposing novel applications of limited life as a tool of corporate governance—inviting scholars and practitioners alike to rethink the assumption of corporate immortality.

AI.tldr: 该文探讨了有限寿命商业实体（有限企业）在现代商业中的重要作用，认为有限寿命是降低代理成本的有效工具，并分析了何时应选择有限寿命结构。
AI.research_question: 为什么企业会选择有限寿命结构？有限寿命如何作为公司治理工具来降低代理成本？在什么情况下应该选择有限寿命而非永久存续？
AI.motivation: 法律赋予公司永久存续的权力，但现实中存在许多选择有限寿命的商业实体（如私募基金、SPACs、保险辛迪加）。这些有限企业的存在及其治理价值被学术界和实践界低估，需要系统研究其作用机制和适用条件。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代理成本理论：有限寿命通过创造时间约束来激励管理者，因为他们的职业前景取决于在有限期限内取得成果。公司治理理论：有限寿命作为一种治理机制，能够解决管理者与投资者之间的利益冲突。
AI.method: 理论分析：通过逻辑推理和理论框架构建，分析有限寿命作为治理工具的作用机制。案例研究：考察私募股权基金、风险投资基金、SPACs、保险辛迪加等有限寿命实体的实践。
AI.findings: 有限寿命商业实体在现代商业中扮演重要角色；有限寿命是降低代理成本的有效工具，因为管理者知道必须在期限内取得成果；有限寿命和永久存续各有优缺点，需要根据具体情况选择。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了"公司永续"的默认假设；将有限寿命概念化为公司治理工具；扩展了代理成本理论的应用范围；为有限寿命作为治理机制提供了理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为决策者提供了选择有限寿命或永久存续的指导框架；提出了有限寿命在公司治理中的创新应用；帮助实践者重新思考企业存续期限的设定；为有限寿命实体的设计提供了实用建议。

title: Doom Spending: Exploring Spending Behaviour of Millennials and Generation Z
affiliations: Dr.Vishwanath Karad MIT World Peace University,Pune, and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Doom Spending: Exploring Spending Behaviour of Millennials and Generation Z
detail.abstract:
Purpose:
Consumer behaviour of Millennials and Generation Z has been coined as “doom spending.” The uncertainty driven by anxiety on internal and external levels has given a behavioural nudge towards consumerism. Consequently, the researchers investigate the transformation in this spending behaviour. The objective of the article is to explore the drivers of doom spending and examine its psychological and behavioural aspects among Indian consumers.

Design:
Survey data was collected from 200 respondents in the age range of 20 to 50. Data was collected on three dimensions of spending by consumer- mental, emotional, and social. Additionally, in-depth understanding of these dimensions was received by collecting qualitative data. The data analysis included carrying out Exploratory factor analysis (EFA) with Principal Component Analysis (PCA) for arriving at the optimum variables within each dimension. Furthermore, content analysis was performed on the qualitative data set.

Findings:
The key results of the study reflect the consumption behaviour of both the generations inclining towards luxury spending predominantly influenced by peers. Moreover, it was also found that the external environment in the form of social and digital media enhances the internal parameters of sensitivity, stress, and impulsion towards consumerism. The key insights are explained by Stimulus-Organism-Response (SOR) model. The qualitative finding reveals ‘fear of future’ and ‘consumption as catharsis’ as major arguments for spending behaviour.

Originality:
This unique research demonstrates behavioural contradictions in fulfilment of SDG 12 of ‘responsible consumption’. The implications are relevant for policymakers to nudge the production towards sustainable spending of Millennials and Generation Z.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了印度千禧一代和Z世代消费者的"末日消费"行为，发现同辈压力、社交媒体等因素驱动了这种消费主义倾向，揭示了与可持续发展目标12（负责任消费）的行为矛盾。
AI.research_question: 印度千禧一代和Z世代消费者的"末日消费"行为的驱动因素是什么？其心理和行为特征如何？
AI.motivation: 千禧一代和Z世代消费者的行为被描述为"末日消费"，由内外焦虑驱动的不确定性促使他们转向消费主义。研究者希望探索这种消费行为的转变。
AI.theoretical_framework: 刺激-机体-反应（SOR）模型，用于解释外部刺激如何通过内部心理过程影响消费行为。
AI.method: 混合方法研究：收集了200名20-50岁受访者的调查数据，涵盖心理、情感和社会三个消费维度；同时收集定性数据。数据分析包括探索性因子分析（EFA）和主成分分析（PCA）确定各维度最优变量，并对定性数据进行内容分析。
AI.findings: 1. 两代人的消费行为都倾向于受同辈影响为主的奢侈品消费；2. 社交媒体等外部环境增强了敏感性、压力和消费冲动等内部参数；3. 定性研究发现"对未来恐惧"和"消费作为宣泄"是主要消费动机。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 应用SOR模型解释"末日消费"现象；2. 揭示了焦虑驱动消费的心理机制；3. 为理解代际消费行为提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 揭示了与SDG 12（负责任消费）目标的行为矛盾；2. 为政策制定者推动可持续消费提供依据；3. 帮助企业理解年轻消费者心理，制定相应营销策略。

title: Dark Data in Business -The Untapped Goldmine
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Dark Data in Business -The Untapped Goldmine
detail.abstract: In today’s data driven economy companies and businesses spawn a huge amount of data each and every second. But where do all these enormous amount of data go, they all remain as free – form text, amorphous and semi structured data. All these unstructured data is known as dark data these include old email correspondences, pdfs, call and chat logs, service line rates and margin conditions that are never processed and analysed. Even after being in a quiescent state this dark data holds a noteworthy and consequential potential for upholding hidden aspects which in turn improves the decision making and predictive analysis This paper formulates a strategic paradigm for acquiring the unknown appraisal of dark data acknowledging data analytics, Natural Language Processing (NLP), computer vision, and predictive analytics, artificial intelligence, dark data audit and cultural shift. Additionally, this case work brings out the need for organizations to transpose their perspective of viewing dark data and acknowledge them as an untapped goldmine with progressive potential.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种战略范式，通过数据分析、自然语言处理、计算机视觉、预测分析和人工智能等技术，挖掘"暗数据"（未被处理和分析的非结构化数据）的潜在价值，帮助企业改善决策和预测分析。
AI.research_question: 如何有效挖掘和利用组织中的暗数据（非结构化数据）来改善决策制定和预测分析？
AI.motivation: 在当前数据驱动经济中，企业每天产生大量非结构化数据（如邮件、PDF、聊天记录等），这些"暗数据"虽然处于休眠状态，但蕴含着改善决策和预测分析的重要潜力，目前却未被充分利用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 暗数据理论、数据分析框架、人工智能应用理论、组织变革理论
AI.method: 提出战略范式，整合数据分析、自然语言处理(NLP)、计算机视觉、预测分析、人工智能、暗数据审计和文化转变等多维度方法
AI.findings: 暗数据蕴含着显著的潜在价值，通过适当的技术和方法可以挖掘其中的隐藏信息，从而改善决策制定和预测分析能力
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了暗数据价值挖掘的综合理论框架，整合了技术应用和组织变革的双重视角，为暗数据研究提供了系统的理论范式
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了具体的战略方法和技术工具来挖掘暗数据价值，促进组织文化转变，将暗数据视为未开发的金矿，提升决策质量和预测能力

title: Which Ideas Attract Workers? Gender and Labor Supply in Startups
affiliations: University of California, Berkeley - Haas School of Business, Stanford University, University of California, Berkeley - Haas School of Business and Harvard University - Business School (HBS)

detail.title: Which Ideas Attract Workers? Gender and Labor Supply in Startups

publicationDetails.detailsText: Harvard Business School Entrepreneurial Management Working Paper No. 26-051
publicationDetails.journalName: Harvard Business School: Entrepreneurial Management Unit Working Paper Series

publicationDetails.detailsText: Harvard Business School Working Paper No. 26-051
publicationDetails.journalName: Harvard Business School Working Papers

detail.abstract: Which startups can attract the talent they need to grow? We argue that worker preferences over which problems to solve shape labor supply to early-stage firms. In male-dominated labor markets, startups focused on women may struggle to recruit, especially for critical, male-dominated roles like engineering and senior leadership. We combine observational data on over 52,000 U.S. high-potential startups with a pre-registered field experiment. Linking startups to over 2.5 million worker histories, we find that female-focused startups employ fewer workers: a one standard deviation increase in a startup’s female-focus predicts 11% fewer male employees. To isolate worker preferences, we run a field experiment where we randomize the startup idea itself, thereby developing a new experimental paradigm to causally identify how the nature of an idea matters. We built a job-search platform recruiting real tech job seekers in a within-subject design, where each participant evaluates 15 startup ideas, each randomized to be more or less female-focused. Crucially, our experiment is incentive-compatible, because participants’ evaluations affect which real job postings our platform subsequently recommends to them. Male job seekers are 6.8 percentage points less likely to apply to female-focused startups than other startups, a 10% decrease from baseline. Offsetting the male penalty would require approximately $47,000 in additional yearly compensation. Our findings demonstrate that who benefits from an idea is an important nonpecuniary job attribute shaping talent acquisition, potentially helping explain why ventures serving women grow more slowly.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，在男性主导的劳动力市场中，专注于女性市场的初创企业难以吸引男性员工，特别是工程师和高级领导等关键职位。通过观察数据和实地实验发现，女性导向的初创企业男性员工减少11%，男性求职者申请意愿降低6.8个百分点，相当于需要增加4.7万美元年薪才能抵消这一劣势。
AI.research_question: 哪些初创企业能够吸引到发展所需的人才？专注于女性市场的初创企业是否在劳动力招募方面面临挑战，特别是在男性主导的职位上？
AI.motivation: 理解为什么服务于女性的企业增长较慢，探讨员工对解决何种问题的偏好如何影响早期企业的劳动力供给。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力供给理论、员工非货币性工作属性偏好、性别与劳动力市场动态、初创企业人才获取障碍
AI.method:
1. 观察性研究：分析52,000多家美国高潜力初创企业数据，链接250多万名员工历史记录
2. 实地实验：预先注册的随机对照实验，在求职平台随机化展示不同性别导向的初创企业理念，采用被试内设计，每个参与者评估15个创业想法
AI.findings:
1. 女性导向的初创企业男性员工减少11%（一个标准差变化）
2. 男性求职者对女性导向初创企业的申请意愿降低6.8个百分点（下降10%）
3. 需要增加约47,000美元年薪才能抵消男性申请意愿的下降
4. 实验验证了员工对服务对象的偏好是重要的非货币性工作属性
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出并验证"谁从创意中受益"作为重要的非货币性工作属性
2. 开发了新的实验范式来因果识别创意性质的重要性
3. 为理解性别化劳动力市场动态提供了理论框架
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 帮助女性导向初创企业理解人才获取挑战
2. 提供量化指标：需要增加约4.7万美元薪酬来抵消性别导向带来的招聘劣势
3. 为创业者和投资者提供决策依据，特别是关于服务于特定性别市场的企业增长潜力

title: Work Design and Compensation Strategies in a Post-COVID World: Evidence From Online Job Postings
affiliations: South China University of Technology, South China University of Technology, City University of Hong Kong, City University of Hong Kong and

detail.title: Work Design and Compensation Strategies in a Post-COVID World: Evidence From Online Job Postings

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflicts of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: We gratefully acknowledge funding support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China, 72422022, 72272055, 72202041, 72321001; National Social Science Fund of China, 23ZDA063; Research Grants Council of the Hong Kong SAR, China, CityU11501121.

detail.abstract: This study examines how the COVID-19 pandemic, as a disruptive external shock, has reshaped organizational practices, with particular emphasis on changes in work design and compensation strategies. Drawing on a unique dataset of over 1.8 million online job postings from Chinese publicly listed firms, we employed a large language model to systematically quantify work design characteristics. Using a difference-indifferences approach, we found that the pandemic significantly enhanced skill variety, task identity, task significance, autonomy, feedback, and work-from-home feasibility. Notably, these effects varied by occupational nonroutineness: occupations with high nonroutineness exhibited larger increases in task significance but smaller increases in other work design characteristics. Moreover, work design characteristics mediated the relationship between the pandemic and salaries, though these indirect effects were attenuated for nonroutine occupations. Additionally, we observed post-pandemic adjustments in firms' compensation, including notable declines in performance-related pay and insurance benefits, accompanied by increases in subsidies. These findings provide new insights into how organizations redesign work and adjust compensation strategies in response to large-scale external shocks.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用180万条中国上市公司在线招聘数据，通过大语言模型量化工作设计特征，发现新冠疫情显著提升了技能多样性、任务完整性、任务重要性、自主性、反馈和居家办公可行性，这些变化因职业非例行性而异，并中介了疫情与薪资的关系，同时企业薪酬策略也出现调整。
AI.research_question: 新冠疫情作为破坏性外部冲击如何重塑组织实践，特别是工作设计和薪酬策略的变化？
AI.motivation: 理解大规模外部冲击（如新冠疫情）如何影响组织实践，特别是工作设计和薪酬策略的调整，为组织应对未来类似冲击提供参考。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于工作设计理论（技能多样性、任务完整性、任务重要性、自主性、反馈），结合职业非例行性理论，探讨外部冲击对组织实践的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用180万条中国上市公司在线招聘数据，采用大语言模型系统量化工作设计特征，运用双重差分法分析疫情影响，并检验职业非例行性的调节作用和工作设计特征的中介作用。
AI.findings: 1. 疫情显著提升技能多样性、任务完整性、任务重要性、自主性、反馈和居家办公可行性；2. 职业非例行性调节这些效应：高非例行性职业任务重要性提升更大，但其他特征提升较小；3. 工作设计特征中介疫情与薪资关系，但非例行职业中介效应减弱；4. 疫情后企业薪酬策略调整：绩效相关薪酬和保险福利下降，补贴增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展工作设计理论，揭示外部冲击对工作特征的系统性影响；2. 阐明职业非例行性在冲击响应中的调节作用；3. 建立工作设计特征作为冲击与薪酬关系的中介机制；4. 丰富组织适应理论在极端环境下的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业应对未来外部冲击提供工作设计和薪酬调整的实证依据；2. 帮助管理者根据职业特性制定差异化的人力资源策略；3. 为政策制定者设计劳动力市场干预措施提供参考；4. 指导组织在危机中优化工作安排和薪酬结构。

title: Institutional Stitching as Ecosystem Formation: Father de Rotz's Initiatives in Nagasaki: Relational Philanthropy and Co-Production in an Ecosystem for New Philanthropy

detail.title: Institutional Stitching as Ecosystem Formation: Father de Rotz's Initiatives in Nagasaki: Relational Philanthropy and Co-Production in an Ecosystem for New Philanthropy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based on publicly available documents and historical sources. The fieldwork interview was conducted with informed consent, and no personal or sensitive data are reported. Accordingly, formal institutional ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by JSPS KAKENHI (Grant Number JP23K01528).

detail.abstract: This working paper offers a hypothesis-generating reinterpretation of Father Marc Marie de Rotz’s (1840–1914) initiatives in Sotome, Nagasaki, through the combined lenses of relational (reciprocal) philanthropy and ecosystem-oriented institutional design. Focusing on the Shitsu Relief Institute (est. 1883) as a coordinating hub, it shows how livelihood support and skills training were bundled with education, basic healthcare, and community infrastructure to address institutional gaps in an isolated coastal community. Drawing on relational grantmaking (e.g., Petzinger & Jung, 2024), co-production theory, and institutional work, the paper conceptualizes these practices as institutional stitching: (1) sustained co-presence that enables trust and local knowledge circulation; (2) beneficiary co-production that transforms beneficiaries into local agents; (3) multi-domain coupling that creates resilient pathways among livelihoods, learning, and care; and (4) long-term repair and maintenance that stabilizes emerging rules, capacities, and legitimacy. The paper contributes an integrative concept linking relational mechanisms (reciprocity, trust, power-sharing) with ecosystem mechanisms (cross-domain linkages, spatial configuration, and implementation capacity), and concludes with implications for contemporary place-based care ecosystems and Ecosystem for New Philanthropy (ENP)-oriented design.

AI.tldr: 本文通过关系慈善和生态系统制度设计的视角，重新解读Rotz神父在长崎外海的社区发展实践，提出"制度缝合"概念，将生计支持、技能培训与教育、医疗、基础设施结合，填补偏远社区的体制空白。
AI.research_question: Rotz神父在长崎外海的社区发展实践如何通过关系慈善和生态系统制度设计填补偏远社区的体制空白？
AI.motivation: 研究偏远社区发展中的制度空白问题，探索如何通过整合性方法解决生计、教育、医疗等多领域挑战，为当代基于地方的关怀生态系统提供启示。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关系慈善（互惠性）、生态系统制度设计、关系资助、共同生产理论、制度工作理论。
AI.method: 历史案例研究，以1883年成立的志津救济院为协调中心，分析Rotz神父在长崎外海的社区发展实践。
AI.findings: 提出了"制度缝合"的四个维度：持续共在促进信任和本地知识流通；受益人共同生产将受益人转变为本地代理人；多领域耦合创造生计、学习和关怀的韧性路径；长期修复和维护稳定新兴规则、能力和合法性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"制度缝合"的整合概念，将关系机制（互惠、信任、权力共享）与生态系统机制（跨领域连接、空间配置、实施能力）联系起来。
AI.practical_contributions: 为当代基于地方的关怀生态系统和新慈善生态系统导向设计提供实践启示，展示了如何通过整合性方法解决偏远社区的多重挑战。

title: The Institutionalization Revelation: How ETFs Exposed Bitcoin's Speculative Nature within the Debasement Trade
affiliations: Marquette University

detail.title: The Institutionalization Revelation: How ETFs Exposed Bitcoin's Speculative Nature within the Debasement Trade
detail.abstract: The post-2020 global financial landscape, characterized by unprecedented monetary and fiscal expansion, has given rise to the "debasement trade" narrative, the investment thesis that excessive government debt growth devalues fiat currencies relative to scarce assets. Within this framework, Bitcoin has occupied a conceptual dual identity: as a digital monetary commodity akin to gold (the "digital gold" hypothesis) and as a speculative technology growth asset. The January 2024 approval of U.S. spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds (ETFs) created a natural experiment to test whether institutional adoption transforms or reveals an asset's fundamental characteristics within the debasement trade framework. Analyzing daily returns from January 2020 to January 2026 across five asset classes, this study examines Bitcoin's behavior before and after ETF approval. Contrary to transformation theories, results indicate institutionalization weakened Bitcoin's debasement hedge properties (beta changed from-1.61 to +0.63, p<.01), failed to increase its correlation with gold (0.156 to 0.091, p=.219), and diminished its optimal portfolio weight from 31.2% to 2.9%. Bitcoin's volatility decreased (74.6% to 47.6% annualized) but remained characteristic of speculative assets, and correlation with the S&P 500 showed no significant increase (0.378 to 0.362, p=.736). These findings support an "institutionalization revelation" hypothesis: rather than transforming Bitcoin into a monetary asset, institutional participation reveals its true nature as a speculative technology innovation. The results challenge the "digital gold" narrative within the debasement trade framework and suggest Bitcoin's value proposition remains technological rather than monetary, with implications for portfolio construction, risk management, and financial regulation.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过分析2020-2026年比特币ETF批准前后的数据发现，机构化并未将比特币转变为"数字黄金"式的货币资产，反而揭示了其投机性技术创新的本质，削弱了其对货币贬值的对冲属性。
AI.research_question: 机构采用（通过比特币ETF批准）是否会改变比特币在货币贬值交易框架中的基本特性，将其从投机性技术资产转变为"数字黄金"式的货币资产？
AI.motivation: 后2020年全球金融格局中，政府债务激增引发"货币贬值交易"叙事，比特币被赋予双重身份：数字黄金（货币商品）和投机性技术增长资产。2024年1月美国现货比特币ETF的批准为检验机构化是否改变资产特性提供了自然实验机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币贬值交易框架（debasement trade framework）、数字黄金假说、机构化理论（机构参与可能改变或揭示资产本质）、资产分类理论（货币资产vs投机资产）
AI.method: 自然实验设计，分析2020年1月至2026年1月五个资产类别的日收益率数据，比较比特币ETF批准前后的行为变化，包括beta系数、相关性、波动率、最优投资组合权重等统计指标。
AI.findings: 1. 机构化削弱了比特币的货币贬值对冲属性（beta从-1.61变为+0.63）；2. 与黄金相关性未显著增加（0.156到0.091）；3. 最优投资组合权重从31.2%降至2.9%；4. 波动率下降但仍具投机性特征；5. 与标普500相关性无显著变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"机构化揭示"假说：机构参与不是将比特币转变为货币资产，而是揭示其作为投机性技术创新的真实本质；挑战了货币贬值交易框架内的"数字黄金"叙事；为资产分类和机构化影响理论提供新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 投资组合构建：比特币在多元化投资组合中的权重应降低；2. 风险管理：比特币仍具高投机性，需相应风险管理策略；3. 金融监管：应将其视为技术创新资产而非货币资产进行监管；4. 投资者教育：纠正"数字黄金"的错误认知。

title: Administrative Justice and the Boards of Appeal of EU Agencies
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Administrative Justice and the Boards of Appeal of EU Agencies
detail.abstract:
This book provides the first comprehensive analysis of EU Boards of Appeal—specialized review bodies within European agencies processing thousands of decisions annually across trademark protection (EUIPO), chemical safety (ECHA), aviation (EASA), financial supervision (ESAs), energy (ACER), and other domains.

The study examines Boards' constitutional foundations, empirical performance, and institutional challenges through doctrinal analysis, data from the University of Ferrara Common Database, and comparison with UK, French, German, and US systems.

Three fundamental questions structure the inquiry. First, what is Boards' legal nature? They constitute sui generis hybrids combining administrative expertise with quasi-judicial procedures. Second, do Boards satisfy Article 47 Charter requirements? Generally yes, though independence from parent agencies remains problematic. The Article 58a filter limiting Court of Justice access (1-2% admission rate) raises constitutional concerns. Third, what review standard applies? Aquind (2018) mandated "full review," causing the empirically documented "Aquind Spike"—18% increase in processing times.

Empirical assessment through 2025 shows strong performance: 6-12 month processing versus judicial 24+ months, 55-70% confirmation rates indicating balanced review, 75-85% judicial confirmation validating quality. Substantive contributions include EUIPO's NFT/metaverse doctrine (2024-2025), ECHA's PFAS jurisprudence (2025), ACER's hydrogen regulation (2024), and cross-Board AI evidence standards.

Comparative analysis reveals critical findings. Transatlantic convergence: EU's Aquind (2018) and US Loper Bright (2024) both rejected administrative deference within six years. Yet divergence persists as US questions administrative adjudication (Jarkesy) while EU consolidates it. Spanish perspective reveals institutional gaps—no specialized tribunals, only direct judicial review.

Three existential reforms emerge. "Ring-fenced Fee Model" provides budgetary independence. "Regulation on Administrative Procedure for Union Bodies" (2028) eliminates arbitrary variations. "Common Protocol on Algorithmic Adjudication" addresses the Aquind-AI Paradox: full review mandates colliding with opaque AI governance.

Writing in January 2026, Boards face decisive challenges. When ECHA reviews toxicity, EASA evaluates safety, ESAs assess stability, administrative justice quality becomes literally life and death. Success requires evolution toward coherence, independence, and technological capability.

 KEYWORDS: EU administrative law, Boards of Appeal, EUIPO, ECHA, Article 47, Aquind, Article 58a, AI governance, Loper Bright

AI.tldr: 本书首次全面分析欧盟上诉委员会——欧盟机构内的专门审查机构，每年处理商标保护、化学品安全、航空、金融监管等领域的数千项决定。研究通过法律分析、实证数据和比较法方法，探讨了其宪法基础、绩效表现和制度挑战，提出了三项根本改革方案。
AI.research_question: 欧盟上诉委员会的法律性质是什么？它们是否满足《欧盟基本权利宪章》第47条的要求？适用何种审查标准？
AI.motivation: 欧盟上诉委员会作为欧盟机构内的专门审查机构，每年处理大量重要决定，涉及商标保护、化学品安全、航空安全、金融稳定等关键领域，其运作质量直接影响行政正义和公民权利保护，但目前缺乏全面系统的分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧盟行政法理论、行政司法理论、比较行政法（英美法系与大陆法系比较）、宪法权利保护理论（特别是《欧盟基本权利宪章》第47条）、行政审查标准理论（"全面审查"原则）
AI.method: 法律教义分析、实证数据分析（使用费拉拉大学共同数据库）、比较法分析（英国、法国、德国、美国制度比较）、案例研究（Aquind案、Loper Bright案等）
AI.findings: 1. 上诉委员会是独特的混合体，结合行政专业知识和准司法程序；2. 总体上满足《宪章》第47条要求，但独立性存在问题；3. Aquind案确立的"全面审查"标准导致处理时间增加18%；4. 实证显示良好绩效：6-12个月处理时间，55-70%确认率；5. 跨大西洋趋同：欧盟Aquind案和美国Loper Bright案都在6年内拒绝行政尊重原则。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统构建欧盟上诉委员会的理论框架；2. 提出"行政-准司法混合体"概念；3. 揭示Aquind案确立的"全面审查"标准对行政效率的影响；4. 识别"Aquind-AI悖论"：全面审查要求与不透明AI治理的冲突；5. 比较法视角下的跨大西洋行政法趋同与分歧分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提出三项根本改革方案："围栏式收费模式"确保预算独立性；"欧盟机构行政程序条例"消除任意差异；"算法裁决共同议定书"解决AI治理问题；2. 为各领域（NFT/元宇宙、PFAS、氢能监管等）提供具体实务指导；3. 为政策制定者提供实证依据和改革路线图。

title: A Comparative Analysis of Stablecoin Interest Prohibition Under MiCA and the GENIUS Act
affiliations: Marquette University

detail.title: A Comparative Analysis of Stablecoin Interest Prohibition Under MiCA and the GENIUS Act
detail.abstract: The prohibition of interest-bearing stablecoins marks a critical juncture in digital asset regulation, exposing fundamental tensions between financial innovation and systemic stability. This paper provides the first comparative legal and financial analysis of the European Union's Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA) and the United States' GENIUS Act of 2025, examining how two major jurisdictions reach convergent prohibitions on yield-bearing stablecoins through markedly divergent regulatory architectures. While both frameworks forbid direct interest payments to holders, they diverge sharply in their treatment of decentralized finance (DeFi) protocols, reserve composition requirements, and supervisory allocation. The paper advances three interconnected contributions: (1) a technical examination of reserve management mechanisms and their implications for run dynamics; (2) a scenario-based stress test identifying contagion pathways from stablecoin markets to traditional banking systems; and (3) an analysis of the "DeFi gap," the substantial regulatory perimeter failure whereby third-party protocols offer functionally equivalent yields outside statutory prohibitions. With stablecoin market capitalization exceeding $300 billion, rivaling the deposit bases of mid-sized national banking systems-the regulatory treatment of these instruments will determine whether they evolve as competitors to traditional banks or as complementary infrastructure within a restructured financial system.

AI.tldr: 该论文首次对欧盟MiCA法规和美国GENIUS法案进行对比分析，研究两大司法管辖区如何通过不同监管架构实现对生息稳定币的禁令，重点关注储备管理机制、压力测试和DeFi监管缺口。
AI.research_question: 欧盟MiCA法规和美国GENIUS法案如何通过不同的监管架构实现对生息稳定币的禁令？这些禁令对金融稳定、传统银行系统和DeFi生态系统有何影响？
AI.motivation: 稳定币市值已超过3000亿美元，堪比中型国家银行系统的存款规模。生息稳定币禁令是数字资产监管的关键节点，暴露了金融创新与系统稳定性之间的根本张力，需要深入研究其监管方法和潜在影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融监管理论、系统性风险理论、金融创新与监管的张力理论、银行挤兑动态理论、监管套利理论
AI.method: 比较法律和金融分析（欧盟MiCA vs 美国GENIUS法案）、技术性储备管理机制检查、基于情景的压力测试、监管缺口分析
AI.findings:
1. 两大司法管辖区都禁止直接向持有者支付利息，但在DeFi协议处理、储备构成要求和监管分配方面存在显著差异
2. 储备管理机制对挤兑动态有重要影响
3. 压力测试识别出稳定币市场向传统银行系统的传染路径
4. 存在"DeFi缺口"——第三方协议在法定禁令之外提供功能等效的收益率
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 首次对两大主要司法管辖区的稳定币监管进行系统比较分析
2. 提出"DeFi缺口"概念，描述监管边界失效现象
3. 分析不同监管架构如何实现相同的政策目标
4. 为金融创新与监管的张力理论提供实证案例
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为监管机构提供储备管理机制的技术分析
2. 通过情景压力测试识别系统性风险传染路径
3. 揭示DeFi监管缺口，为完善监管框架提供建议
4. 帮助政策制定者理解稳定币可能作为传统银行竞争者还是补充基础设施的发展路径

title: Institutional Crypto Asset Integration in U.S. Pension Funds and University Endowments: Evidence from SEC 13F Filings, Q1 2024 through Q4 2025
affiliations: Marquette University

detail.title: Institutional Crypto Asset Integration in U.S. Pension Funds and University Endowments: Evidence from SEC 13F Filings, Q1 2024 through Q4 2025
detail.abstract: The January 10, 2024 approval of spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds (ETFs) by the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission created the first regulated, operationally accessible vehicle for institutional investors to obtain direct Bitcoin price exposure through conventional brokerage infrastructure. This study provides a comprehensive empirical analysis of institutional crypto asset adoption in the two years following that regulatory turning point, examining quarterly SEC Form 13F-HR filings for a sample of 20 major institutional investors comprising 15 U.S. public pension funds and 5 university endowments across eight quarters from Q1 2024 through Q4 2025. Aggregate institutional crypto asset holdings grew from $450,216,676 at the Q1 2024 baseline to a peak of $1,478,823,205 in Q3 2025, before declining 34.7% to $965,495,831 in Q4 2025. Three findings carry first-order significance for researchers and policymakers. First, pension funds and university endowments pursued categorically distinct investment vehicle strategies throughout the study period: pension funds concentrated in MicroStrategy equity (MSTR) as a leveraged Bitcoin proxy, with MSTR representing up to 58.4% of aggregate pension holdings, while endowments held exclusively in spot ETFs. This vehicle bifurcation produced a 24.2 percentage-point performance differential during the Q4 2025 drawdown, with pension funds declining 43.0% versus endowments declining 18.8%. Second, share-count decomposition reveals heterogeneous institutional behavior, with 18 instances of active accumulation and 23 of deliberate reduction during Q4 2025, confirming that institutional crypto allocation involves active portfolio management rather than passive price exposure. Third, Harvard Management Company's Q4 2025 simultaneous reduction of iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT) and initiation of a $86.8 million iShares Ethereum Trust (ETHA) position represents the first major intra-crypto portfolio rotation in the sample and may foreshadow broader multi-asset institutional crypto adoption. The results advance understanding of how large fiduciaries navigate novel asset classes under conditions of regulatory ambiguity and investment policy constraint.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了美国SEC批准比特币现货ETF后两年内（2024Q1-2025Q4）20家主要机构投资者（15家公共养老基金和5所大学捐赠基金）的加密货币资产配置行为。研究发现机构持有量从4.5亿美元增长至14.8亿美元峰值后回落至9.65亿美元，养老基金偏好MicroStrategy股票作为杠杆比特币代理，而捐赠基金只投资现货ETF，导致业绩差异显著。研究还发现机构存在主动管理行为，以及哈佛管理公司首次进行加密货币内部轮换。
AI.research_question: 在美国SEC批准比特币现货ETF后，主要机构投资者（公共养老基金和大学捐赠基金）如何配置加密货币资产？他们的投资策略、行为模式及业绩表现有何差异？
AI.motivation: 2024年1月10日美国SEC批准比特币现货ETF，首次为机构投资者提供了通过传统经纪基础设施获取直接比特币价格敞口的受监管、可操作的渠道。这一监管转折点为研究机构加密货币采用提供了重要契机，但缺乏对大型受托机构在此新资产类别中实际行为的实证分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机构投资理论、资产配置理论、监管影响理论、投资行为理论、风险管理理论、受托责任理论
AI.method: 实证分析：基于SEC Form 13F-HR季度申报文件，分析20家主要机构投资者（15家美国公共养老基金和5所大学捐赠基金）在8个季度（2024Q1-2025Q4）的加密货币资产持有数据。采用描述性统计、比较分析、份额分解等方法。
AI.findings: 1. 机构加密货币持有总量从2024Q1的4.5亿美元增长至2025Q3的14.8亿美元峰值，后下降34.7%至2025Q4的9.65亿美元；2. 养老基金偏好MicroStrategy股票作为杠杆比特币代理（占养老基金持有量最高达58.4%），而捐赠基金只投资现货ETF，导致2025Q4下跌期间业绩差异24.2个百分点（养老基金下跌43.0% vs 捐赠基金下跌18.8%）；3. 机构存在主动管理行为，2025Q4有18次主动增持和23次主动减持；4. 哈佛管理公司首次进行加密货币内部轮换，减持iShares比特币信托同时新建8680万美元iShares以太坊信托头寸。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统分析了监管转折点后大型受托机构的加密货币采用行为；2. 揭示了不同类型机构在投资工具选择上的策略差异及其业绩影响；3. 证实了机构加密货币配置涉及主动投资组合管理而非被动价格敞口；4. 提供了机构在监管模糊性和投资政策约束下应对新资产类别的行为模式理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为机构投资者提供加密货币配置策略的实证参考；2. 为监管机构了解机构加密货币采用模式提供数据支持；3. 帮助投资顾问理解不同类型机构的风险偏好和工具选择；4. 为资产管理者设计适合机构需求的加密货币产品提供市场洞察；5. 为学术界提供机构加密货币投资行为的研究基础。

title: Institutional Crypto Asset Integration: Fiduciary Prudence and the Price of Product Choice
affiliations: Marquette University

detail.title: Institutional Crypto Asset Integration: Fiduciary Prudence and the Price of Product Choice
detail.abstract: The January 2024 regulatory approval of spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds (ETFs) created the first regulated, operationally accessible vehicle for institutional fiduciaries to obtain direct Bitcoin price exposure. This article examines the two-year period following that transition, drawing on SEC Form 13F filings from 15 public pension funds and five university endowments. While aggregate institutional crypto holdings reached a peak of $1.48 billion in late 2025, a subsequent market correction revealed a stark performance differential between institution types. The gap between pension funds (-43.0%) and endowments (-18.8%) traces directly to a single governance decision: the choice of investment vehicle. This article documents that divergence and draws practical implications for fiduciaries, investment committee members, and board trustees.

AI.tldr: 比特币现货ETF获批后，机构投资者通过不同投资工具配置比特币，养老金和大学捐赠基金在2025年市场回调中表现出显著绩效差异（-43.0% vs -18.8%），主要源于投资工具选择这一治理决策。
AI.research_question: 比特币现货ETF获批后，不同类型的机构投资者（养老金vs捐赠基金）在比特币投资中的绩效差异及其驱动因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 2024年1月比特币现货ETF获批，首次为机构受托人提供了受监管、操作便捷的直接比特币价格敞口工具，但不同机构类型在后续市场波动中的表现差异值得研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机构投资决策理论、治理结构理论、投资工具选择理论、受托责任理论
AI.method: 基于SEC Form 13F文件，分析15个公共养老金和5个大学捐赠基金在比特币现货ETF获批后两年的投资数据
AI.findings: 1. 机构加密资产持有在2025年底达到14.8亿美元峰值；2. 市场回调后，养老金亏损43.0%，捐赠基金亏损18.8%；3. 绩效差异主要源于投资工具选择这一治理决策
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了机构类型与投资绩效的关系；2. 强调了治理决策在加密资产投资中的关键作用；3. 丰富了机构投资决策理论在新型资产类别中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为机构受托人提供投资工具选择的实践指导；2. 帮助投资委员会成员和董事会理事理解治理决策的重要性；3. 为机构投资者在加密资产配置中提供风险管理参考

title: Stablecoins vs. Traditional P2P Payment Systems: A Critical Analysis of the Push for U.S. Retail Adoption
affiliations: Marquette University

detail.title: Stablecoins vs. Traditional P2P Payment Systems: A Critical Analysis of the Push for U.S. Retail Adoption
detail.abstract: The passage of the Guiding and Establishing National Innovation for U.S. Stablecoins (GENIUS) Act in July 2025 and subsequent state-level initiatives have positioned stablecoins for potentially significant integration into the U.S. financial system. Proponents frame these developments as financial innovation and evidence of American technological leadership. This paper critically examines a fundamental question: why would a U.S. consumer need a stablecoin for retail transactions when established peer-to-peer payment systems such as Venmo, PayPal, and Zelle already provide secure, instantaneous, and widely accepted digital payment services? Drawing on a mixed-methods approach that incorporates market data, legislative analysis, documented campaign finance activity, and comparative case studies, this paper argues that the push for stablecoin adoption in U.S. retail payments lacks a compelling consumer-centric rationale. The genuine advantages of stablecoins, including lower cross-border transaction costs, inflation hedging in economies with unstable currencies, and institutional efficiency gains, are largely irrelevant to the average U.S. consumer. Instead, the momentum behind stablecoin adoption appears to be driven by two interrelated forces: concentrated industry interests seeking regulatory capture, evidenced by substantial and documented political spending, and political dynamics in which support for financial innovation serves as a mechanism for alignment with influential stakeholders and the broader pursuit of U.S. digital finance leadership. The paper concludes that policymakers should prioritize consumer protection over industry rents and that U.S. consumers currently have limited reason to substitute existing P2P systems with stablecoins.

AI.tldr: 该论文批判性分析了美国稳定币零售支付的推动力，认为缺乏消费者需求基础，主要是行业利益和政治动机驱动，而非真正的消费者利益。
AI.research_question: 为什么美国消费者在已有成熟P2P支付系统（如Venmo、PayPal、Zelle）的情况下，还需要稳定币进行零售交易？
AI.motivation: GENIUS法案通过后，稳定币可能大规模融入美国金融体系，支持者将其视为金融创新和技术领导力的体现，但需要检验其消费者需求合理性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 监管俘获理论（regulatory capture）、政治经济学分析、产业利益驱动理论
AI.method: 混合方法：市场数据分析、立法分析、竞选资金活动记录分析、比较案例研究
AI.findings: 稳定币在美国零售支付中的采用缺乏消费者中心化的理由；其真正优势（跨境成本低、通胀对冲、机构效率）对美国消费者无关；推动力主要来自行业利益寻求监管俘获和政治动机。
AI.theory_contributions: 将监管俘获理论应用于新兴数字金融领域，揭示了稳定币推广背后的政治经济学机制，挑战了"金融创新必然有益消费者"的假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供警示：应优先考虑消费者保护而非行业租金；美国消费者目前没有充分理由用稳定币替代现有P2P系统。

title: When States Buy Bitcoin: Political Signaling, Fiscal Risk, and the Empirical Failure of Strategic Cryptocurrency Reserves
affiliations: Marquette University

detail.title: When States Buy Bitcoin: Political Signaling, Fiscal Risk, and the Empirical Failure of Strategic Cryptocurrency Reserves
detail.abstract: This paper provides a comprehensive empirical and theoretical critique of proposals to establish state-level Bitcoin strategic reserves. Using Missouri House Bill 2080 as a contemporary case study, the author analyzes the performance of $10 million hypothetical investments in Bitcoin, gold (GLD ETF), and 3-month Treasury bills across five strategic investment dates during 2025 and 2026. The results are consistent across all scenarios: Bitcoin investments lost an average of 30.5% of principal, gold gained an average of 51.1%, and Treasury bills preserved capital with modest positive returns, Risk metrics reveal Bitcoin's annualized volatility of 43.92%, nearly double gold's 24.40% and more than 100 times Treasury bills' annualized volatility of 0.41%, with a 95% Value at Risk of $461,371 per day for a $10 million position. Drawing on event study evidence from Texas's $5 million Bitcoin purchase, which generated statistically insignificant market reactions, this paper argues that state-level cryptocurrency reserves represent political signaling rather than sound fiscal management. The paper contributes to public finance theory by identifying the "libertarian-state paradox," whereby governments adopting an explicitly anti-state technology undermine both the technology's core principles and their own fiduciary duties. The paper concludes with a template for evaluating future cryptocurrency policy proposals based on scale and market response tests.

AI.tldr: 该论文批判性地分析了州级比特币战略储备提案，通过实证研究发现比特币投资表现远逊于黄金和国债，认为此类政策更多是政治信号而非审慎财政管理，并提出了"自由意志主义-国家悖论"理论贡献。
AI.research_question: 州级比特币战略储备是否代表审慎的财政管理，还是仅仅是政治信号？
AI.motivation: 随着密苏里州众议院第2080号法案等州级比特币储备提案的出现，需要实证评估此类政策的财务合理性和实际效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共财政理论、投资组合理论、风险管理理论，以及新提出的"自由意志主义-国家悖论"概念。
AI.method: 1. 案例研究：以密苏里州HB 2080法案为案例；2. 假设投资分析：比较1000万美元在比特币、黄金(GLD ETF)和3个月期国债上的表现；3. 事件研究法：分析德克萨斯州500万美元比特币购买的市场反应；4. 风险度量：计算年化波动率、每日95% VaR等指标。
AI.findings: 1. 比特币投资平均亏损30.5%，黄金平均收益51.1%，国债保持资本并获适度正收益；2. 比特币年化波动率43.92%，是黄金(24.40%)的近两倍，是国债(0.41%)的100多倍；3. 1000万美元比特币头寸的每日95% VaR为461,371美元；4. 德克萨斯州比特币购买未产生显著市场反应。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"自由意志主义-国家悖论"：政府采用明确反国家性质的技术，既破坏了该技术的核心原则，也违背了自身的信托责任。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为评估未来加密货币政策提案提供了基于规模和市场反应测试的模板；2. 为政策制定者提供了实证证据，表明州级比特币储备更多是政治信号而非审慎财政管理；3. 强调了风险管理在公共财政决策中的重要性。

title: Why Financial Intelligence Reaches Its Full Potential Through System Literacy
affiliations: New York State Department of Taxation & Finance

detail.title: Why Financial Intelligence Reaches Its Full Potential Through System Literacy
detail.abstract:
Financial intelligence is commonly associated with analytical proficiency, including the ability to interpret data, apply economic reasoning, and navigate regulatory frameworks. However, as financial environments become increasingly complex and system-driven, analytical skill alone is often insufficient to produce consistent, accountable, and resilient outcomes. This paper argues that financial intelligence reaches its full potential only when it is supported by system literacy—the ability to understand how decisions are operationalized within interconnected institutional, procedural, and technological systems.

Drawing on interdisciplinary literature from finance, accounting, organizational theory, and governance, this conceptual analysis distinguishes between analytical intelligence and executional intelligence. It demonstrates how system literacy functions as a foundational capability that enables financial insight to translate into effective action. Without an understanding of system design, process dependencies, and institutional constraints, even technically correct financial decisions may fail in practice.

The paper develops a high-level framework illustrating how system awareness enhances decision consistency, accountability, and governance quality. Rather than offering policy prescriptions, the analysis focuses on structural dynamics that shape real-world financial decision-making. The findings have implications for professional education, organizational design, and leadership development, particularly in environments where financial decisions intersect with complex administrative and regulatory systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出金融智能需要系统素养支撑，仅靠分析能力不足以保证决策的有效执行。系统素养帮助理解决策如何在制度、流程和技术系统中运作，从而提升决策一致性、问责性和治理质量。
AI.research_question: 金融智能如何通过系统素养提升决策的有效性和执行质量？
AI.motivation: 随着金融环境日益复杂和系统化，仅靠分析能力已不足以产生一致、可问责和有韧性的结果，需要理解决策如何在系统中运作。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于金融、会计、组织理论和治理的跨学科文献，区分分析智能与执行智能，强调系统素养作为基础能力的重要性。
AI.method: 概念分析，通过跨学科文献综述构建理论框架，说明系统素养如何将金融洞察转化为有效行动。
AI.findings: 系统素养是金融智能发挥潜力的关键，缺乏对系统设计、流程依赖和制度约束的理解，即使技术正确的金融决策也可能在实践中失败。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了系统素养作为金融智能核心组成部分的理论框架，区分分析智能与执行智能，强调系统意识对决策一致性和治理质量的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 对专业教育、组织设计和领导力发展有启示，特别是在金融决策与复杂行政和监管系统交叉的环境中。

reference: https://www.xinghu.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Credibility-and-Self-preferencing_Xing-SSRN.pdf
title: Invisible Influence: Credibility under Self-Preferencing on Recommendation Platforms

detail.title: Invisible Influence: Credibility under Self-Preferencing on Recommendation Platforms
detail.abstract:
Problem definition: Digital platforms now guide most consumption decisions through personalized assortments and ranked recommendations. At the same time, these platforms have strong self-preferencing incentives to push high-margin or strategic content (e.g., originals, sponsored items, private labels). When such incentives are salient, users may no longer treat rankings as neutral advice, but instead question their credibility and adjust their behavior. We study how this tension between platform incentives and user trust shapes engagement, assortment decisions, and long-run platform payoff.

Methodology/results: We develop a game-theoretic model that captures the strategic interactions between a platform and rational users who adjust their beliefs and decide whether to follow, discount, or ignore the recommendations. We introduce platform’s self-preferencing weight toward the high-margin category. Our analysis reveals three distinct equilibrium regimes: compliance, pandering, and zero-compliance. We find that persistent self-preferencing is not always beneficial; excessive bias can lead users to disregard recommendations entirely. Reducing assortment variety can enhance both credibility and profitability, challenging the conventional belief that “more choice is better.” Furthermore, we propose strategies such as donation-match schemes to restore user trust while maintaining profitability.

Managerial implications: Our analysis delivers concise design rules for incentive-driven recommendation systems. When users recognize platform-incentivized options, content curation and ranking should be treated as tools for credibility engineering: sometimes limiting platform-favored items, sometimes softening self-preferencing, and sometimes using donation-match type, value sharing schemes that visibly align the platform’s interests with those of its users and restore trust in the recommendation signal.

AI.tldr: 平台自我偏好推荐与用户信任的博弈：过度偏向会破坏推荐可信度，减少品类多样性反而能提升平台盈利，捐赠匹配机制可恢复信任。
AI.research_question: 平台自我偏好激励与用户信任之间的紧张关系如何影响用户参与度、品类决策和平台长期收益？
AI.motivation: 数字平台通过个性化推荐引导消费决策，但平台有强烈动机推送高利润或战略性内容（如原创、赞助商品、自有品牌）。当这种激励明显时，用户可能不再将排名视为中性建议，而是质疑其可信度并调整行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论模型，捕捉平台与理性用户之间的战略互动，用户调整信念并决定是否遵循、折扣或忽略推荐。
AI.method: 开发博弈论模型，引入平台对高利润品类的自我偏好权重，分析三种均衡状态：遵从、迎合和零遵从。
AI.findings: 1. 持续自我偏好并非总是有益，过度偏袒会导致用户完全忽视推荐；2. 减少品类多样性可同时提升可信度和盈利能力，挑战"更多选择更好"的传统观念；3. 捐赠匹配机制可恢复用户信任同时保持盈利。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立平台自我偏好与用户信任的博弈理论框架；2. 识别三种均衡状态及其转换条件；3. 挑战传统"更多选择更好"的假设，提出可信度工程概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为激励驱动推荐系统提供简洁设计规则；2. 内容策展和排名应作为可信度工程工具；3. 建议限制平台偏好项目、软化自我偏好、使用捐赠匹配等价值共享方案来恢复信任。

title: Organizational Governance and Steward Leadership
affiliations: Columbia International University, Columbia International University

detail.title: Organizational Governance and Steward Leadership
detail.abstract: This analysis provides insights into stewardship within nonprofit governance, particularly regarding the roles of chief stewards or boards of members and under-steward CEOs. Steward Leadership in this context centers on a biblical model, emphasizing non-ownership and accountability to both implicit/explicit owners. The analysis details the governance role of board members, examining the fiduciary, strategic, and potentially generative roles. The examination delves into Chait, Ryan, and Taylor's (2005) explanations of Type I-III governance, including applications of stewardship necessitating flexible organizational structures with oversight. It also includes the overall potential for generative thinking and governance, as well as the board's positioning. This paper highlights the role of the CEO, presenting the dynamics they hold with stakeholders regarding accessibility and public profile, and demonstrating that these must be aligned with the board and that they maintain responsibility for organizational impacts. This analysis concludes with the emphasis that stewardship within governance must focus on flexibility and accountability, noting the respective responsibilities of the chief steward and understeward.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析了非营利组织治理中的管家领导力，重点关注董事会成员（首席管家）和CEO（次级管家）的角色。基于圣经模型，强调非所有权和对显性/隐性所有者的问责。探讨了董事会的信托、战略和生成性角色，以及CEO与利益相关者的动态关系，最终强调治理需要灵活性和问责制。
AI.research_question: 非营利组织治理中管家领导力的角色和动态是什么？特别是董事会成员（首席管家）和CEO（次级管家）在治理结构中的责任、关系和问责机制如何运作？
AI.motivation: 非营利组织治理面临独特的挑战，需要不同于营利组织的领导模式。基于圣经的管家领导力模型为非营利治理提供了强调非所有权和问责的理论框架，但这一模型在实践中的具体应用和角色分工需要深入研究。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 管家领导力理论（基于圣经模型）：强调非所有权、对显性和隐性所有者的问责
2. Chait, Ryan和Taylor（2005）的治理类型理论：Type I-III治理模式
3. 董事会角色理论：信托角色、战略角色、生成性角色
4. 组织治理结构理论：强调灵活的组织结构和监督机制
AI.method: 概念分析/理论分析。论文采用文献综述和理论分析的方法，基于现有治理理论和管家领导力框架，对非营利组织治理中的角色和关系进行系统性分析。
AI.findings:
1. 董事会成员作为"首席管家"承担信托、战略和生成性三重角色
2. CEO作为"次级管家"需要与董事会保持一致，并对组织影响负责
3. CEO与利益相关者的动态关系（可及性和公众形象）必须与董事会协调
4. 有效的管家治理需要灵活的组织结构和明确的监督机制
5. 生成性思维在治理中具有重要潜力
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 将管家领导力理论系统应用于非营利组织治理分析
2. 明确了"首席管家"（董事会）和"次级管家"（CEO）的角色区分
3. 整合了Chait等人的治理类型理论与管家领导力框架
4. 强调了生成性思维在非营利治理中的理论价值
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为非营利组织董事会和CEO提供了清晰的角色指导
2. 强调了治理结构灵活性和问责机制的重要性
3. 提供了协调董事会与CEO关系的实践框架
4. 帮助非营利组织建立基于管家领导力的有效治理模式

title: From Lists to Oracles: Competition for Generative Search Visibility and Long-Tail Entry

detail.title: From Lists to Oracles: Competition for Generative Search Visibility and Long-Tail Entry
detail.abstract: The transition from ranked-list search engines to generative AI “oracles” represents a fundamental shift in the allocation mechanism of the digital attention economy. We develop a game-theoretic framework to analyze how the move from divisible visibility (lists) to winner-takes-all exclusion (answers) reshapes competitive incentives and market structure. We model the competition between a high-authority Head firm  and a low-authority Tail firm, where the platform’s scoring  rule aggregates prior authority and query-specific evidence via a strategic authority weight, while firms exert costly optimization effort (GEO) to signal their intrinsic relevance. Our results demonstrate that Generative Search drives a surge-or-retreat equilibrium leading to a bifurcated market: in broad queries with commoditized relevance, the game intensifies Matthew-Effect concentration; in niche queries, sufficiently specialized SMEs can overturn incumbency to capture the market via a “long-tail flip.” Furthermore, we uncover a dual-endowment reversal: intrinsic relevance acts as a substitute for effort once a specialist secures the answer slot, whereas an authority disadvantage forces the SME to escalate effort to deter entry. Finally, for platforms and policymakers, we identify the authority weight as a critical market-design lever that dictates competitiveness, redistributes visibility, and determines the quality of information delivered to the user.

AI.tldr: 生成式AI搜索从排名列表转向单一答案模式，重塑数字注意力经济分配机制，导致市场两极分化：宽泛查询加剧马太效应，专业查询中中小企业可能颠覆现有格局。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI搜索如何改变数字注意力经济的竞争激励和市场结构？从可分可见性（列表）到赢家通吃（答案）的转变如何影响企业竞争策略？
AI.motivation: 传统排名列表搜索引擎向生成式AI"神谕"模式的转变，代表了数字注意力经济分配机制的根本性变化，需要理解这种转变如何重塑竞争动态和市场结构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论框架，分析从可分可见性到赢家通吃排他性的转变；建模高权威头部企业与低权威尾部企业的竞争；平台评分规则整合先验权威和查询特定证据；企业通过成本优化努力（GEO）发出内在相关性信号。
AI.method: 博弈论建模方法，构建包含平台评分规则、企业权威差异、优化努力成本的理论模型，分析不同查询类型下的均衡结果。
AI.findings: 1.生成式搜索导致"激增或撤退"均衡，市场两极分化；2.宽泛查询加剧马太效应集中；3.专业查询中，足够专业的中小企业可通过"长尾翻转"颠覆现有格局；4.发现双重禀赋逆转：内在相关性在获得答案位置后替代努力，而权威劣势迫使中小企业增加努力以阻止进入。
AI.theory_contributions: 1.首次从博弈论角度分析生成式AI搜索对注意力经济的影响；2.提出"激增或撤退"均衡概念；3.识别"长尾翻转"机制；4.揭示权威权重作为关键市场设计杠杆的理论意义。
AI.practical_contributions: 1.为平台提供权威权重作为市场设计工具；2.为中小企业提供专业查询中的竞争策略；3.为政策制定者提供监管生成式AI搜索市场竞争的框架；4.帮助企业理解在不同查询类型下的最优投资策略。

title: Token Design for Favor Trading with Dynamic Membership
affiliations: , The University of Hong Kong - Faculty of Business and Economics and

detail.title: Token Design for Favor Trading with Dynamic Membership
detail.abstract:
This paper investigates the design and management of token-based favor-trading platforms, explicitly accounting for dynamic entry and exit of heterogeneous participants. Favor-trading systems, which facilitate non-monetary reciprocal exchanges, offer substantial potential for resource sharing and collaboration. However, existing research largely assumes a fixed set of participants, limiting its relevance to real-world environments where users frequently join or exit. 

 

To address this gap, we design a dynamic system that accommodates participant turnover and heterogeneity. We propose novel token-based mechanisms: token issuance (at zero balance), redemption (at a finite cap U), and recycling (at exit). Together, they ensure stable token circulation and incentivize an efficient “always-trade” strategy. Our analysis characterizes the conditions for this strategy to prevail in equilibrium, showing it is sustained if the favor's benefit-cost ratio exceeds a specific threshold. Further, we demonstrate that a finite token cap U is necessary for equilibrium and that our recycling mechanism is essential for making the system robust and scalable by preventing the threshold from growing exponentially. We also show the mechanism is robust to participant heterogeneity. 

 

By bridging theoretical insights and practical design, our work provides the first rigorous framework for operating favor-trading systems with dynamic membership. The results have direct implications for time-banking, decentralized capacity-sharing platforms, and broader applications in tokenized service exchanges.

AI.tldr: 本文研究基于代币的互助交易平台设计与管理，特别考虑异质参与者的动态进出。现有研究假设参与者固定，而实际中用户频繁加入退出。作者设计动态系统，提出代币发行、赎回和回收机制，确保稳定流通并激励"始终交易"策略。分析表明当收益成本比超过阈值时该策略可持续，有限代币上限和回收机制对系统稳健性和可扩展性至关重要。
AI.research_question: 如何设计和管基于代币的互助交易平台，以应对异质参与者的动态进出问题？
AI.motivation: 现有研究大多假设参与者固定，但实际应用中用户频繁加入和退出，这限制了现有研究的现实相关性。互助交易系统在资源共享和协作方面具有巨大潜力，但需要解决动态成员管理问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代币经济学、博弈论、动态系统理论、激励机制设计
AI.method: 理论建模与分析，设计代币发行（零余额）、赎回（有限上限U）和回收（退出时）机制，分析均衡条件和策略可持续性
AI.findings: 1. 当互助的收益成本比超过特定阈值时，"始终交易"策略可在均衡中持续；2. 有限代币上限U对均衡是必要的；3. 回收机制通过防止阈值指数增长使系统稳健且可扩展；4. 机制对参与者异质性具有鲁棒性
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次为动态成员互助交易系统提供严谨理论框架；2. 提出代币发行、赎回和回收机制的理论基础；3. 分析动态环境下均衡条件和策略可持续性
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为时间银行、去中心化能力共享平台提供设计指导；2. 为代币化服务交换提供实用机制；3. 帮助平台管理者设计稳健的动态互助系统
